Translation: (iii) A cargo ship shall be issued a Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate after passing the initial or renewal survey, provided it complies with the relevant requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, and V, as well as other applicable provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅳ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第IV章的有关要求及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给货船无线电安全证书。
Translation: (iv) A cargo ship, upon undergoing initial or renewal survey and meeting the relevant requirements of Chapter IV as well as other applicable provisions of this Convention, shall be issued a Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (2)如货船安全证书用以取代货船构造安全证书、货船设备安全证书或货船无线电安全证书时，则无论何时，在本章涉及有关这些证书的事项时，亦应适用于货船安全证书。
Translation: (2) When the Cargo Ship Safety Certificate is issued in lieu of the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, the Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate, or the Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate, any reference in this chapter to such certificates shall apply equally to the Cargo Ship Safety Certificate at all times.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅵ)(ⅰ)、(ⅲ)、(ⅳ)和(ⅴ)所述的客船安全证书、货船设备安全证书、货船无线电安全证书和货船安全证书均应备有一份设备记录。
Translation: (vi) A record of equipment shall be permanently attached to the passenger ship safety certificate, cargo ship safety equipment certificate, cargo ship safety radio certificate, and cargo ship safety certificate referred to in (i), (iii), (iv), and (v) respectively.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅶ)对于根据和按照本公约的规定受到某项免除的船舶，除发给本条所述的证书以外，还应发给免除证书。
Translation: (vii) In addition to the certificate specified in this article, a ship granted an exemption under and in accordance with the provisions of this Convention shall be issued with an exemption certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.791(19)决议《1969国际吨位丈量公约对现有船舶的应用》。
Translation: Refer to the Organization's resolution A.791(19) "Application of the 1969 International Tonnage Measurement Convention to Existing Ships."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见关于签发补录和附录的通函(PSLS.2/Circ.1)。
Translation: ②Refer to Circular PSLS.2/Circ.1 regarding the issuance of supplements and appendices.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在缔约国政府对本公约的接受生效之日后，不应再根据和按照1960、1948或1929年国际海上人命安全公约的规定签发证书。
Translation: (b) No certificates shall be issued under or in accordance with the provisions of the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1960, 1948 or 1929, after the date on which acceptance of the present Convention by the Government of the Contracting State concerned takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国政府可应主管机关请求对船舶进行检验，如认为该船符合本公约的要求，应按照本公约规定发给或授权发给该船证书，或如适用，对船上证书进行签署或授权签署。
Translation: The Government of a Contracting State may, at the request of the competent authority, have a ship surveyed. If it is satisfied that the ship complies with the requirements of the Convention, it shall issue or authorize the issuance of certificates to the ship in accordance with the Convention or, where applicable, endorse or authorize the endorsement of certificates on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如此签发的任何证书必须载明是受船旗国政府的委托而签发的。此证书与根据第12条所发的证书具有同等效力，并受同样的承认。
Translation: Any certificate so issued must contain a statement to the effect that it has been issued at the request of the Government of the flag State. It shall have the same validity and receive the same recognition as the certificate issued under Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: (a)签发客船安全证书的有效期限不应超过12个月。
Translation: (a) The validity period of a passenger ship safety certificate shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 签发货船构造安全证书、货船设备全证书和货船无线电安全证书的有效期限应由主管机关规定，但不得超过5年。
Translation: The validity period of the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate, and Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate shall be determined by the Administration but shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: 免除证书的有效期限不应长于其有关证书的有效期限。
Translation: The validity period of an exemption certificate shall not exceed that of the relevant certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (2)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年的日期内有效。
Translation: (2) For cargo ships, the validity period shall not exceed 5 years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.

Query_Text_cn: (c)除客船安全证书外，如果所发证书的有效期限少于5年，主管机关可延长证书的有效期自证书期满日至本条(a)规定的最长期限，条件是在签发5年期的证书时进行了第8、9和10条所述的相应的检验。
Translation: (c) In addition to the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate, if the validity period of the issued certificate is less than five years, the Administration may extend the validity of the certificate from the expiry date to the maximum period specified in paragraph (a) of this Article, provided that the corresponding surveys referred to in Articles 8, 9, and 10 have been carried out when issuing the five-year certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如果换证检验已完成，而新证书在现有证书期满之日前不能签发或不能存放在船上，主管机关授权的人员或组织可在现有证书上签署，签署后的证书自期满之日起不超过5个月的期限内应视为有效。
Translation: (d) If the renewal survey has been completed and the new certificate cannot be issued or placed on board before the expiry date of the existing certificate, the person or organization authorized by the Administration may endorse the existing certificate, which shall be accepted as valid for a period not exceeding five months from the expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如果证书期满时船舶不在应进行检验的港口，主管机关可延长该证书的有效期，但此项展期仅以能使船舶完成其驶抵应进行检验的港口的航次为限，并且仅在正当和合理的情况下才能如此办理。
Translation: (e) If a ship at the time when a certificate expires is not in a port in which it is to be surveyed, the competent authority may extend the validity of the certificate, but such extension shall be granted only for the purpose of allowing the ship to complete its voyage to the port in which it is to be surveyed, and only in cases where it appears proper and reasonable to do so.

Query_Text_cn: 展期不得超过3个月。经展期的船舶在抵达应进行检验的港口后，不得因有此项展期而在未获得新证书前驶离该港口。
Translation: The extension shall not exceed three months. A ship to which an extension is granted shall not, upon arriving at the port in which it is due to be surveyed, leave that port without having obtained a new certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自现有证书展期前的期满日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, not exceeding 5 years from the expiry date of the existing certificate prior to its renewal.

Query_Text_cn: (f)发给短程航行船舶的证书未按本条前述之规定展期，主管机关可给予自该证书期满之日起至多1个月的宽限期。
Translation: (f) For certificates issued to ships engaged on short voyages that have not been extended under the preceding provisions of this article, the Administration may grant a grace period of up to one month from the date of expiry of such certificates.

Query_Text_cn: (g)在特殊情况下(由主管机关确定)，新证书无需按(b)(ⅱ)、(e)或(f)的要求从现有证书期满日起计算日期。
Translation: (g) In exceptional circumstances (as determined by the competent authority), a new certificate need not be dated from the expiry date of the existing certificate as required by (b)(ii), (e), or (f).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, not exceeding 5 years from the date of completion of the renewal survey.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)若进行一次或多次相宜的年度检验、中间检验或定期检验，而使有关规则规定的检验最长间隔期不超过，该期满日可保持不变。
Translation: (iii) If one or more appropriate annual surveys, intermediate surveys or periodical surveys are conducted in accordance with the relevant rules without exceeding the maximum interval specified therein, the expiry date may remain unchanged.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)船舶变更船旗国时。
Translation: (iii) When a ship changes its flag state.

Query_Text_cn: 只有当换发新证书的政府确认该船业已满足第11(a)及(b)条的要求时，才换发新证书。
Translation: A new certificate shall be issued only when the Government issuing the new certificate is fully satisfied that the ship complies with the requirements of paragraphs (a) and (b) of regulation 11.

Query_Text_cn: 如果变更船旗系在两个缔约国之间进行，则在变更船旗后的3个月内，前一个船旗国政府如接到申请，应尽快将变更船旗前该船所携证书的副本以及有关的检验报告(如备有时)，送交该船的新主管机关。
Translation: If the change of flag occurs between two Contracting Parties, the former flag State government shall, upon request within three months after the change of flag, promptly transmit to the new Administration copies of the certificates carried by the ship prior to the change of flag, along with relevant survey reports (if available).

Query_Text_cn: 各种证书和设备记录应按本公约附则的附录中给出的相应格式制定。
Translation: All certificates and equipment records shall be drawn up in the corresponding forms specified in the appendices to the annex of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果使用的文字既非英文又非法文，则文本应包含其中一种文字的译本。
Translation: If the text used is neither in English nor in French, it shall include a translation in one of these languages.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第12和13条签发的船上各种证书应随时可用，以供检查。
Translation: All certificates issued under Articles 12 and 13 shall be readily available for inspection at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应视为这种证书与由其本国政府所签发的证书同样有效。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall regard such certificates as having the same validity as those issued by its own government.

Query_Text_cn: (a)如船舶在某一特定航次中所载人数少于客船安全证书中所载的总数，从而按照本规则规定可配置少于证书中所载的救生艇和其他救生设备，本章第12条或第13条所指的政府、个人或组织可签发一份证书附件。
Translation: (a) If a ship carries a smaller number of persons on a particular voyage than the total number stated in the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate, and thus requires fewer lifeboats and other life-saving appliances than are specified in the Certificate under the provisions of these regulations, the government, individual, or organization referred to in Article 12 or Article 13 of this chapter may issue an annex to the Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在此项附件上应载明在当时情况下并无违反本规则规定之处。
Translation: (b) This annex shall state that there was no violation of the provisions of these rules under the circumstances at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 上述附件应附于证书之后，并仅在救生设备方面代替该证书。
Translation: The above-mentioned annex shall be attached to the certificate and shall replace it only in respect of life-saving appliances.

Query_Text_cn: 这种附件仅对该特定航次有效。
Translation: This attachment is valid only for this specific voyage.

Query_Text_cn: (a)每艘船舶当其在另一缔约国政府的港口时，应受该国政府正式授权官员的控制。这种控制的目的，仅在于查明该船根据第12条或第13条所签发的各种证书是否有效。
Translation: (a) Every ship, while in a port of another Contracting Government, shall be subject to control by officers duly authorized by that Government. Such control shall be limited to verifying whether the certificates issued under Article 12 or Article 13 are valid.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除有明显理由确信该船或其设备的情况实质上与任一证书所载情况不符，或该船及其设备不符合第11(a)及(b)条的规定外，这些证书，如属有效，即应被承认。
Translation: (b) These certificates shall be accepted as valid unless there are clear grounds for believing that the condition of the ship or its equipment does not correspond substantially with the particulars of any certificate, or that the ship and its equipment do not comply with the provisions of paragraphs (a) and (b) of Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如因这种控制而引起任何干涉，执行控制的官员应将认为必须进行干涉的一切情况，立即书面通知船旗国的领事，或当领事不在时，则通知其最近的外交代表。
Translation: (d) In the event of any interference arising from such control, the officer carrying out the control shall promptly notify in writing all circumstances deemed necessary for the interference to the consular officer of the flag State or, in the absence of such consular officer, to its nearest diplomatic representative.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应通知负责发证的指定验船师或认可组织。
Translation: Additionally, the designated surveyor or recognized organization responsible for issuing the certificate shall be notified.

Query_Text_cn: 有关干涉的事实应向本组织报告。
Translation: The facts concerning the interference shall be reported to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如未能按本条(c)及(d)的规定采取措施，或如已允许该船驶往下一停靠港时，港口国的有关当局应将所有有关该船的情况，除通知本条(d)所述有关方面外，还要通知下一停靠港当局。
Translation: (e) If measures as specified in paragraphs (c) and (d) of this Article are not taken, or if the ship is permitted to proceed to the next port of call, the competent authorities of the port State shall notify all relevant information concerning the ship, in addition to the parties referred to in paragraph (d), to the authorities of the next port of call.

Query_Text_cn: (f)根据本条规定执行控制时，应尽一切努力避免对船舶作不当扣留或延误。
Translation: (f) When exercising control under this provision, every effort shall be made to avoid undue detention or delay of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶被不当扣留或延误，应有权对所受的任何损失或损害要求赔偿。
Translation: If a vessel is improperly detained or delayed, it shall have the right to claim compensation for any loss or damage incurred.

Query_Text_cn: 任何船舶除持有相应的有效证书外，不可要求本公约所赋予的各项特权。
Translation: No ship shall be entitled to the privileges conferred by this Convention unless it holds the corresponding valid certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.787(19)决议通过的，经A.882(21)决议修正的《港口国控制程序》。
Translation: Refer to the Procedures for Port State Control adopted by the Assembly resolution A.787(19), as amended by resolution A.882(21).

Query_Text_cn: (a)各主管机关对其所属的受本公约规定约束的任何船舶所发生的任何事故，当其认为调查该项事故有助于确定本规则可能所需要的何种修改时，即应承担义务进行调查。
Translation: (a) Each Administration undertakes to conduct an investigation into any accident occurring to any of its ships subject to the provisions of this Convention when it believes that such an investigation may assist in determining what changes in the present rules might be desirable.

Query_Text_cn: (b)各缔约国政府有义务将有关此项调查所获得的适当资料提供给本组织。
Translation: (b) Each Contracting Government is obligated to provide the Organization with relevant information obtained from such investigations.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织根据此项资料所作的报告或建议，一律不得泄露有关船舶的辨认特征或国籍，或以任何方式确定或暗示任何船舶或个人承担的责任。
Translation: Reports or recommendations made by the Organization based on such information shall not disclose the identity or nationality of the vessels concerned, nor shall they in any manner determine or imply the liability of any vessel or individual.

Query_Text_cn: 经A.884(21)决议修正的A.849(20)决议：海难与事故调查规则。
Translation: Resolution A.849(20) as amended by Resolution A.884(21): Code for the Investigation of Marine Casualties and Incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见：MSC/Circ.953海安会通函：关于海难与事故的报告。
Translation: See also: MSC/Circ.953 - IMO Circular on Reporting of Marine Casualties and Incidents.

Query_Text_cn: 经修订的协调报告程序-SOLAS公约第I/21条和MARPOL73/78公约第8条和第12条所要求的报告。
Translation: Revised harmonized reporting procedures - reports required under SOLAS Regulation I/21 and MARPOL 73/78 Articles 8 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅷ)本条所述的各种证书均应由主管机关或主管机关授权的任何个人或组织签发或签署，但无论由谁签发或签署，主管机关都应对证书完全负责。
Translation: (viii) All certificates referred to in this paragraph shall be issued or signed either by the Administration or by any person or organization duly authorized by it. In every case, the Administration assumes full responsibility for the certificates.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在本条(b)所述情况下或当证书过期或失效时，执行控制的官员应采取措施，以保证该船在未具备对船舶或船上人员都无危险的条件前，不得开航出海或离港驶往适当的修船厂。
Translation: (c) In the circumstances referred to in paragraph (b) or when a certificate has expired or ceased to be valid, the officer carrying out the control shall take steps to ensure that the ship shall not sail until it can proceed to sea or leave the port for an appropriate repair yard without danger to the ship or persons on board.

Query_Text_cn: 1本部分的要求适用于船长（Ls）超过100m的货船，但不包括表明是符合本组织制定的其他文件②中分舱和破损稳性规则的那些船舶。
Translation: This section applies to cargo ships with a length (Ls) exceeding 100 meters, excluding those certified as complying with the subdivision and damage stability rules in other documents developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本部分要求也适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船长（Ls）为80m及以上但不超过100m的货船。
Translation: This requirement also applies to cargo ships with a length (Ls) of 80 meters or more but not exceeding 100 meters, constructed on or after July 1, 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 2下文提到的规则系指本部分所包含的整套规则。
Translation: The rules mentioned below refer to the entire set of rules contained in this section.

Query_Text_cn: 3对某一特定船舶或一组船舶，如果主管机关确信至少能达到与本规则同等的安全程度，可以接受变通的布置。
Translation: 3 For a specific ship or a group of ships, the Administration may accept alternative arrangements if it is satisfied that at least an equivalent level of safety to that provided by these rules is achieved.

Query_Text_cn: 凡允许采取此类变通布置的任何主管机关均应将其详细情况通报本组织。
Translation: Any Administration which allows such alternative arrangements shall communicate the particulars thereof to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1分舱载重线系指用以确定船舶分舱的水线。
Translation: 1.1 The subdivision load line refers to the waterline used to determine the subdivision of a ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2最深分舱载重线系指相应于核定的船舶夏季吃水的分舱载重线。
Translation: 1.2 The deepest subdivision load line is the waterline corresponding to the ship's approved summer draught.

Query_Text_cn: 1.3部分载重线系指空船吃水加上空船吃水与最深分舱载重线之间差值的60%。
Translation: 1.3 Partial load line refers to the light draft plus 60% of the difference between the light draft and the deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1船舶分舱长度（Ls）系指船舶处于最深分舱载重线时限制垂向浸水范围的甲板及其以下部分最大投影型长度。
Translation: 2.1 The subdivision length (Ls) refers to the maximum projected molded length of the part of the vessel below the deck that limits vertical flooding when the ship is at its deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: ①在采用包含在B-1部分的规则时，海上安全委员会提请各主管机关注意，这些规则应与本组织A.684(17)决议通过的《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释》一起使用，以确保应用的一致性。
Translation: ① When applying the rules contained in section B-1, the Maritime Safety Committee draws the attention of Administrations to the fact that these rules should be used in conjunction with theInterpretation of the Intact Stability Code on damage stability requirements for cargo ships of 100m in length and over for application to SOLAS, adopted by resolution A.684(17), in the interest of uniform application.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见MSC.76(69)决议《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释的扩展应用（A.684(17)决议）》。
Translation: See also MSC.76(69) resolution on the "Extended Application of the Explanatory Notes to the SOLAS Regulations on Subdivision and Damage Stability of Cargo Ships of 100 Metres in Length and Over (Resolution A.684(17))".

Query_Text_cn: 6采用《1966载重线公约》第27条的破损稳性要求且同时符合A.320(IX)和A.514(13)决议的规定，但是对适用该公约第27(9)条的船舶而言，被认为有效的主水密横舱壁应按A.320(IX)决议中(12)(f)规定的间距设置。
Translation: 6 Adopt the damage stability requirements of Article 27 of the 1966 Load Line Convention while complying with the provisions of Resolutions A.320(IX) and A.514(13). However, for ships to which Article 27(9) of the Convention applies, the effective main watertight transverse bulkheads shall be spaced in accordance with the intervals specified in paragraph (12)(f) of Resolution A.320(IX).

Query_Text_cn: 2.2船长中点系指船舶分舱长度的中点。
Translation: 2.2 The amidships point refers to the midpoint of the ship's subdivision length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3后端点系指分舱长度的最后一点。
Translation: 2.3 The after terminal refers to the final point of the subdivision length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.4前端点系指分舱长度的最前一点。
Translation: 2.4 The forward terminal refers to the foremost point of the subdivision length.

Query_Text_cn: 3船宽（B）系指在最深分舱载重线或其下的船舶最大型宽。
Translation: The breadth (B) refers to the maximum molded breadth of the ship at or below the deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 4吃水（d）系指在船长中点处从船型基线至所述水线间的垂直距离。
Translation: 4 The draught (d) is the vertical distance measured at the midship from the moulded baseline to the waterline in question.

Query_Text_cn: 5某一处所的渗透率（μ）系指该处所浸水容积与浸没容积之比。
Translation: The permeability (μ) of a compartment refers to the ratio of its floodable volume to its total volume.

Query_Text_cn: 1本规则旨在给船舶规定一个最低的分舱标准。
Translation: 1 The purpose of these regulations is to prescribe a minimum standard of subdivision for ships.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：R0为上述.1公式算出的R值。
Translation: where:R0 is the R value calculated by the formula in section.1 above.

Query_Text_cn: 1按本条计算所得的达到的分舱指数A应不小于按第25-3.2条计算所得的要求的分舱指数R。
Translation: The attained subdivision index A calculated in accordance with this regulation shall not be less than the required subdivision index R calculated in accordance with regulation 25-3.2.

Query_Text_cn: si表示所考虑的舱或舱组浸水后生存概率，包括任何水平分隔的影响。
Translation: si denotes the probability of survival for the compartment or group of compartments under consideration after flooding, including the effects of any horizontal subdivision.

Query_Text_cn: 3在计算A时应采用水平纵倾。
Translation: When calculating A, horizontal trim should be applied.

Query_Text_cn: 4该总和仅包括那些有助于增加达到的分舱指数A值的浸水情况。
Translation: 4 This total includes only those flooding scenarios that contribute to increasing the attained subdivision index A.

Query_Text_cn: 5上述公式所表示的总和应计及整船长范围内单个舱或两个或更多相邻舱浸水的所有情况。
Translation: The total sum represented by the above formula shall take into account all cases of flooding involving a single compartment or two or more adjacent compartments within the ship's entire length.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，边舱或舱组和其相邻的内侧舱或舱组间同时浸水的所有情况也应加入总和，此时假定一矩形穿透扩展至船中心线但不包括中心线处舱壁的破损。
Translation: In addition, all cases of simultaneous flooding of a side compartment or group of compartments and the adjacent inboard compartment or group of compartments should be included in the summation, assuming a rectangular penetration extending to the ship's centerline but excluding damage to the centerline bulkhead.

Query_Text_cn: 7破损的垂向范围假定为从基线向上扩展至水线以上或更高的任一水密水平分隔。
Translation: 7 The vertical extent of damage is assumed to extend upward from the baseline to any watertight horizontal subdivision above the waterline or higher.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果一个较小范围的破损会产生更为严重的后果，则须假定为该范围。
Translation: However, if damage to a smaller area would result in more severe consequences, that area shall be assumed.

Query_Text_cn: 8如在假定浸水舱范围内设有管子、管弄或隧道，其布置必须保证累进浸水不会扩展到那些假定浸水的舱室以外的其他舱室。
Translation: 8 If pipes, pipe ducts, or tunnels are installed within the assumed flooded compartments, their arrangement shall ensure that progressive flooding does not extend to other compartments beyond those assumed to be flooded.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果证实累进浸水的影响能被容易地控制并且不损害船舶的安全，则主管机关可允许较小的累进浸水。
Translation: However, if it is demonstrated that the effects of progressive flooding can be easily controlled and do not compromise the safety of the ship, the Administration may permit a lesser extent of progressive flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 9在根据规则进行浸水计算时，只需假定船壳有一个破洞。
Translation: 9 When performing the flooding calculation according to the rules, it is only necessary to assume a single breach in the ship's hull.

Query_Text_cn: 48最大无因次破损长度Jmax=Ls，但不大于0.24。
Translation: The maximum non-dimensional damage length Jmax=Ls, but shall not exceed 0.24.

Query_Text_cn: 破损位置沿船长的假定分布密度a=1.2+0.8E，但不大于1.2。
Translation: The assumed distribution density of damage location along the ship's length is a=1.2+0.8E, but not exceeding 1.2.

Query_Text_cn: Fy2y12=-+其他情况。
Translation: FY2Y12=Other circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1.5在应用本条1.1.2、1.1.3和1.1.4公式时，当所考虑的舱室跨越“船长中点”时，这些公式的值应减去一个按公式求得的q值，在此公式中取y=J'/Jmax计算F2。
Translation: 1.1.5 When applying the formulas in 1.1.2, 1.1.3, and 1.1.4, if the compartment in question extends over the "midpoint of the ship’s length," the value obtained from these formulas shall be reduced by a value q calculated according to a formula where F2 is determined by taking y = J′/Jmax.

Query_Text_cn: 2若设有边舱，某一边舱的pi值应以按本条3得到的值乘以本条2.2表示内侧处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数r求得。
Translation: 2 If a side compartment is fitted, the pi value for such a compartment shall be obtained by multiplying the value determined in accordance with paragraph 3 of this regulation by the reduction factor r, which represents the probability that the inboard spaces will not be flooded.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1某一边舱和其相邻的内侧舱室同时浸水的情况，其pi值应以本条3各公式所得的值乘以因数（1-r）求得。
Translation: 2.1 In the case where a side compartment and its adjacent inboard compartment are simultaneously flooded, the pi value shall be obtained by multiplying the value derived from the formulas in paragraph 3 of this section by the factor (1−r).

Query_Text_cn: 当J＜0.2b/B时，缩减因数r应在J=0时的r=1，和J=0.2b/B时，r按上述公式所得值之间用线性内插法求得。
Translation: When J < 0.2b/B, the reduction factor r should be determined by linear interpolation between r=1 at J=0 and the value of r obtained from the above formula when J=0.2b/B.

Query_Text_cn: b计算因数pi所用的纵向限界之间的平均横向距离（m）。该距离在最深分舱载重线处由船壳板至通过纵舱壁最外部分并与其平行的平面之间向中心线垂直量计。
Translation: b The average transverse distance (in meters) between the vertical limits used to calculate the factor pi. This distance is measured perpendicularly to the centerline at the deepest subdivision load line, from the ship's shell plating to a plane parallel to and passing through the outermost portion of the longitudinal bulkhead.

Query_Text_cn: 3对几个舱作为一个舱的pi值，可直接应用本条1和2的公式计算。
Translation: For three compartments treated as one compartment, the pᵢ value can be directly calculated using the formulas provided in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this section.

Query_Text_cn: pi=p23-p2-p3，等。
Translation: pi = p23 - p2 - p3, etc.
pi = p234 - p23 - p34 + p3, and so on.
pi = p2345 - p234 - p345 + p34, and so on.

Query_Text_cn: 应按本条1和2对单个舱的公式计算，其无因次长度J取p的下标所标明的舱组的无因次长度。
Translation: The calculation for an individual compartment shall be performed in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article, with the non-dimensional length J taken as the non-dimensional length of the group of compartments indicated by the subscript p.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2对三个或更多相邻舱室为一组的舱组，如果该舱组的无因次长度减去该舱组最前和最后舱室的无因次长度大于Jmax，则其因数pi等于零。
Translation: 3.2 For a group of three or more adjacent compartments, if the non-dimensional length of the group minus the non-dimensional lengths of the foremost and aftermost compartments in the group is greater than Jmax, then its factor pi shall be taken as zero.

Query_Text_cn: range超出平衡角的正复原力臂的范围（°），但不大于20°；但是此范围应在不能被风雨密关闭的开口被淹没的角度处终止。
Translation: The range exceeds the positive righting lever within the equilibrium angle (°), but not more than 20°; however, this range shall terminate at the angle where openings not capable of being closed weathertight become submerged.

Query_Text_cn: θe=最终横倾平衡角（°）。
Translation: θe = final heeling equilibrium angle (°).

Query_Text_cn: 1.2如考虑下沉、横倾和纵倾后的最终水线浸没某些开口的下缘,且通过该开口可能发生累进浸水时，取s=0。
Translation: 1.2 If the final waterline after accounting for sinkage, heel, and trim submerges the lower edge of any openings through which progressive flooding may occur, then s=0 shall be taken.

Query_Text_cn: 这些开口应包括空气管、通风筒和用风雨密门或舱口盖关闭的开口，但可以不包括那些用水密人孔盖和平面舱盖，保持甲板高度完整性的小型水密舱口盖，遥控操作的水密滑动门，通常在海上关闭的水密完整的出入门和舱口盖，以及非打开型的舷窗关闭的开口。
Translation: These openings shall include air pipes, ventilators, and openings closed by weathertight doors or hatch covers, but may exclude small watertight hatch covers secured by watertight manhole covers and flush deck plates that maintain the integrity of the deck level, remotely operated watertight sliding doors, normally closed watertight access doors and hatch covers, and openings closed by non-opening type scuttles.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果在计算中计及那些累进浸水的舱室，则本条的要求也应适用。
Translation: However, if the progressively flooded compartments are included in the calculation, the requirements of this paragraph shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: sp在部分载重线处的s因数。
Translation: The s-factor at certain load waterlines.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于防撞舱壁前面的所有舱室计算所得的s值应等于1，此时假定船舶位于最深分舱载重线并且不限制垂向破损范围。
Translation: For all compartments forward of the collision bulkhead, the calculated s value shall be equal to 1, assuming the ship is at the deepest subdivision load line with no restriction on the vertical extent of damage.

Query_Text_cn: 3.1对水平分隔以下的舱或舱组，其s值应以本条1.1所得的值乘以按本条3.3表示该水平分隔以上处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数v求得。
Translation: 3.1 For compartments or groups of compartments below a horizontal subdivision, the s value shall be obtained by multiplying the value as determined in paragraph 1.1 of this regulation by the reduction factor v, which represents the probability that the spaces above the horizontal subdivision will remain water-free, as specified in paragraph 3.3 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2如果由于水平分隔以上处所同时浸水能使指数A增加一个正值，则该舱室或舱组的s值应由按本条3.1所得的值增加一个因同时浸水按本条1.1得到的s值乘以因数（1-v）求得的值。
Translation: 3.2 If the simultaneous flooding of compartments above the waterline results in an increase in the index A by a positive value, the s-value for such compartment or group of compartments shall be obtained by adding to the value derived from 3.1 the product of the s-value calculated in accordance with 1.1 for simultaneous flooding multiplied by the factor (1-v).

Query_Text_cn: 取其较小者。
Translation: Take the smaller one.

Query_Text_cn: 1应向船长提供必要的可靠资料，以使船长能在各种营运情况下通过迅速而简便的方法得到有关船舶稳性的准确指导。
Translation: 1. The master shall be supplied with such reliable information as is necessary to enable him by rapid and simple processes to obtain accurate guidance as to the stability of the ship under varying conditions of service.

Query_Text_cn: 3破损后维持稳性所必需的所有其他数据和辅助措施。
Translation: 3 All other necessary data and auxiliary measures for maintaining stability after damage.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MCS/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: Refer to MCS/Circ.651 circular "Interpretation of the rules in Part B-1 of Chapter II-1 of the SOLAS Convention."

Query_Text_cn: ②视何者导致较严重的后果而定。
Translation: ②Depending on which leads to more severe consequences.

Query_Text_cn: 2为了指导高级船员，在驾驶室内应有固定显示的或随时可用的控制图，该图应清晰标明各层甲板及货舱的水密舱室的限界，限界上的开口及其关闭装置和控制位置，以及扶正由于浸水产生的横倾的装置。
Translation: 2 For the guidance of senior officers, a permanently displayed or readily available control plan shall be provided in the wheelhouse. This plan shall clearly indicate the boundaries of watertight compartments on each deck and in the cargo holds, the openings therein with their closing devices and control positions, as well as the arrangements for correcting any heel resulting from flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应给船上高级船员提供包含上述资料的小册子。
Translation: In addition, booklets containing the above information should also be provided to senior officers on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 3为了提供本条1.1所指的资料，如果所用的极限GM（或KG）值从有关分舱指数的计算中求得，则此极限GM应在最深分舱载重线和部分载重线之间呈线性变化。
Translation: 3 To provide the information referred to in paragraph 1.1, if the limiting GM (or KG) value used is derived from the calculation of the relevant subdivision index, this limiting GM shall vary linearly between the deepest subdivision load line and the partial load line.

Query_Text_cn: ②在此情况下，如部分载重线吃水的最小GM值由分舱指数的计算求得，则此GM值应假定为在低于部分载重线的各较小吃水时的GM值，除非应用完整稳性的要求。
Translation: ② In such cases, if the minimum GM value at partial load line draught is determined by subdivision index calculation, this GM value shall be assumed to apply at all lesser draughts below the partial load line, unless intact stability requirements dictate otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 1为适应船舶设计和船舶正常作业，水密分隔上的开口数量应保持最少。
Translation: To accommodate ship design and normal ship operations, the number of openings in watertight subdivisions shall be kept to a minimum.

Query_Text_cn: 凡是为了出入、管路、通风、电缆等需要而穿过水密舱壁和内部甲板时，须设有保持水密完整性的装置。
Translation: Where openings are made in watertight bulkheads and internal decks for access, piping, ventilation, electrical cables, etc., arrangements shall be made to ensure the watertight integrity is maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 如果表明任何累进浸水能易于控制并且不损害船舶安全，则主管机关可以允许放宽对干舷甲板以上的开口的水密性要求。
Translation: If it is demonstrated that any progressive flooding can be easily controlled and does not impair the safety of the ship, the Administration may allow relaxation of the watertight integrity requirements for openings above the freeboard deck.

Query_Text_cn: 2为确保在海上使用的内部开口的水密完整性而设置的门须是滑动水密门，该门能从驾驶室遥控关闭，也能从舱壁的每一边就地操纵。
Translation: To ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings used at sea, the doors must be sliding watertight doors that can be remotely closed from the bridge and operated locally from either side of the bulkhead.

Query_Text_cn: 在控制位置应装设显示门是开启或关闭的指示器，并且在门关闭时发出声响报警。
Translation: An indicator showing whether the door is open or closed shall be installed at the control position, and an audible alarm shall sound when the door is closed.

Query_Text_cn: 在主动力失灵时，动力、控制和指示器应能工作。
Translation: In the event of main power failure, the power, control, and indicators shall remain operational.

Query_Text_cn: 特别应注意减少控制系统失灵的影响。
Translation: Particular attention should be paid to mitigating the impact of control system failures.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个动力操纵的滑动水密门应有一个独立的手动机械操纵装置。
Translation: Every power-operated sliding watertight door shall have an independent manual mechanical operating device.

Query_Text_cn: 该装置应能从门的任一边用手开启和关闭该门。
Translation: The device shall be capable of manually opening and closing the door from either side.

Query_Text_cn: 3用以保证内部开口的水密完整性且通常在航行时关闭的出入门和舱盖，应在该处和驾驶室装设显示这些门或舱盖是开启还是关闭的设施。
Translation: 3 Doors and hatches used to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings, which are normally closed during navigation, shall be fitted with indicators at their locations and on the bridge to show whether they are open or closed.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个此类门或舱盖必须附贴一个通告牌，其大意是不能让它开着。
Translation: Each such door or hatch must bear a notice to the effect that it is not to be left open.

Query_Text_cn: 这类门或舱盖的使用应经值班驾驶员批准。
Translation: The use of such doors or hatches shall be approved by the officer on watch.

Query_Text_cn: 4可以装设结构良好的水密门或坡道用作大型货物处所的内部分隔，条件是主管机关确信此种门或坡道是必要的。
Translation: 4 Watertight doors or ramps with sound construction may be installed as internal subdivisions within large cargo spaces, provided the competent authority is satisfied that such doors or ramps are necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这些门或坡道可以是绞链的，滚动的或滑动的门或坡道，但不应是遥控操纵的。
Translation: These doors or ramps may be hinged, rolling, or sliding, but shall not be remotely operated.

Query_Text_cn: ②此类门或坡道应在开航前关妥，并应在航行中保持关闭；此类门或坡道在港内开启的时间和船舶离港前关闭的时间应记入航海日志中。
Translation: ②Such doors or ramps shall be properly closed before the voyage commences and shall remain closed during navigation; the times of opening such doors or ramps in port and of closing them before the ship leaves the port shall be recorded in the logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何此类门或坡道，则应设有适当装置以防未经授权的开启。
Translation: If it is necessary to pass through any such door or ramp during the voyage, appropriate devices shall be provided to prevent unauthorized opening.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证内部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: 5 To ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings, other closing devices that remain permanently closed at sea shall bear a notice stating that they must be kept closed.

Query_Text_cn: 用螺栓紧固盖子的人孔不必设此通告牌。
Translation: A caution sign is not required for manholes with bolted covers.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MSC/Circ.919通函《破损控制图指南》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.919, the Guidelines for Damage Control Plans.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: ② Refer to MSC/Circ.651, "Interpretation of SOLAS Chapter II-1, Part B-1 Regulations."

Query_Text_cn: 1所有通向在破损分析中假定为完整的且位于最终水线以下的舱室的外部开口，应要求水密。
Translation: 1 All external openings leading to compartments assumed intact in the damage analysis and located below the final waterline shall be required to be watertight.

Query_Text_cn: 2根据本条1要求水密的外部开口应有足够的强度，除货舱盖外，在驾驶室应设有指示器。
Translation: 2 External openings required to be watertight by paragraph 1 shall be of sufficient strength. Except for cargo hatch covers, indicators shall be provided in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 3在限制垂向破损范围的甲板以下的船壳外板上的开口，在海上应保持永久关闭。
Translation: 3 Openings in the shell plating below the deck limiting the vertical extent of damage shall be kept permanently closed at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何这类开口，则应设有适当装置以防未经受授权的开启。
Translation: If it is necessary to pass through any such openings during the voyage, appropriate devices shall be provided to prevent unauthorized opening.

Query_Text_cn: 4尽管有本条3的要求，如为了船舶的操纵需要并且不损害船舶的安全，主管机关仍可授权船长根据需要打开某些特殊的门。
Translation: 4 Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 3, the Administration may authorize the master to open any specific doors for operational necessities as required, provided that the safety of the ship is not impaired.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证外部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: 5 To ensure the watertight integrity of external openings, other closing devices that remain permanently closed at sea shall bear a notice indicating that they must be kept closed.

Query_Text_cn: 1机器、锅炉和其他受压容器、有关的管系和附件，其设计和构造应适合于它们的用途；并在充分考虑到运动部件、热表面和其他危险的情况下，其安装和保护应使其对船上人员伤害的危险性降至最低程度。
Translation: 1. Machinery, boilers and other pressure vessels, associated piping systems and fittings shall be of a design and construction adequate for the service for which they are intended and shall be so installed and protected as to reduce to a minimum any danger to persons on board, due regard being paid to moving parts, hot surfaces and other hazards.

Query_Text_cn: 其设计应考虑到结构所用的材料、设备用途以及可能遇到的工作条件和船上环境条件。
Translation: The design shall take into account the materials used for the structure, the intended purpose of the equipment, and the potential working conditions as well as the environmental conditions onboard.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应特别注意单个重要推进部件的可靠性；而且可以要求设有一个独立推进动力源，足以使船舶保持一个可航行速度，特别是在非常规布置的情况下。
Translation: The competent authority shall pay special attention to the reliability of individual essential propulsion components and may require an independent propulsion power source capable of maintaining a navigable speed for the vessel, particularly in cases of unconventional arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 3应设有措施，在任一重要辅机不能工作时，使推进机械的正常运转能够维持或恢复。
Translation: 3 Measures shall be provided to ensure that the normal operation of the propulsion machinery can be maintained or restored when any essential auxiliary machinery is inoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 10主推进装置（包括可调螺距螺旋桨）的液压、气动或电气的控制装置。
Translation: 10 Main propulsion machinery (including controllable pitch propellers) hydraulic, pneumatic or electrical control devices.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，当主管机关对整体安全性作考虑后，可以接受将正常运行的推进能力作部分降低。
Translation: However, when the competent authority takes overall safety into consideration, it may accept a partial reduction in propulsion capability during normal operation.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见MSC/Circ.834通函《机舱的设置、设计和布置指南》。
Translation: ①Refer to MSC/Circ.834, the "Guidelines for the Installation, Design and Layout of Engine Rooms."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.647通函《关于最大限度减少可燃液体系统泄漏的指南》，该通函经MSC/Circ.851通函《关于机舱燃油系统的指南》补充。
Translation: ② Refer to MSC/Circ.647, "Guidelines for the Minimization of Leakages from Flammable Liquid Systems," as supplemented by MSC/Circ.851, "Guidelines for Fuel Oil Systems in Machinery Spaces."

Query_Text_cn: 4应设有措施保证在没有外来帮助的情况下能使机器从瘫船状态运转起来。
Translation: 4 Measures shall be provided to ensure that the machinery can be operated from a dead ship condition without external assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 5所有锅炉、机器的所有部件，所有蒸汽、液压、气动和其他系统，以及有关的承受内部压力的附件，在首次投入使用前，应经受包括压力试验在内的相应试验。
Translation: All boilers, all parts of machinery, all steam, hydraulic, pneumatic and other systems, and associated fittings subject to internal pressure shall be subjected to appropriate tests, including pressure tests, before being put into service for the first time.

Query_Text_cn: 6主推进装置和船舶推进与安全必需的所有辅机，均应设计成安装于船上后，在船舶正浮时以及向任一舷横倾至15°和向任一舷横摇至22.5°，并同时首或尾纵摇7.5°时能正常工作。
Translation: The main propulsion machinery and all auxiliary machinery essential to the propulsion and safety of the ship shall be designed to operate normally when the ship is upright and when inclined at any angle of list up to 15° or when rolling up to 22.5° on either side, combined with a simultaneous pitching motion of 7.5° at bow or stern.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到船舶的类型、尺度和营运条件，主管机关可允许偏离这些角度。
Translation: Taking into account the type, size and operational conditions of the vessel, the competent authority may permit deviations from these angles.

Query_Text_cn: 7应有便于对主推进装置和辅机，包括锅炉和受压容器，进行清洁、检查和维修保养的措施。
Translation: There shall be measures facilitating the cleaning, inspection, and maintenance of the main propulsion plant and auxiliary machinery, including boilers and pressure vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 8应特别注意推进装置系统的设计、构造和安装，以使在正常运转范围内机器的任何振动模态不会引起其过度的应力。
Translation: Particular attention shall be paid to the design, construction and installation of the propulsion system to ensure that no vibration mode of the machinery within the normal operating range induces excessive stress.

Query_Text_cn: 9管系中的非金属膨胀接头如安装于贯穿船侧的管系中，且贯穿位置和非金属膨胀接头均位于最深载重线以下，则应作为按第I/10(a)条规定检验的一部分进行检查，并在必要时或按制造商建议的间隔期予以更换。
Translation: Non-metallic expansion joints in piping systems, where installed in pipes penetrating the ship's side and where both the penetration and the non-metallic expansion joint are located below the deepest load waterline, shall be examined as part of the survey required by regulation I/10(a) and renewed when necessary or at the manufacturer's recommended replacement intervals.

Query_Text_cn: 10操作和保养须知以及保证船舶机器和设备安全操作的图纸文件应用高级船员和船员明白的语言文字书写，以使其在执行自已的职责时能够看懂这些资料。
Translation: 10. Operating and maintenance instructions, as well as drawings and documents ensuring the safe operation of ship machinery and equipment, shall be written in a language understood by officers and crew members to enable them to comprehend such materials while performing their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 11用于燃油舱、沉淀柜及润滑油舱的透气管的安装和布置应使透气管在破损时不会直接导致海水或雨水溅入。
Translation: 11 The installation and arrangement of vent pipes for fuel oil tanks, settling tanks, and lubricating oil tanks shall be such that in the event of damage, seawater or rainwater cannot directly splash into the vent pipes.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘新建船舶应对推进及主系统必需的每一种燃油配备两个燃油柜或等效布置，其容量必须至少能供船舶推进装置在最大持续功率下，以及发电机装置在海上正常负荷下工作8h。
Translation: Every new ship shall be provided with two fuel oil service tanks for each type of fuel oil required for propulsion and essential systems, or equivalent arrangements, of sufficient capacity to enable the ship to operate at maximum continuous power for propulsion and at normal sea load for the generating plant for not less than 8 hours.

Query_Text_cn: ①本节规定只适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船舶。
Translation: ①The provisions of this section shall apply only to ships constructed on or after 1 July 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 1当机器存在超速的危险时，应有措施以保证不超过安全速度。
Translation: 1When there is a risk of the machine exceeding safe speeds, measures shall be in place to ensure it does not surpass the safety limit.

Query_Text_cn: 2当主机或辅机（包括受压容器或这类机器的任何部件）经受内部压力并可能受到危险的超压时，应有措施切实防止这种过度的压力。
Translation: 2When the main or auxiliary machinery (including pressure vessels or any components of such machinery) is subjected to internal pressure and may be exposed to dangerous overpressure, effective measures shall be taken to prevent such excessive pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 3对船舶推进、船舶安全或船上人员安全必要的机器，其动力传递用的所有齿轮装置和每根轴与每个联轴器的设计和构造应能承受一切运行情况下可能产生的最大工作应力，并应适当考虑到驱动它们的或由它们作为组成部分的机器的型式。
Translation: All gear units for power transmission and each shaft and coupling essential for ship propulsion, ship safety, or personnel safety shall be designed and constructed to withstand the maximum working stresses likely to occur under all operational conditions, with due consideration given to the type of machinery driving them or of which they form a part.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见SOLAS公约第II-2/4.2条“燃油、润滑油和其他易燃油类的布置”。
Translation: ① Refer to SOLAS Convention Regulation II-2/4.2 "Arrangements for oil fuel, lubricating oil and other flammable oils".

Query_Text_cn: 4缸径为200mm或曲柄箱容积为0.6m3及以上的内燃机，应设有适当型式和足够释压面积的曲柄箱防爆安全阀。
Translation: Internal combustion engines with a cylinder bore of 200mm or more, or a crankcase volume of 0.6m³ or above, shall be equipped with crankcase explosion relief valves of appropriate type and sufficient venting area.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的布置或提供的措施，应保证阀排出的气体对人员伤害的可能性降至最低程度。
Translation: The arrangement or provision of safety valves shall ensure that the possibility of harm to personnel from discharged gases is minimized.

Query_Text_cn: 5主涡轮推进机械和（如适用时）主内燃推进机械及辅机，应设有发生诸如滑油供应故障等可能导致机器的迅速破坏、严重损伤或爆炸的故障时能自动停车的装置。
Translation: 5. The main turbine propulsion machinery and, where applicable, the main internal combustion propulsion machinery and auxiliary machinery shall be provided with automatic shutdown devices in the event of faults such as failure of lubricating oil supply that may lead to rapid damage, serious injury, or explosion of the machinery.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关可允许采用自动停车装置的越控装置。
Translation: The competent authority may permit override devices for automatic parking systems.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶应具有足够的后退动力，以保证在所有正常情况下均能控制船舶。
Translation: 1. Ships shall have sufficient power for going astern to ensure proper control of the vessel under all normal circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2对机器在足够的时间内使推进器换向，并在合理的距离内使船舶从最大营运前进航速到停止的能力应进行验证并记录。
Translation: The ability of the machinery to reverse the propulsion within sufficient time and bring the ship to a stop from maximum ahead service speed within a reasonable distance shall be verified and recorded.

Query_Text_cn: 3对航行试验记录的停船时间、船首航向和距离，连同多螺旋桨船舶在一个或几个螺旋桨不工作的情况下所进行的航行和操纵以测定其能力的试验结果应备于船上供船长或指定的人员随时可用。
Translation: The stopping time, heading, and distance recorded in the maneuvering trials, along with the results of trials conducted to determine the maneuvering capabilities of multi-propeller vessels with one or more propellers inoperative, shall be readily available on board for the master or designated personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 4如船舶设有操纵或停船的补充措施，则应按本条2和3的要求，对这些措施的有效性进行验证并记录。
Translation: 4 If the ship is equipped with supplementary measures for maneuvering or stopping, the effectiveness of these measures shall be verified and recorded in accordance with the requirements of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定外，每艘船舶应配备使主管机关满意的主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置。
Translation: 1 Except where expressly provided otherwise, every ship shall be provided with a main steering gear and an auxiliary steering gear to the satisfaction of the Administration.

Query_Text_cn: 主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置的布置应使两者中之一在发生故障时，不会导致另一装置不能工作。
Translation: The main and auxiliary steering gear shall be so arranged that the failure of one will not render the other inoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1所有操舵装置的部件和舵杆应为主管机关满意的坚固和可靠的构造。
Translation: 2.1 All components of the steering gear and the rudder stock shall be of a sound and reliable construction to the satisfaction of the Administration.

Query_Text_cn: 对于非双套的必要部件的适用性应特别注意。
Translation: Special attention should be paid to the applicability of non-duplicated essential components.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这类必要部件，如合适时，应采用耐磨轴承，如球轴承、滚子轴承或者能持久润滑或设有润滑装置的套筒轴承。
Translation: Any such necessary components shall, where appropriate, incorporate wear-resistant bearings such as ball bearings, roller bearings, or sleeve bearings that are either permanently lubricated or equipped with lubrication devices.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2对于承受内部液压的管系和其他操舵装置的部件，确定其尺寸计算所用的设计压力应至少为本条3.2所指运行状况下可能出现的最大工作压力的1.25倍，同时应考虑在该系统低压一侧可能存在的压力。
Translation: 2.2 For piping systems and other components of steering gear subjected to internal hydraulic pressure, the design pressure used for determining their dimensions shall be at least 1.25 times the maximum working pressure that may occur under the operating conditions specified in paragraph 3.2 of this section, while also taking into account any pressure that may exist on the low-pressure side of the system.

Query_Text_cn: 根据主管机关的意见，管系和部件的设计应采用疲劳衡准，同时考虑动力负荷所产生的脉动压力。
Translation: According to the competent authority's opinion, the design of piping systems and components shall adopt fatigue criteria, taking into account the pulsating pressure generated by dynamic loads.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《关于操纵资料在船上存放和显示的建议》(A.601(15)决议)、《船舶操纵性标准》(MSC.137(76)决议)和《船舶操纵性标准的解释性说明》(MSC/Circ.1053通函)。
Translation: ① Refer to the "Recommendation on the Storage and Display of Maneuvering Information on Board Ships" (Resolution A.601(15)), "Standards for Ship Maneuverability" (Resolution MSC.137(76)), and "Explanatory Notes to the Standards for Ship Maneuverability" (MSC/Circ.1053).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.415(XI)决议《关于改进的客货船操舵装置标准》和A.416(XI)决议《关于现有液货船操舵装置的检查》。
Translation: ② Refer to Resolution A.415(XI) "Standards for Improved Steering Gear for Passenger and Cargo Ships" and Resolution A.416(XI) "Inspection of Steering Gear on Existing Tankers."

Query_Text_cn: 2.3凡在液压系统中能被隔断的和由于动力源或外力作用能产生压力的任何部件，应设置安全阀。
Translation: 2.3 Any component within a hydraulic system that can be isolated and is capable of generating pressure due to power sources or external forces shall be equipped with a safety valve.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的调定应不超过设计压力。
Translation: The safety valve setting shall not exceed the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀应有足够尺寸并布置成能够避免过度升高的压力超过设计压力。
Translation: Safety valves shall be of adequate size and arranged to prevent the pressure from rising more than 10% above the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 4设计成在最大后退航速时不致损坏；但是这个设计要求不需要用最大后退航速和最大舵角的试航来验证。
Translation: 4 It shall be designed to prevent damage at maximum astern speed; however, this design requirement does not need to be verified by sea trials at maximum astern speed with maximum rudder angle.

Query_Text_cn: 3动力操纵，以必要时满足本条4.2的要求，以及在任何情况下主管机关要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm时（不包括冰区加强）的要求。
Translation: 3 Power operation shall meet the requirements of paragraph 4.2 of this article when necessary, as well as the requirements under any circumstances where the competent authority mandates that the diameter of the rudder stock at the tiller exceeds 230 mm (excluding ice-strengthening).

Query_Text_cn: 2能从驾驶室某一位置投入工作。
Translation: 2. Can be deployed to work from any position in the cockpit.

Query_Text_cn: 操舵装置的任何一台动力设备失电时，应在驾驶室里发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: An audible and visual alarm shall be activated in the wheelhouse upon loss of power to any steering gear power unit.

Query_Text_cn: 3主操舵装置布置成当其管系或1台动力设备发生单项故障时，此故障能被隔离，使操舵能力能够保持或迅速恢复。
Translation: The main steering gear shall be so arranged that in the event of a single failure in its piping system or one of its power units, the defect can be isolated to enable steering capability to be maintained or promptly restored.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2直至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可以接受设置经证实具有可靠性记录但不符合本条6.1.3对液压系统要求的操舵装置。
Translation: 6.2 Until September 1, 1986, the competent authority may accept steering gear installations that have a proven record of reliability but do not comply with the hydraulic system requirements specified in paragraph 6.1.3 of this section.

Query_Text_cn: 6.3非液压型式的操舵装置应达到等效的标准，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: 6.3 Non-hydraulic steering gear shall meet equivalent standards to the satisfaction of the Administration.

Query_Text_cn: 但不必设置两套操舵手轮或操舵手柄。
Translation: However, it is not necessary to install two sets of steering wheels or steering handles.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于位于舵机舱的辅助操舵装置，如系动力操纵，也应能在驾驶室进行操作，并应独立于主操舵装置的控制系统。
Translation: 3 For auxiliary steering gear located in the steering gear compartment, if power-operated, it shall also be operable from the navigation bridge and be independent of the control system for the main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 5应仅对操舵装置控制供电线路设有短路保护。
Translation: 5 Short-circuit protection shall be provided solely for the power supply circuits of the steering gear control system.

Query_Text_cn: 9本条和第30条要求的电力线路和操舵装置系统以及相关的部件、电缆和管子应在它们的整个长度范围内尽可能地分离。
Translation: The electrical circuits and steering gear systems required by this Article and Article 30, along with their associated components, cables, and pipes, shall be separated as far as practicable throughout their entire length.

Query_Text_cn: 10驾驶室与舵机舱之间应设有通信设施。
Translation: 10. Communication facilities shall be provided between the wheelhouse and the steering gear room.

Query_Text_cn: 1当主操舵装置系动力操纵时，在驾驶室显示。
Translation: 1 When the main steering gear is power-operated, it shall be displayed in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 2能在舵机舱内辨认出来。
Translation: 2 Can be identified within the servo compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 2每个液体贮存器设低位警报器，以便确切和尽早地指示液体泄漏。
Translation: Each liquid storage tank shall be equipped with a low-level alarm to accurately and promptly indicate liquid leakage.

Query_Text_cn: 3当主操舵装置要求动力操纵时，设置一个固定储存柜，其容量足以至少为一个动力执行系统(包括贮存器)进行再充液。
Translation: When the main steering gear requires power operation, a fixed storage tank shall be provided with sufficient capacity to recharge at least one power actuating system (including the reservoir).

Query_Text_cn: 储存柜应用管系固定联结以使能从舵机舱内容易地再次为液压系统充液，并应设有液位指示器。
Translation: The locker application piping system shall be securely connected to allow easy recharging of the hydraulic system from within the steering gear compartment, and shall be equipped with a liquid level indicator.

Query_Text_cn: 2有适当的布置以保证有到达操舵装置和控制器的工作通道。
Translation: 2. There shall be proper arrangements to ensure a working passage to the steering gear and controls.

Query_Text_cn: 这些布置应包括扶手栏杆和格子板或其他防滑地板以保证液体泄漏时有适宜的工作条件。
Translation: These arrangements shall include handrails, grating plates, or other non-slip flooring to ensure proper working conditions in the event of liquid leakage.

Query_Text_cn: 14如果要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm（不包括冰区加强），应设有由应急电源或位于舵机舱内的独立动力源在45s内自动供电的替代动力源，其容量至少满足供应符合本条4.2要求的操舵装置动力设备及其有关的控制系统和舵角指示器。
Translation: 14 If the diameter of the rudder stock at the tiller is required to exceed 230 mm (excluding ice strengthening), an alternative power source shall be provided that is automatically supplied within 45 seconds from either the emergency power source or an independent power source located in the steering gear compartment. This source must have sufficient capacity to supply the steering gear power unit meeting the requirements of paragraph 4.2 of this regulation, along with its associated control system and rudder angle indicator.

Query_Text_cn: 此独立动力源应只用于上述目的。
Translation: This independent power source shall be used solely for the aforementioned purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘10,000总吨及以上的船舶，替代动力源应具有至少连续运转30min的能力，在任何其他船舶上则至少为10min。
Translation: For each ship of 10,000 gross tonnage and above, the alternative power source shall be capable of operating continuously for at least 30 minutes, while on any other ship, it shall be at least 10 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 1510,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船和70,000总吨及以上的每艘其他船舶，主操舵装置应由符合本条6规定的两台或两台以上相同的动力设备组成。
Translation: For every oil tanker, chemical tanker, or gas carrier of 10,000 gross tonnage and above, and every other ship of 70,000 gross tonnage and above, the main steering gear shall consist of two or more identical power units complying with the provisions of paragraph 6 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2至少两个相同的动力执行系统，在正常运转中同时工作时，应能满足本条3.2的要求。
Translation: 2.2 At least two identical power actuation systems, when operating simultaneously under normal conditions, shall meet the requirements specified in section 3.2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 当需要符合此要求时，液压动力执行系统应设有交叉联结。
Translation: When required to meet this specification, the hydraulic power actuation system shall be equipped with cross-connections.

Query_Text_cn: 一个系统中液体的流失应能发现，有缺陷的系统应能自动隔离，以使另一个或几个执行系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: The loss of liquid in a system should be detectable, and any defective system must be automatically isolated to ensure that one or more operational systems can maintain full functionality.

Query_Text_cn: 3非液压型式的操舵装置应能达到等效标准。
Translation: Non-hydraulic steering gear shall meet equivalent standards.

Query_Text_cn: 2如果操舵装置只包括单个舵执行器，则应特别注意在设计中对所使用的材料、密封装置的安装、试验检查和有效维护的要求进行包括疲劳分析和断裂力学分析（如适用）在内的应力分析。
Translation: 2 If the steering gear consists of a single rudder actuator, special attention shall be paid to conducting stress analysis—including fatigue analysis and fracture mechanics analysis (where applicable)—on the design requirements for materials used, installation of sealing devices, testing inspections, and effective maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 在考虑上述情况时，主管机关应采用包括本组织通过的《10,000总吨及以上但小于100,000载重吨的油船、化学品船和气体运输船非双套舵执行器验收指南》的各项规定。
Translation: In considering the above circumstances, the competent authority shall apply the provisions including those of the Guidelines for the Acceptance of Non-Duplicated Rudder Actuators for Oil Tankers, Chemical Tankers and Gas Carriers of 10,000 Gross Tonnage and Above but Less Than 100,000 Deadweight Tonnage adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 18对于10,000总吨及以上但小于70,000载重吨的油船、化学品船或气体运输船，至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可接受具有可靠性记录但不符合本条16中对液压系统要求的单项故障衡准的操舵装置系统。
Translation: For oil tankers, chemical tankers, or gas carriers of 10,000 gross tonnage and above but less than 70,000 deadweight tons, the Administration may accept a steering gear system with a proven reliability record that does not comply with the single failure criterion for hydraulic systems specified in paragraph 16 of this regulation, until September 1, 1986.

Query_Text_cn: 2应设有两个独立操舵装置控制系统，每个系统均能从驾驶室操作。
Translation: 2 Two independent steering gear control systems shall be provided, each operable from the navigating bridge.

Query_Text_cn: 4每个操舵装置控制系统，如系电动者，应由操舵装置电力线路设独立电路供电，或从向操舵装置电力线路供电的电路板上邻近该电力线路处的一点直接供电。
Translation: 4 Each steering gear control system, if electrically operated, shall be supplied by an independent circuit from the steering gear power circuit or directly from the switchboard adjacent to the steering gear power circuit at a point adjacent to that power supply.

Query_Text_cn: 20除本条19的要求外，1984年9月1日以前建造的40,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船，其操舵装置应在不迟于1988年9月1日布置成当管系或其中1台动力设备发生单项故障时，能够保持操舵能力，或舵的运动能加以限制，以使操舵能力迅速重新获得。
Translation: In addition to the requirements of Regulation 19, every oil tanker, chemical tanker, or gas carrier of 40,000 gross tonnage and above constructed before September 1, 1984, shall have its steering gear arranged no later than September 1, 1988, so that steering capability is maintained or the movement of the rudder is restricted to enable prompt restoration of steering capability in the event of a single failure in the piping system or in one of the power units.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织通过的A.467(XII)决议。
Translation: Resolution A.467(XII) adopted by this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3如各液压动力系统是交叉联结的，则应作适当布置以保证一个系统中液体的流失能被发现，有缺陷的系统能自动地或从驾驶室加以隔离，以使其他系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: If the hydraulic power systems are interconnected, appropriate arrangements shall be made to ensure that fluid loss in one system can be detected, and the defective system can be automatically isolated or isolated from the wheelhouse, so that the other systems can remain fully operational.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于电动和电动液压操舵装置，应在驾驶室和适当的主机控制位置装设指示其电动机正在运转的设备。
Translation: 1 For electric and electro-hydraulic steering gear, equipment indicating that their motors are in operation shall be installed in the wheelhouse and at an appropriate main machinery control location.

Query_Text_cn: 2由1台或几台动力设备组成的每一电动或电动液压操舵装置至少应由两个自主配电板直接供电的专用电路来供电；但是，其中之一可以由应急配电板供电。
Translation: Each electric or electro-hydraulic steering gear composed of one or several power units shall be supplied by at least two dedicated circuits fed directly from separate switchboards; however, one of these circuits may be supplied from the emergency switchboard.

Query_Text_cn: 与电动或电动液压主操舵装置相联系的电动或电动液压辅助操舵装置可与向此主操舵装置供电的电路之一连接。
Translation: The electric or electro-hydraulic auxiliary steering gear connected to the electric or electro-hydraulic main steering gear may be connected to one of the circuits supplying this main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 向电动或电动液压操舵装置供电的电路应有足够容量，以便能同时向与它连接且可能需要同时工作的所有电动机供电。
Translation: The circuit supplying power to electric or electro-hydraulic steering gear shall have sufficient capacity to simultaneously supply all motors connected to it that may be required to operate concurrently.

Query_Text_cn: 3这类电路和电动机应设有短路保护和过载报警装置。
Translation: Such circuits and motors shall be provided with short-circuit protection and overload alarm devices.

Query_Text_cn: 包括起动电流在内的过电流保护装置（如有时），应不小于所保护电路或电动机全负荷电流的两倍，并应布置成能允许适当的起动电流通过。
Translation: The overcurrent protective device, including starting current (where applicable), shall be not less than twice the full-load current of the circuit or motor it protects and shall be arranged to permit the passage of appropriate starting current.

Query_Text_cn: 如采用三相供电，应设有能指示任一相所发生故障的报警装置。
Translation: If three-phase power supply is adopted, an alarm device capable of indicating any phase failure shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 本节所要求的警报应为听觉和视觉报警，并应位于正常控制主机的主机处所或控制室内明显位置上，并应符合第51条适用的要求。
Translation: The alarms required by this section shall be both audible and visual, and shall be located at a conspicuous position in the main machinery space or control room of the normal control console, complying with the applicable requirements of Article 51.

Query_Text_cn: 4在小于1,600总吨的船上，按第29.4.3条要求为动力操作的辅助操舵装置，如不是电动的或是由原来用作其他用途的电动机来驱动的，则主操舵装置可由来自主配电板的一个电路供电。
Translation: 4 On ships of less than 1,600 gross tonnage, the main steering gear may be supplied by one circuit from the main switchboard if the power-operated auxiliary steering gear required by regulation 29.4.3 is not electrically driven or is driven by a motor originally intended for other purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类原来用作其他用途的电动机作为这种辅助舵装置的动力时，如主管机关对其保护装置表示满意，并认为其满足适用于辅助操舵装置的第29.5.1条和29.5.2条以及第29.7.3条的要求时，可免除本条3的要求。
Translation: When such electric motors originally intended for other purposes are used as the power source for this auxiliary steering gear, the requirements of paragraph 3 of this regulation may be waived if the Administration is satisfied with their protective devices and deems them to comply with the provisions of regulations 29.5.1, 29.5.2, and 29.7.3 applicable to auxiliary steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 1对船舶推进和安全所必需的主机和辅机应设有有效的操作和控制装置。
Translation: Effective operating and control devices shall be provided for main and auxiliary machinery essential to the propulsion and safety of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 2对每一独立的螺旋桨，应由一个控制装置进行遥控，该控制装置的设计和制造应使其在运行时无需对机器的操作细节予以特别注意。
Translation: Each independent propeller shall be remotely controlled by a control device, which shall be designed and constructed to operate without requiring special attention to the details of machine operation.

Query_Text_cn: 5推进机械在同一个时间内仅能由一处进行遥控；在这些处所可允许有互相连接的控制位置。
Translation: 5. The propulsion machinery shall be remotely controlled from one location at a time; interconnected control positions may be permitted in these locations.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定者外，本章应适用于1998年7月1日或以后安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船舶。
Translation: 1 Unless expressly provided otherwise, this chapter shall apply to ships whose keels are laid or which are at a similar stage of construction on or after 1 July 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly of the vessel has commenced with a minimum quantity of 50 tons, or 1% of the estimated total weight of structural materials, whichever is less.

Query_Text_cn: 3无论何时建造的货船，一经改装为客船后，从开始改装之日应视作客船。
Translation: 3 Any cargo ship, regardless of when it was built, shall be regarded as a passenger ship from the date its conversion begins once it is converted into a passenger ship.

Query_Text_cn: 2确保当此类船舶更换救生设备或装置，或当此类船舶进行涉及到更换或增设其现有救生设备或装置的重大修理、改装或改建时，这些救生设备和装置在合理可行的情况下满足本章要求。
Translation: 2 Ensure that when such vessels replace life-saving appliances or arrangements, or when they undergo major repairs, alterations, or modifications involving the replacement or addition of existing life-saving appliances or arrangements, these appliances and arrangements comply with the requirements of this chapter to the extent reasonably practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果更换的只是除气胀式救生筏外的救生艇筏而不更换其降落设备，或是相反，则救生艇筏或降落设备可与被更换者是相同类型的。
Translation: However, if only the lifeboat or liferaft (excluding inflatable liferafts) is replaced without changing its launching appliance, or vice versa, the replacement lifeboat/liferaft or launching appliance may be of the same type as the one being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关如考虑到航程的遮蔽性及其条件认为实施本章的某些要求为不合理或不必要时，对在航程中距最近陆地不超过20nmile的个别船舶或某些类型的船舶，可免除这些要求。
Translation: 1 The competent authority may exempt individual ships or certain types of ships from these requirements if it considers that, given the sheltered nature and conditions of the voyage, the application of certain provisions of this chapter is unreasonable or unnecessary for ships engaged on voyages not more than 20 nautical miles from the nearest land.

Query_Text_cn: 2《1973年特种业务客船舱室要求议定书》所附的规则。
Translation: 2 The rules annexed to the Protocol of 1973 on Space Requirements for Special Category Passengers.

Query_Text_cn: 1抗暴露服系指设计成供救助艇艇员和海上撤离系统人员使用的保护服。
Translation: 1. An exposure suit refers to a protective garment designed for use by rescue boat crew members and marine evacuation system personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 2持证人员系指持有主管机关按照现行的《国际海员培训、发证和值班标准公约》要求，授权签发的或承认有效的精通救生艇筏业务证书的人员；或持有非该公约缔约国的主管机关为公约证书同一目的而签发或承认的证书的人员。
Translation: 2 Certified personnel refer to those who hold a certificate of proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats issued or recognized as valid by the competent authority in accordance with the current International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers; or those who hold a certificate issued or recognized by the competent authority of a non-party state to the Convention for the same purpose as the Convention certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3探测系指幸存者或救生艇筏位置的测定。
Translation: Detection refers to the determination of the position of survivors or lifeboats and rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 4登乘梯系指设置在救生艇筏登乘站以供安全登入降落下水后的救生艇筏的梯子。
Translation: A boarding ladder refers to a ladder installed at a lifeboat or liferaft embarkation station to facilitate safe boarding of launched survival craft.

Query_Text_cn: 5自由漂浮下水系指救生艇筏从下沉中的船舶自动脱开并立即可用的降落方法。
Translation: Free-floating launching refers to a method of deploying lifeboats or liferafts where they automatically detach from a sinking vessel and become immediately available for use.

Query_Text_cn: 6自由降落下水系指载足全部乘员和属具的救生艇筏在船上脱开并在没有任何制约装置的情况下，任其下降到海面的降落方法。
Translation: A free-fall launching system refers to a method where a lifeboat or liferaft, fully loaded with all occupants and equipment, is released from the vessel and allowed to descend into the sea without any restraining devices.

Query_Text_cn: 7救生服系指减少在冷水中穿着该服人员体热损失的保护服。
Translation: 7 A survival suit refers to protective clothing designed to reduce the loss of body heat for a person wearing it in cold water.

Query_Text_cn: 8气胀式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且在准备使用前通常保持不充气状态的设备。
Translation: 8 An inflatable device refers to equipment that relies on non-rigid inflatable chambers for buoyancy and is typically kept uninflated until ready for use.

Query_Text_cn: 9充气式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且一直保持充气备用状态的设备。
Translation: 9. Inflatable equipment refers to devices that rely on non-rigid inflatable chambers for buoyancy and remain inflated and ready for use at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 10国际救生设备（LSA）规则（本章内称“规则”）系指本组织海上安全委员会MSC.48(66)决议通过的，可由本组织修正的《国际救生设备（LSA）规则》，但这种修正案的通过、生效和实施应按本公约第VIII条有关适用于除第I章外的附则的修正程序的规定进行。
Translation: The International Life-Saving Appliance (LSA) Code (referred to in this chapter as "the Code") means the International Life-Saving Appliance (LSA) Code adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by resolution MSC.48(66), as may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments are adopted, brought into force and take effect in accordance with the provisions of Article VIII of the present Convention concerning the amendment procedures applicable to the annex other than Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 11降落设备或装置系指将救生艇筏或救助艇从其存放位置安全地转移到水上的设施。
Translation: 11 Launching appliance or arrangement means the means of safely transferring a survival craft or rescue boat from its stowed position to the water.

Query_Text_cn: 12长度系指量自龙骨上面的最小型深85%处水线总长的96%，或沿该水线从首柱前缘量至舵杆中心线的长度，取较大者。
Translation: Length means 96% of the total length on a waterline at 85% of the least moulded depth measured from the top of the keel, or the length from the fore side of the stem to the axis of the rudder stock on that waterline, whichever is greater.

Query_Text_cn: 对设计为具有倾斜龙骨的船舶，其计量长度的水线应与设计水线平行。
Translation: For vessels designed with an inclined keel, the waterline used for measuring length shall be parallel to the design waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 13最轻载航行状态系指船舶处于平浮、无货，备品和燃料有10%剩余量的装载状态；对客船而言，船舶处于载足全额乘客和船员及其行李的装载状态。
Translation: 13 The lightest seagoing condition refers to the state where the ship is on an even keel, without cargo, and with 10% remaining stores and fuel; for passenger ships, it means the ship is fully loaded with all passengers, crew, and their luggage.

Query_Text_cn: 14海上撤离系统系指将人员从船舶的登乘甲板迅速转移到漂浮的救生艇筏上的设备。
Translation: A marine evacuation system refers to equipment designed to rapidly transfer persons from a vessel's embarkation deck to floating lifeboats or liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 1型深系指从龙骨上面量到在船舷处的干舷甲板横梁上面的垂直距离。
Translation: Type 1 depth refers to the vertical distance measured from the top of the keel to the top of the freeboard deck beam at the ship's side.

Query_Text_cn: 对木质船舶和混合结构船舶，此垂直距离从龙骨槽口的下缘量起。
Translation: For wooden ships and composite ships, this vertical distance is measured from the lower edge of the keel rabbet.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶中横剖面的下部具有凹形，或如装有厚龙骨翼板，此垂直距离从船底平坦部分向内延伸线与龙骨侧面相交之点量起。
Translation: If the lower part of the midship section has a hollow curve, or if thick garboards are fitted, this vertical distance is measured from the point where the line of the flat bottom extended inwards intersects the side of the keel.

Query_Text_cn: 2具有圆弧形舷边的船舶，型深应量至甲板型线和船舶外板型线相交之点，这些线的延伸是把该舷边看作是设计为角形的。
Translation: For ships with rounded gunwales, the molded depth shall be measured to the point of intersection of the molded deck line and the molded outer shell line, with these lines extended as if the gunwale were designed angular.

Query_Text_cn: 3凡干舷甲板为阶梯形并且其升高部分延伸到超过决定型深的点时，型深应量至甲板较低部分与升高部分平行的延伸线。
Translation: 3 Where the freeboard deck is stepped and the raised part of the deck extends over the point at which the moulded depth is determined, the moulded depth shall be measured to a line of reference extending from the lower part of the deck parallel to the raised part.

Query_Text_cn: 16新颖救生设备或装置系指具有本章或规则之规定未全部包括的新型特征，但达到等效的或更高的安全标准的救生设备或装置。
Translation: 16. Novel life-saving appliances or arrangements refer to those with new features not fully covered by the provisions of this chapter or the rules, but which meet equivalent or higher safety standards.

Query_Text_cn: 17正稳性系指艇筏在移去一横倾力矩后回复到其初始位置的能力。
Translation: 17 Positive stability refers to the ability of a lifeboat or liferaft to return to its initial position after the removal of a heeling moment.

Query_Text_cn: 18救助艇的回收时间系指该艇被提升至某一位置，而使艇上人员可从该处登上大船甲板所需的时间。
Translation: The recovery time of the 18 rescue boat refers to the time required for the boat to be hoisted to a position where its personnel can board the main vessel's deck.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间包括在救助艇上做的回收准备工作所需的时间，诸如抛投和系住首缆，连接救助艇与降落设备，以及提升救助艇的时间。
Translation: The recovery time includes the duration required for preparatory actions on the rescue boat, such as deploying and securing the painter, connecting the rescue boat to the launching appliance, and hoisting the rescue boat.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间不包括把降落设备降低至回收救助艇的位置所需要的时间。
Translation: Recovery time does not include the duration required to lower the retrieval equipment to the position of the recovery lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 19救助艇系指为救助遇险人员及集结救生艇筏而设计的艇。
Translation: A rescue boat refers to a craft specifically designed for rescuing distressed persons and assembling lifeboats or liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 20拯救系指安全寻回幸存者。
Translation: 20 Rescue refers to the safe retrieval of survivors.

Query_Text_cn: 21客滚船系指具有第II-2/3条定义的滚装装货处所或特种处所的客船。
Translation: Passenger ro-ro ship means a passenger ship with ro-ro cargo spaces or special category spaces as defined in regulation II-2/3.

Query_Text_cn: 22短程国际航行系指在航行中，船舶距离能够安全安置乘客和船员的港口或地点不超过200nmile的国际航行。
Translation: 22 Short international voyages refer to international voyages during which the ship is not more than 200 nautical miles from a port or place where passengers and crew can be safely accommodated.

Query_Text_cn: 启航国最后停靠港至最终目的港之间距离与返航航程均应不超过600nmile。
Translation: The distance between the last port of call in the Qihang country and the final destination port, as well as the return voyage, shall not exceed 600 nautical miles.

Query_Text_cn: 最终目的港系指船舶开始返航回到启航国前的计划航次中的最后停靠港。
Translation: The final port of destination refers to the last planned port of call in the voyage before the vessel commences its return journey to the country of departure.

Query_Text_cn: 23救生艇筏系指从弃船时起能维持遇险人员生命的艇筏。
Translation: 23 Life-saving craft refers to any boat or raft capable of sustaining the lives of distressed persons from the moment of abandoning ship.

Query_Text_cn: 24保温用具系指采用低导热率的防水材料制成的袋子或衣服。
Translation: 24 Thermal protective aids are bags or suits made of waterproof materials with low thermal conductivity.

Query_Text_cn: 1除按照本条5和6的规定外，本章所规定的救生设备和装置应经主管机关认可。
Translation: 1 Except as provided in paragraphs 5 and 6 of this regulation, the life-saving appliances and arrangements required by this chapter shall be approved by the Administration.

Query_Text_cn: 2业已成功地经受的试验实质上等效于该项建议所规定的试验，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: The test already successfully undergone is substantially equivalent to that specified in the recommendation and is satisfactory to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2业已成功地经受实质上等效于该项建议的鉴定和试验，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: 2 has successfully undergone evaluation and testing that is substantially equivalent to the proposed recommendation and has satisfied the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 4主管机关所采用的认可程序还应包括继续认可或撤消认可的条件。
Translation: The recognition procedures adopted by the competent authorities shall also include conditions for continued recognition or withdrawal of recognition.

Query_Text_cn: 5在接受主管机关原先未予认可的救生设备和装置之前，主管机管应确信该救生设备和装置符合本章和规则的要求。
Translation: Before accepting any life-saving appliances or arrangements that were not previously approved by the competent authority, the authority shall ensure that such appliances or arrangements comply with the requirements of this chapter and the regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 6本章所要求的救生设备，如其详细的技术规定未列入规则，应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The lifesaving equipment required by this chapter, for which detailed technical specifications are not provided in the rules, shall be to the satisfaction of the Administration.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应要求救生设备必经必要的生产试验，以确保救生设备是按已认可的原型设备的同一标准进行制造。
Translation: The competent authority shall require that life-saving equipment undergo necessary production tests to ensure it is manufactured to the same standards as the approved prototype equipment.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.689(17)决议通过的《关于救生设备试验的建议案》。
Translation: ① See the "Recommendations for Testing Life-Saving Appliances" adopted by Resolution A.689(17) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 对1999年7月1日或以后安装在船上的救生设备，参见海上安全委员会MSC.81(70)决议通过的《经修订的关于救生设备试验的建议案》。
Translation: For life-saving appliances installed on ships on or after 1 July 1999, refer to the Revised Recommendation on Testing of Life-Saving Appliances adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee by resolution MSC.81(70).

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.520(13)决议通过的《原型新颖救生设备和装置的鉴定、试验及验收实施规则》。
Translation: Refer to the Code of Practice for the Evaluation,Testing and Acceptance of Prototype Novel Life-Saving Appliances and Arrangements adopted by Assembly resolution A.520(13).

Query_Text_cn: 1本条2适用于所有客船和300总吨及以上的所有货船。
Translation: 1 This regulation applies to all passenger ships and all cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and above.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1.1每艘客船和每艘500总吨及以上的货船，应至少配备3台双向甚高频（VHF）无线电话设备。
Translation: 2.1.1 Every passenger ship and every cargo ship of 500 gross tonnage and upwards shall be provided with at least three two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatuses.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘300总吨及以上，但小于500总吨的货船，应至少配备2台双向VHF无线电话设备。
Translation: Every cargo ship of 300 gross tonnage and above but less than 500 gross tonnage shall be provided with at least two two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus.

Query_Text_cn: 该设备所符合的性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: The performance standards to which the equipment conforms should not be inferior to the performance standards adopted by the Organization①.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在救生艇筏上装有固定式双向VHF无线电话设备，其所符合的性能标准也应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: If a fixed two-way VHF radiotelephone installation is provided on survival craft, its performance standards shall be at least equivalent to those adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1.21992年2月1日以前在船上配备的，且不完全符合本组织通过的性能标准的双向VHF无线电话设备，只要主管机关确信它们同经认可的双向VHF无线电话设备相容，在1999年2月1日前仍可被主管机关接受。
Translation: 2.1.2 Two-way VHF radiotelephone equipment installed on board ships before 1 February 1992 that does not fully comply with the performance standards adopted by the Organization may be accepted by the Administration until 1 February 1999, provided the Administration is satisfied that it is compatible with approved two-way VHF radiotelephone equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘客船和每艘500总吨及以上的货船，每舷应至少配有1台雷达应答器。
Translation: Every passenger ship and every cargo ship of 500 gross tonnage and upwards shall be provided with at least one radar transponder on each side.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘300总吨及以上，但小于500总吨的货船应至少配有1台雷达应答器。
Translation: Every cargo ship of 300 gross tonnage and above but less than 500 gross tonnage shall be provided with at least one radar transponder.

Query_Text_cn: 该雷达应答器所符合的性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准②。
Translation: The performance standards of the radar transponder shall not be inferior to those adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 雷达应答器③应存放在能迅速放入任何救生艇筏的位置处（第31.1.4条要求的救生筏除外）。
Translation: Radar transponders shall be stowed in a location where they can be rapidly placed in any survival craft (except for the liferaft required by regulation 31.1.4).

Query_Text_cn: 或者，应在每一救生艇筏上存放1台雷达应答器（第31.1.4条要求的救生艇筏除外）。
Translation: Alternatively, one radar transponder shall be stowed on each lifeboat or liferaft (except for those lifeboats or liferafts required by regulation 31.1.4).

Query_Text_cn: 在至少配有2台雷达应答器以及配备自由降落救生艇的船上，其中的一台雷达应答器应存放在一艘自由降落救生艇内，另一台存放在紧邻驾驶室之处，以便能在船上使用，并能便于转移至任一其他救生艇筏上。
Translation: On ships equipped with at least two radar transponders and free-fall lifeboats, one radar transponder shall be stowed in a free-fall lifeboat, and the other shall be kept near the navigating bridge for use on board and for ready transfer to any other life raft or lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 应配备不少于12支符合规则3.1要求的火箭降落伞火焰信号，并应存放在驾驶室或其附近。
Translation: No fewer than 12 rocket parachute flares complying with the requirements of Rule 3.1 shall be provided and stowed on the navigating bridge or in its vicinity.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.809(19)决议通过的，可能经修正的《救生艇筏双向甚高频（VHF）无线电话设备性能标准》附件1或附件2的适用者。
Translation: ① Refer to Annex 1 or Annex 2 of the "Performance Standards for Survival Craft Two-Way VHF Radiotelephone Equipment" adopted by the organization's Resolution A.809(19), or the applicable one as may be amended.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织A.802(19)决议通过的，可能经修正的《供搜救作业使用的救生艇筏雷达应答器性能标准》。
Translation: ② Refer to the Performance Standards for Survival Craft Radar Transponders for Use in Search and Rescue Operations, adopted by the Organization's resolution A.802(19), as may be amended.

Query_Text_cn: ③这些雷达应答器其中之一可以是第IV/7.1.3条所要求的雷达应答器。
Translation: ③ One of these radar transponders may be the radar transponder required by regulation IV/7.1.3.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1应配备1套固定式或手提式设备构成的或由这两种型式构成的应急设施，供船上应急控制站、集合站和登乘站及要害位置之间的双向通信联系使用。
Translation: 4.1 At least one set of emergency facilities, consisting of fixed or portable equipment or a combination thereof, shall be provided for two-way communication between emergency control stations, assembly stations, embarkation stations, and critical locations on board.

Query_Text_cn: 4.2应配备符合规则7.2.1要求的通用应急报警系统，以供召集乘客与船员至集合站和采取应变部署表所列行动之用。
Translation: 4.2 A general emergency alarm system complying with the requirements of Regulation 7.2.1 shall be provided for summoning passengers and crew to assembly stations and initiating the actions specified in the muster list.

Query_Text_cn: 该系统应以符合规则7.2.2要求的公共广播系统或其他适宜的通信设施作为补充。
Translation: The system shall be supplemented by a public address system or other suitable communication facilities that comply with the requirements of Rule 7.2.2.

Query_Text_cn: 当通用应急报警系统启动时，娱乐声响系统应自动关闭。
Translation: When the general emergency alarm system is activated, the entertainment sound system shall automatically shut down.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3客船通用应急报警系统应在所有开敞甲板上都能听到。
Translation: 4.3 The general emergency alarm system for passenger ships shall be audible on all open decks.

Query_Text_cn: 4.4配备海上撤离系统的船舶应确保登乘站和平台或救生艇筏之间的通信联络。
Translation: 4.4 Ships equipped with marine evacuation systems shall ensure communication between the embarkation station and the platform or life-saving craft.

Query_Text_cn: 5.1除第II-2/40.5①或II-2/41-2条①（视何者适用）及本条4.2的要求外，所有客船还应设置一套公共广播系统。
Translation: 5.1 In addition to the requirements of regulation II-2/40.5 or II-2/41-2 (as applicable) and regulation 4.2 of this chapter, all passenger ships shall be provided with a public address system.
