Query_Text_cn: 对于1997年7月1日以前建造的客船，除5.5的规定外，5.2和5.4的要求应在不迟于1997年7月1日以后第一次定期检验的日期适用。
Translation: For passenger ships constructed before July 1, 1997, the requirements of 5.2 and 5.4, except as provided in 5.5, shall apply no later than the date of the first periodical survey after July 1, 1997.

Query_Text_cn: 5.2公共广播系统应按规则7.2.2.1所述，在所有处所内都高于环境噪声，并能清晰地听到。该系统还应配备一个可从驾驶室的某一位置以及主管机关认为必需的船上的其他位置进行控制的越控功能，以便当有关处所内的任一扩音器已被关闭，其音量已被关小或公共广播系统供作他用时，也能广播所有的紧急信息。
Translation: 5.2 The public address system shall be audible above the ambient noise level in all spaces, as specified in Regulation 7.2.2.1, and shall be clearly intelligible. It shall also be equipped with an override function controllable from a position in the navigating bridge and other locations on board as deemed necessary by the Administration, ensuring that all emergency messages can be broadcast even if any loudspeaker in the relevant spaces has been switched off, its volume has been reduced, or the public address system is being used for other purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 2公共广播系统及其性能标准应经主管机关考虑了本组织所通过的建议案②后予以认可。
Translation: The public address system and its performance standards shall be approved by the competent authority, taking into account the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 5.4公共广播系统应与第II-1/42.2.2条要求的应急电源相连接。
Translation: 5.4 The public announcement system shall be connected to the emergency power source required by regulation II-1/42.2.2.

Query_Text_cn: 5.5对1997年7月1日以前建造的船舶，如已设有经主管机关认可的且确实符合5.2、5.4和规则7.2.2.1所要求的公共广播系统，则不要求改变该系统。
Translation: 5.5 For ships constructed before 1 July 1997, if a public address system approved by the Administration is already installed and effectively complies with the requirements of 5.2, 5.4, and regulation 7.2.2.1, no alteration to such a system shall be required.

Query_Text_cn: ①此处系指2002年7月1日前实施的第II-2章，同等规定见经修正的第II-2章第12.3条。
Translation: ① This refers to Chapter II-2 implemented before July 1, 2002. Equivalent provisions can be found in amended Chapter II-2, Article 12.3.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.808《关于客船公共广播系统,包括其布线的性能标准建议案》。
Translation: ② Refer to IMO MSC/Circ.808 "Recommendation on Performance Standards for Public Address Systems on Passenger Ships, Including Their Wiring."

Query_Text_cn: 2其存放应能随时迅速取下，不应以任何方式永久系牢。
Translation: 2 They shall be stowed so as to be readily accessible and shall not be permanently secured in any way.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2船舶每舷至少有1个救生圈应设有符合规则2.1.4要求的可浮救生索，其长度不少于其存放处在最轻载航行水线以上高度的2倍，或30m，取较大者。
Translation: 1.2 At least one lifebuoy on each side of the ship shall be fitted with a buoyant lifeline complying with the requirements of regulation 2.1.4. The length shall be not less than twice the height of its stowage position above the waterline in the lightest seagoing condition, or 30 meters, whichever is the greater.

Query_Text_cn: 设有自亮灯的和设有自亮灯及自发烟雾信号的救生圈，应均等地分布在船舶两舷，这类救生圈不应是按本条1.2要求的装有救生索的救生圈。
Translation: Lifebuoys fitted with self-igniting lights and those equipped with both self-igniting lights and self-activating smoke signals shall be equally distributed on both sides of the vessel. Such lifebuoys shall not be the type required by paragraph 1.2 of this article to be fitted with lifelines.

Query_Text_cn: 1.4每个救生圈应以粗体罗马大写字母标明其所属船舶的船名和船籍港。
Translation: 1.4 Each lifebuoy shall be marked in block capital Roman letters with the name of the ship and the port of registry to which it belongs.

Query_Text_cn: 2配备足够数量的救生衣，以供值班人员使用，并供设置在远处的救生艇筏站使用。
Translation: An adequate number of lifejackets shall be provided for the use of watch personnel and for use at remotely located survival craft stations.

Query_Text_cn: 供值班人员使用的救生衣应存放在驾驶室、机舱控制室和任何其他有人值班的地方。
Translation: Life jackets for duty personnel shall be stowed in the wheelhouse, engine control room, and any other manned locations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2救生衣应放在容易到达之处，其位置应予明显标示。
Translation: 2.2 Life jackets shall be stowed in readily accessible locations, with their positions clearly marked.

Query_Text_cn: 凡由于船舶的特殊布置，而使按本条2.1要求配备的救生衣可能无法拿到时，可制定使主管机关满意的变通措施，其中可包括增加救生衣的配备数量。
Translation: Where the special arrangements of the ship render the lifejackets required by paragraph 2.1 of this regulation inaccessible, alternative arrangements satisfactory to the Administration may be made, which may include an increase in the number of lifejackets to be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3除自由降落救生艇外，用于全封闭救生艇上的救生衣应不妨碍人员进入救生艇或在艇内就座，包括系好安全带。
Translation: 2.3 Except for free-fall lifeboats, lifejackets used in totally enclosed lifeboats shall not impede entry into the lifeboat or seating within it, including the fastening of seatbelts.

Query_Text_cn: 2.4为自由降落救生艇选用的救生衣及其存放和穿着方式应不妨碍人员进入救生艇、乘员安全或该艇的操作。
Translation: 2.4 The lifejackets selected for free-fall lifeboats, along with their stowage and donning methods, shall not impede entry into the lifeboat, occupant safety, or the operation of the craft.

Query_Text_cn: 应为每个被指派为救助艇员或海上撤离系统工作人员的人分别配备1件合身的、符合规则2.3要求的救生服或符合规则2.4要求的抗暴露服。
Translation: Each person assigned to crew a rescue boat or operate a marine evacuation system shall be provided with a properly fitted immersion suit of thermal protective performance complying with the requirements of section 2.3 or an anti-exposure suit complying with the requirements of section 2.4.

Query_Text_cn: 如果船舶一直在主管机关认为无需热保护的温暖气候①区域航行，则不必配备该保护服。
Translation: If the vessel operates exclusively in areas with warm climates where the administration considers thermal protection unnecessary, such protective clothing need not be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 1本条适用于所有船舶。
Translation: 1 This article applies to all vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 2应为船上每个人员配备1份在紧急情况下必须遵循的明确的须知。
Translation: Two copies of clear instructions to be followed in case of emergency shall be provided for each person on board.

Query_Text_cn: 如为客船，这些须知应使用船旗国要求的一种或数种语言以及英语写成。
Translation: For passenger ships, these instructions shall be written in one or more languages required by the flag State and in English.

Query_Text_cn: 3符合第37条要求的应变部署表和应变须知应展示在全船各个显著之处，包括驾驶室、机舱和各船员起居处所。
Translation: The muster list and emergency instructions conforming to Article 37 shall be displayed in conspicuous places throughout the ship, including the navigation bridge, engine room, and crew accommodation spaces.

Query_Text_cn: 3救生衣的穿着方法。
Translation: 3. How to Wear a Life Jacket.

Query_Text_cn: 3使用符合本组织建议案的符号。
Translation: 3 Use symbols in accordance with the recommendations of this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2船上应有足够数量受过培训的人员来召集和协助未受培训的人员。
Translation: The ship shall have a sufficient number of trained personnel to muster and assist untrained persons.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.1046《热保护评定指南》。
Translation: ① Refer to IMO Circular MSC/Circ.1046 "Guidelines for the Evaluation of Thermal Protection".

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.760(18)决议通过的,经MSC.82(70)决议修正的《与救生设备和装置有关的符号》。
Translation: Refer to the symbols related to life-saving appliances and arrangements adopted by resolution A.760(18), as amended by resolution MSC.82(70).

Query_Text_cn: 3船上应有足够数量的船员（他们可以是驾驶员或持证人员）来操作船上全体人员弃船所需要的救生艇筏及其降落装置。
Translation: The ship shall carry a sufficient number of crew members (who may be deck officers or certificated personnel) to operate the lifeboats and liferafts as well as their launching appliances required for the abandonment of the ship by all persons on board.

Query_Text_cn: 4每艘要使用的救生艇筏，均应设置1名驾驶员或持证人员负责指挥。
Translation: Each lifeboat or liferaft to be used shall be assigned a coxswain or certified person in charge of command.

Query_Text_cn: 但主管机关经适当考虑到航程的性质、船上人数和船舶的特点后，可以准许精通救生筏操纵和操作的人员来代替具有上述资格的人员负责指挥救生筏。
Translation: However, the competent authority may, after due consideration of the nature of the voyage, the number of persons on board, and the characteristics of the ship, permit a person proficient in the handling and operation of liferafts to take charge of such a raft in place of a person possessing the aforementioned qualifications.

Query_Text_cn: 如为救生艇，还应指派1名副指挥。
Translation: For lifeboats, a deputy commander shall also be assigned.

Query_Text_cn: 5救生艇筏负责人应有1份该救生艇筏船员名单，并应确保在其指挥下的船员是熟悉他们的各项任务的。
Translation: The person in charge of each lifeboat or liferaft shall have a list of its crew members and shall ensure that those under their command are familiar with their respective duties.

Query_Text_cn: 救生艇的副指挥亦应有1份该救生艇船员名单。
Translation: The deputy commander of the lifeboat should also have a copy of the crew list for that lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 6应为每艘机动救生艇筏指派1名能操作发动机和进行小调整的人。
Translation: Each motorized lifeboat or liferaft shall be assigned one person capable of operating the engine and performing minor adjustments.

Query_Text_cn: 7船长应确保本条2、3和4所指人员妥善地分配到本船救生艇筏中。
Translation: The master shall ensure that the persons referred to in paragraphs 2, 3, and 4 of this article are properly assigned to the lifeboats and liferafts on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1须有认可的降落设备的救生艇和救生筏，应存放在尽可能靠近起居处所和服务处所的地方。
Translation: 1 Lifeboats and liferafts with approved launching appliances shall be stowed as close to accommodation and service spaces as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 2集合站应设在紧靠登乘站的地方。
Translation: The assembly station shall be located immediately adjacent to the embarkation station.

Query_Text_cn: 每个集合站应在甲板上有足够的无障碍场所，以容纳指定在该站集合的所有人员，但人均占面积至少为0.35m2。
Translation: Each assembly station shall have sufficient clear deck space to accommodate all persons assigned to assemble at that station, with a minimum area of at least 0.35m² per person.

Query_Text_cn: 3集合站与登乘站均应设在容易从起居处所和工作区域到达的地方。
Translation: Both the assembly station and the embarkation station shall be located in areas easily accessible from accommodation and working spaces.

Query_Text_cn: 4集合站与登乘站应根据情况，由第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源照明系统提供足够的照明。
Translation: The muster and embarkation stations shall be adequately illuminated by the emergency source of electric power required by regulation II-1/42 or II-1/43 as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 5通往集合站与登乘站的通道、梯道和出口应予照明。
Translation: Passages, stairways, and exits leading to assembly stations and embarkation stations shall be illuminated.

Query_Text_cn: 该照明系统应能根据情况由第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源供电。
Translation: The lighting system shall be capable of being supplied by the emergency power source required by regulation II-1/42 or II-1/43 as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，并且作为第II-2/28.1.10条①要求的标志的一部分，通往集合站的路线应按本组织为此用途而提出的建议案用集合站的符号标明。
Translation: In addition, and as part of the marking required by regulation II-2/28.1.10, routes to assembly stations shall be indicated by the assembly station symbol in accordance with the recommendations developed by the Organization for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 6吊艇架降落和自由降落的救生艇筏集合站与登乘站的布置，应能使担架病人抬进救生艇筏。
Translation: The arrangement of launching appliances and free-fall lifeboat and liferaft assembly and embarkation stations shall be such as to enable stretcher cases to be placed into the lifeboats and liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 7在船舷降落的救生艇筏的每处登乘站或每二处相邻的登乘站均应设置一个符合规则6.1.6要求的登乘梯，其单根长度在船舶纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下可从甲板延伸至最轻载航行水线。
Translation: At each embarkation station for lifeboats and liferafts lowered over the side of the ship, or at every two adjacent embarkation stations, an embarkation ladder complying with the requirements of Regulation 6.1.6 shall be provided. The single length of such ladder shall be capable of reaching from the deck to the waterline in the lightest seagoing condition under unfavorable conditions of trim of up to 10° and a list of up to 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，主管机关可准许用进入在水面上的救生艇筏的认可装置代替这些梯子,但船舶的两舷均应设有至少一个登乘梯。
Translation: However, the competent authority may permit the use of approved devices for access to survival craft on the water in lieu of these ladders, provided that at least one embarkation ladder is fitted on each side of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 第31.1.4条要求的救生筏可准许用能以受控方式下降至水面的其他登乘设施。
Translation: Life rafts required by paragraph 31.1.4 may be replaced by other approved means of embarkation that can be lowered to the water in a controlled manner.

Query_Text_cn: 8如有必要，应设置将吊艇架降落的救生艇筏贴靠并系留在船舷的装置，以便人员能安全登乘。
Translation: Where necessary, devices shall be provided to bring the survival craft or rescue boat alongside the ship's side and hold it securely during embarkation to ensure safe boarding.

Query_Text_cn: ①此处系指2002年7月1日前实施的第II-2章，同等规定见经修正的第II-2章第13.3.2.5.1条。
Translation: ① Here refers to Chapter II-2 implemented before July 1, 2002, with equivalent provisions found in amended Chapter II-2, Regulation 13.3.2.5.1.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织A.760(18)决议通过的,经MSC.82(70)决议修正的《与救生设备和装置有关的符号》以及本组织A.752(18)决议通过的《客船低位照明的鉴定、试验和应用指南》。
Translation: ② Refer to the Symbols Related to Life-Saving Appliances and Arrangements adopted by resolution A.760(18), as amended by resolution MSC.82(70), and the Guidelines for the Evaluation, Testing and Application of Low-Location Lighting on Passenger Ships adopted by resolution A.752(18).

Query_Text_cn: 降落站的位置应确保救生艇筏安全降落，应特别注意离开推进器及船体陡斜悬空部分，除专门设计为自由降落的救生艇筏外，应尽可能使救生艇筏能从船舷平直部分降落下水。
Translation: The location of the launching station shall ensure the safe launching of survival craft and rafts, with particular attention paid to keeping clear of propellers and steeply overhanging portions of the hull. Except for survival craft and rafts specifically designed for free-fall launching, they shall, as far as practicable, be capable of being launched from the ship's side where the hull is straight and parallel to the waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 如降落站设置在船的前部，则应设置在防撞舱壁后方有遮蔽的地方，对此，主管机关应对降落设备的强度予以特别考虑。
Translation: If the launching station is located forward on the ship, it shall be situated abaft the collision bulkhead in a sheltered position, and special consideration shall be given by the Administration to the strength of the launching appliance.

Query_Text_cn: 5在切实可行的情况下，位于安全的并有遮蔽的地方，并加以保护免受火灾和爆炸引起的损坏。
Translation: Where practicable, it shall be located in a safe and sheltered area and protected against damage caused by fire and explosion.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其是，油船上的救生艇筏，除第31.1.4条要求的救生筏外，不应存放在货油舱、污油舱或其他含有爆炸性或危险性货物的液舱上或其上方。
Translation: In particular, lifeboats and liferafts on oil tankers, except for the liferafts required by regulation 31.1.4, shall not be stowed over cargo oil tanks, slop tanks, or other tanks containing explosive or hazardous cargoes.

Query_Text_cn: 2顺船舷降落的救生艇应存放在推进器前方尽量远的地方。
Translation: Lifeboats launched over the side shall be stowed as far forward of the propeller as practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 在船长为80m及以上但少于120m的货船上，每艘救生艇应存放在使该救生艇尾端在推进器前方不少于该救生艇长度的地方。
Translation: On cargo ships with a length of 80 meters or more but less than 120 meters, each lifeboat shall be stowed so that its aft end is located not less than the length of the lifeboat forward of the propeller.

Query_Text_cn: 在船长为120m及以上的货船与船长为80m及以上的客船上，每艘救生艇应存放在使该救生艇尾端在推进器前方不少于该救生艇一倍半长度的地方。
Translation: On cargo ships with a length of 120 meters or more and passenger ships with a length of 80 meters or more, each lifeboat shall be stowed so that its aft end is located not less than one and a half times the length of the lifeboat forward of the propeller.

Query_Text_cn: 如适合，船舶的布置应对在存放位置的救生艇加以保护，使其免受巨浪引起的损坏。
Translation: Where practicable, the arrangement of the ship shall be such that lifeboats stowed in their launching positions are protected from damage by heavy seas.

Query_Text_cn: 3救生艇应附连于其降落设备上存放。
Translation: 3 Lifeboats shall be stowed attached to their launching appliances.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1每只救生筏的存放应将其首缆牢固地系在船上。
Translation: 4.1 Each life raft shall be stowed with its painter securely fastened to the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 4.2每只救生筏或救生筏组的存放应设有一个符合规则4.1.6要求的自由漂浮装置，以使每只救生筏能自由漂浮，如为气胀式，在船舶下沉时能自动充气。
Translation: 4.2 Each life raft or group of life rafts shall be provided with a free-floating arrangement complying with the requirements of regulation 4.1.6, so that each life raft can float free and, if inflatable, automatically inflate when the ship sinks.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3救生筏的存放应能在用人工将其从系固装置上解脱时，一次释放1只筏或容器。
Translation: 4.3 The stowage of life rafts shall be such that they can be released one raft or container at a time by manually releasing them from their securing arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 4.4上述4.1和4.2不适用于第31.1.4条要求的救生筏。
Translation: 4.4 The provisions of 4.1 and 4.2 above do not apply to liferafts required by Clause 31.1.4.

Query_Text_cn: 5吊艇架降落的救生筏应存放在吊筏钩可到达的范围内，除非设有某种转移设施，该设施在本条1.2所规定的纵倾和横倾范围内并非无法操作，也未因船舶运动或动力故障而无法操作。
Translation: Life rafts launched by a davit shall be stowed within reach of the lifting hooks, unless some means of transfer is provided which is not rendered inoperable within the limits of trim and heel specified in paragraph 1.2 of this regulation or by ship motion or power failure.

Query_Text_cn: 6用于抛出舷外降落的救生筏的存放，应能容易地转移到船舶的任一舷降落，除非船舶每舷已按第31.1条要求的总容量存放了救生筏，且能在任一舷降落。
Translation: Life rafts intended for throw-overboard launching shall be stowed in such a way as to be readily transferable for launching on either side of the ship unless life rafts of the required aggregate capacity are stowed on each side of the ship in compliance with regulation 31.1 and can be launched on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 4在其兼作救生艇时，符合第13条的要求。
Translation: 4 When serving as a lifeboat, it shall comply with the requirements of Article 13.

Query_Text_cn: 1在海上撤离系统的登乘站和最轻载航行水线之间的船侧不应有任何开口，并应设有保护该系统免受任何突出物影响的设施。
Translation: No openings shall be permitted in the ship's side between the embarkation station of the marine evacuation system and the lightest seagoing waterline, and facilities shall be provided to protect the system from any protruding objects.

Query_Text_cn: 2海上撤离系统应布置在能安全降落的位置，应特别注意离开推进器及船体陡斜悬空部分，以尽可能使海上撤离系统能从船舷平直部分降落下水。
Translation: The marine evacuation system shall be positioned to ensure safe deployment, with particular attention paid to maintaining a safe distance from propellers and steep overhanging sections of the hull. This arrangement shall facilitate deployment from the straight side of the ship as far as practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 3每一海上撤离系统的存放应使通道或平台，或其存放或操作装置均不会妨碍任何其他救生设备在任何其他降落站的操作。
Translation: Each marine evacuation system shall be so stowed that the passage or platform, or its stowage or operational arrangements, do not interfere with the operation of any other life-saving appliance at any other launching station.

Query_Text_cn: 4如适合，船舶的布置应对在存放位置的海上撤离系统加以保护，使其免受巨浪引起的损坏。
Translation: 4 Where practicable, the arrangement of the ship shall provide protection for the marine evacuation system in its stowed position from damage by heavy seas.

Query_Text_cn: 5供连同海上撤离系统一起使用并符合规则6.2要求的救生艇筏，且存放方式为可在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下直接从存放地点降落下水。
Translation: Five lifeboats or liferafts, used in conjunction with the marine evacuation system and compliant with Regulation 6.2, shall be stowed in a manner that allows direct launching from their stowage position under adverse conditions of trim up to 10° and list up to 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘救生艇应设有1台能降落和回收该救生艇的设备。
Translation: 2 Each lifeboat shall be provided with one set of equipment capable of launching and recovering the lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应配备放开救生艇的装置，以便释放机构在不受载的情况下进行维护保养。
Translation: Additionally, devices for launching lifeboats shall be provided to allow maintenance of the release mechanism under no-load conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 3降落与回收装置应使该设备的操作人员在救生艇筏降落期间，以及在救生艇回收期间，能随时在船上观察到救生艇筏。
Translation: The launching and recovery appliance shall enable the operator on board to observe the survival craft at all times during both its launching and recovery.

Query_Text_cn: 4船上所配备的类似救生艇筏应仅使用同一种型号的释放机械装置。
Translation: All similar lifeboats and liferafts on board shall be equipped with only one type of launching appliance.

Query_Text_cn: 5在任一降落站，救生艇筏的准备和操作不应妨碍任何其他降落站的任何其他救生艇筏或救助艇的迅速准备和操作。
Translation: At any launching station, the preparation and operation of a lifeboat or liferaft shall not impede the prompt preparation and operation of any other lifeboat, liferaft, or rescue boat at any other launching station.

Query_Text_cn: 6吊艇索（如使用）应有足够的长度，以便船舶在最轻载航行时在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°时，可使救生艇筏到达水面。
Translation: 6. The falls (if used) shall be of sufficient length to ensure that the survival craft can reach the water when the ship is at its lightest seagoing condition with an inclination of 10° trim and listed up to 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 7在准备和降落过程中，救生艇筏及其降落设备以及准备降落的水域，应根据情况使用第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源供电的照明系统予以足够的照明。
Translation: During the preparation and launching process, the lifeboat or liferaft, its launching equipment, and the water area where launching is to take place shall be adequately illuminated by the lighting system supplied by the emergency power source as required by regulation II-1/42 or II-1/43, as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 8在弃船过程中，应有能防止船舶的任何排水排放到救生艇筏内的设施。
Translation: 8 During the abandonment process, facilities shall be provided to prevent any drainage from the vessel from entering the lifeboats or liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 9如救生艇筏有被船舶减摇翼造成损坏的危险，则应有由应急电源驱动的、能将减摇翼收回船内的设施；驾驶室应设有应急电源操纵的指示减摇翼位置的指示器。
Translation: 9 If there is a risk of lifeboats or liferafts being damaged by the ship's stabilizer fins, facilities powered by emergency power sources shall be provided to retract the fins into the ship; the wheelhouse shall be equipped with an emergency power-operated indicator showing the position of the stabilizer fins.

Query_Text_cn: 10如配备符合规则4.5要求的部分封闭救生艇，应装设吊艇架横张索，在其上设置不少于2根足够长度的救生索，以便船舶在最轻载航行时在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下，可使救生艇到达水面。
Translation: Where partially enclosed lifeboats complying with the requirements of regulation 4.5 are provided, they shall be fitted with span wires with not less than two lifelines of sufficient length attached so that the lifeboat can reach the water under unfavorable conditions of trim of up to 10° and list of up to 20° on either side when the ship is in its lightest seagoing condition.

Query_Text_cn: 救助艇的登乘与降落装置，应在尽可能短的时间内，使船员能登上并降落救助艇。
Translation: The embarkation and launching appliances for rescue boats shall enable the crew to board and launch the boat in the shortest possible time.

Query_Text_cn: 2如救助艇是船舶救生艇筏中的一艘，其登乘装置与降落站应符合第11条和第12条的要求。
Translation: 2 If the rescue boat is one of the ship's survival craft, its embarkation arrangements and launching station shall comply with the requirements of regulations 11 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: 3降落装置应符合第16条的要求。
Translation: The landing gear shall comply with the requirements of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，所有救助艇均应能在船舶于平静水面上前进航速达到5kn时降落，如必要可用艇首缆。
Translation: However, all rescue boats shall be capable of being launched when the ship is making headway at speeds of up to 5 knots in calm water, using a painter if necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 4救助艇在载足全部乘员及属具时的中等海况下的回收时间应不超过5min。
Translation: The recovery time of a rescue boat with all its complement and equipment on board in moderate sea conditions shall not exceed 5 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 如救助艇兼作救生艇，应能在此时间内回收载有救生艇属具及认可的、额定乘员至少为6人的救助艇。
Translation: If a rescue boat is also used as a lifeboat, it shall be capable of being recovered within this time when loaded with its lifeboat equipment and an approved rescue boat with a minimum capacity of six persons.

Query_Text_cn: 5救助艇登乘和回收装置应允许安全而有效地搬运担架病人。
Translation: The embarkation and recovery arrangements for lifeboat No. 5 shall permit the safe and efficient handling of stretcher cases.

Query_Text_cn: 如果重型动索滑车构成危险，为了安全应设有供恶劣天气下使用的回收环索。
Translation: If the heavy-duty running rigging constitutes a hazard, a retrieval strop for use in adverse weather conditions should be provided for safety.

Query_Text_cn: 应配备1具符合规则7.1要求的抛绳设备。
Translation: One set of line-throwing appliance complying with the requirements of rule 7.1 shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1每位被指派为具有应急职责的船员，应在开航前熟悉这些职责。
Translation: 2.1 Each crew member assigned emergency duties shall familiarize themselves with these responsibilities prior to the commencement of the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 并向乘客介绍救生衣的使用方法以及在紧急情况下应采取的行动。
Translation: and demonstrate the use of life jackets to passengers along with the actions to be taken in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3当有新的乘客登船时，应在开航前，或在开航后立即召开一次乘客安全简要介绍会。
Translation: 2.3 When new passengers board the vessel, a passenger safety briefing shall be conducted before departure or immediately thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 介绍会应包括第8.2条和第8.4条所要求的应变须知并应以一种或几种易被乘客听懂的语言进行宣讲。
Translation: The briefing shall include the emergency instructions required by Sections 8.2 and 8.4 and shall be delivered in one or more languages easily understood by the passengers.

Query_Text_cn: 宣讲应使用船上的公共广播或用其他等效的方式，至少使得在航行中尚未听到的乘客易于听到。
Translation: Announcements shall be made using the ship's public address system or other equivalent means, ensuring they are clearly audible to passengers who may not have heard them during the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 如果上述2.2要求的集合是在开航后立即举行的，则简要介绍会也可被包括在该集合演习之内。
Translation: If the assembly required in section 2.2 is conducted immediately after sailing, the briefing may be included within such an assembly drill.

Query_Text_cn: 也可以使用资料卡或标贴，或船上录像机播放的录像节目作为简要介绍会的补充，但其不可以替代宣讲。
Translation: Alternatively,information cards,labels,or video programs played on the ship's recorder may be used as supplements to the briefing session,but they cannot serve as a substitute for oral presentations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.1演习应尽可能按实际紧急情况进行。
Translation: 3.1 Exercises should be conducted as realistically as possible to simulate actual emergency conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2每位船员每月应至少参加一次弃船演习和一次消防演习。
Translation: 3.2 Each crew member shall participate in at least one abandon ship drill and one fire drill per month.

Query_Text_cn: 若有25%以上的船员未参加船上的上个月弃船和消防演习，应在该船离港后24h内举行该两项船员演习。
Translation: If more than 25% of the crew members have not participated in the ship's abandon ship and fire drills conducted in the previous month, these two crew drills shall be held within 24 hours after the ship's departure from the port.

Query_Text_cn: 当船舶在经重大改建后首次投入营运时，或有新船员时，应在开航前举行这些演习。
Translation: These drills shall be conducted prior to sailing when a ship is first put into service after undergoing major alterations or when new crew members are onboard.

Query_Text_cn: 对于无法这样做的各类船舶，主管机关可同意至少是等效的其他安排。
Translation: For vessels unable to comply with such requirements, the competent authority may approve alternative arrangements that are at least equivalent.

Query_Text_cn: 9介绍无线电救生设备的使用。
Translation: 9. Introduction to the use of radio lifesaving equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.2不同的救生艇应尽实际可能按本条3.3.1.5要求，在逐次演习中降放。
Translation: 3.3.2 Different lifeboats shall, as far as practicable, be lowered in successive drills in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 3.3.1.5.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.3除本条3.3.4和3.3.5规定外，每艘救生艇应在弃船演习中每3个月至少有一次乘载被指派的操艇船员降落下水，并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: 3.3.3 Except as provided in sections 3.3.4 and 3.3.5 of this article, each lifeboat shall be launched with its assigned crew aboard and maneuvered in the water at least once every three months during an abandon ship drill.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.4如自由降落下水不可行，可允许将救生艇降放至水面，而不作自由降落下水，但该救生艇应每6个月至少有一次乘载被指派的操艇船员自由降落下水，并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: 3.3.4 If free-fall launching is not feasible, the lifeboat may be lowered to the water without free-fall launching, provided that the lifeboat is free-fall launched at least once every six months with its assigned operating crew on board and is maneuvered in the water.

Query_Text_cn: 但如不可行时，主管机关可将此期限延长至12个月，但必须按不超过6个月的间隔期安排一次类似的降落试验。
Translation: However, if this is not feasible, the competent authority may extend this period to 12 months, provided that similar landing tests are conducted at intervals not exceeding 6 months.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.5对于从事短程国际航行的船舶，如果由于港口泊位的安排及其运输方式不允许救生艇在某一舷降落下水，主管机关可准许救生艇不在该舷降落下水。
Translation: 3.3.5 For ships engaged in short international voyages, if the arrangement of port berths and the mode of transport do not permit the launching of lifeboats on one side, the Administration may allow lifeboats not to be launched on that side.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，所有这些救生艇应至少每3个月下降一次并每年至少降落下水一次。
Translation: However, all such lifeboats shall be lowered at least once every three months and launched at least once annually.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.6除兼作救生艇的救助艇外，其他救助艇均应在合理和可行的范围内，每个月乘载指定的船员降落下水并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: 3.3.6 Except for rescue boats that also serve as lifeboats, all other rescue boats shall, within reasonable and practicable limits, be launched monthly with their assigned crew aboard and maneuvered in the water.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，应至少每3个月按此要求进行一次。
Translation: Under any circumstances, this requirement shall be fulfilled at least once every three months.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.7如救生艇与救助艇的降落下水演习是在船舶前进航行中进行，由于涉及危险，该项演习应仅在有遮蔽的水域，并在有此项演习经验的驾驶员监督下进行。
Translation: 3.3.7 If the launching and recovery of lifeboats and rescue boats are conducted while the vessel is underway, as this involves danger, such exercises shall only be carried out in sheltered waters and under the supervision of an experienced officer.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.624(15)决议通过的《关于在前进航行中船舶的救生艇和救助艇降落下水的培训指南》。
Translation: Refer to the "Guidelines on Training for the Launching and Recovery of Lifeboats and Rescue Boats in Forward Motion" adopted by the organization's A.624(15) resolution.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.8如船上配备海上撤离系统，演习应包括按对该系统布放所要求的程序，演练至即将实际布放这一系统的程度。
Translation: 3.3.8 If a marine evacuation system is provided on board, the drill shall include exercising the procedures required for deploying the system up to the point of actual deployment.

Query_Text_cn: 这方面的演习应使用第35.4条要求的船上培训教具按正规规程予以增加。
Translation: Drills of this nature shall be augmented by the regular procedures required by section 35.4 using onboard training aids.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，该系统的每一成员还应尽实际可能，通过在船上或岸上参加类似系统在水中的全面布放而进行进一步的培训，参加的间隔期应不超过2年，但无论如何不得超过3年。
Translation: In addition, each member of the system shall, as far as practicable, undergo further training by participating in a full deployment of a similar system at sea, either on board or ashore, at intervals not exceeding two years and in no case exceeding three years.

Query_Text_cn: 此种培训可同第20.8.2条要求的布放结合起来进行。
Translation: Such training may be combined with the deployment required under Article 20.8.2.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.9在每次弃船演习时，应测试用于集合与弃船的应急照明系统。
Translation: 3.3.9 During each abandon ship drill, the emergency lighting system for mustering and abandonment shall be tested.

Query_Text_cn: 3.4.1在制定消防演习计划时，对在根据船型和货物类型而可能发生的各种紧急情况下的常规做法，应给予充分考虑。
Translation: 3.4.1 When formulating fire drill plans, full consideration shall be given to standard practices for various emergency scenarios that may arise based on vessel type and cargo category.

Query_Text_cn: 6检查供随后弃船用的必要装置。
Translation: 6. Inspect the necessary equipment for subsequent ship abandonment.

Query_Text_cn: 3.4.3演习中使用过的设备应立即恢复到完好的操作状况；演习中发现的任何故障和缺陷，应尽快予以消除。
Translation: 3.4.3 Equipment used in drills shall be promptly restored to fully operational condition; any malfunctions or defects identified during the drills shall be rectified as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1船员上船后，应尽快在不迟于2个星期内，对其进行有关使用包括救生艇筏属具在内的船上救生设备和使用船上灭火设备的船上培训。
Translation: 4.1 Upon boarding, crew members shall receive onboard training on the use of lifesaving appliances, including lifeboat and liferaft equipment, as well as firefighting equipment, as soon as possible but no later than two weeks.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果船员是定期安排轮派上船，则这种培训应在不迟于船员第一次上船后2个星期内进行。
Translation: However, if crew members are assigned to ships on a regular rotation, such training shall be conducted no later than two weeks after their first boarding.

Query_Text_cn: 应讲授船舶灭火设备和救生设备的用法以及海上救生的课程，授课间隔期与演习间隔期相同。
Translation: Courses on the use of shipboard firefighting and lifesaving equipment, as well as maritime lifesaving techniques, shall be conducted at intervals consistent with those of the drills.

Query_Text_cn: 每次授课可以包括船舶救生设备和灭火设备的各个不同部分，但在任何2个月的授课期内应包括该船的全部救生和灭火设备。
Translation: Each training session may cover different parts of the ship's life-saving appliances and fire-fighting equipment, but within any two-month period, all life-saving and fire-fighting equipment on board must be included.

Query_Text_cn: 4灭火设备的操作与使用。
Translation: 4. Operation and Use of Fire Extinguishing Equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3在每艘装有吊架降落式救生筏的船上，应在不超过4个月的间隔时间内举行一次此项设备用法的船上培训。
Translation: 4.3 On every ship equipped with davit-launched liferafts, onboard training in the use of such equipment shall be conducted at intervals not exceeding four months.

Query_Text_cn: 凡可行时，此项培训应包括一个救生筏的充气与下降。
Translation: Where practicable, such training shall include the inflation and lowering of a life raft.

Query_Text_cn: 这个救生筏可以是培训专用救生筏，而不是船舶救生设备的组成部分，并应明显地标出专用救生筏标志。
Translation: This life raft may be a training-specific life raft rather than part of the ship's lifesaving equipment and shall be clearly marked with a dedicated life raft label.

Query_Text_cn: 举行集合的日期、弃船演习和消防演习的详细情况、其他救生设备演习以及船上培训均应记载于主管机关可能规定的航海日志内。
Translation: The dates on which musters are held, details of abandon ship drills and fire drills, other life-saving appliance drills, and onboard training shall be recorded in the logbook as may be prescribed by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在指定时间内未举行全部集合、演习或培训项目，则应在航海日志内记述其原因和已举行的集合、演习或培训项目的范围。
Translation: If all musters, drills, or training sessions are not conducted within the specified time, the reasons and the scope of those that have been carried out shall be recorded in the logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 1986年7月1日以前建造的船舶，应尽实际可能符合本条3和6.2的要求。
Translation: Ships constructed before 1 July 1986 shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 3 and 6.2 to the fullest extent practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定外，本章适用于本规则所适用的所有船舶，和300总吨及以上的货船。
Translation: 1 Unless otherwise expressly provided, this chapter applies to all ships to which these rules apply and to cargo ships of 300 gross tonnage and above.

Query_Text_cn: 2本章不适用于航行在北美洲五大湖及其东至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣拉姆伯特船闸下游出口处为止的相连水域和支流的船舶，而这些船舶在其他情况下应适用本规则①。
Translation: This chapter does not apply to vessels navigating the Great Lakes of North America and their connecting and tributary waters as far east as the lower exit of the St. Lambert Lock at Montreal, Province of Quebec, Canada, where such vessels would otherwise be subject to this rule.

Query_Text_cn: 3本章的规定不应妨碍遇险的任何船舶、救生艇筏或人员使用任何方法以引起注意、表明其位置并获得援助。
Translation: The provisions of this chapter shall not prevent any vessel, lifeboat, raft, or person in distress from using any means to attract attention, indicate their position, and obtain assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 1驾驶室对驾驶室的通信系指在船舶通常驾驶位置进行的船舶之间的安全通信。
Translation: 1 Bridge-to-bridge communication refers to safety communications between vessels conducted from the normal navigation control position on board.

Query_Text_cn: 2连续值班系指有关的无线电值班不应中断，除非当船舶接收能力由于自身通信被削弱或阻塞时，或当设备处于定期维护或检查时，而引起短暂间隔。
Translation: Continuous watch means that the relevant radio watch should not be interrupted, except for brief intervals when the ship's receiving capability is impaired or blocked by its own communications, or when the equipment is undergoing routine maintenance or inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 3数字选择呼叫（DSC）系指使用数码，使一个无线电台与另一个电台或一组电台建立联系和传递信息，并符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）②有关建议案的一种技术。
Translation: Digital Selective Calling (DSC) refers to a technique that uses digital codes to establish contact and transmit information between one radio station and another or a group of stations, in compliance with the relevant recommendations of the International Radio Consultative Committee (CCIR).

Query_Text_cn: 4直接印字电报系指符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）②有关建议案的自动电报技术。
Translation: Direct-printing telegraph refers to automatic telegraph technology that complies with the relevant recommendations of the International Radio Consultative Committee (CCIR).

Query_Text_cn: 5一般无线电通信系指通过无线电进行的除遇险、紧急和安全信息通信以外的业务和公共通信。
Translation: 5 General radiocommunication refers to services and public correspondence conducted via radio, excluding distress, urgency, and safety communications.

Query_Text_cn: 6国际海事卫星组织（INMARSAT）③系指按1976年9月3日通过的国际海事卫星组织公约成立的组织。
Translation: 6 The International Maritime Satellite Organization (INMARSAT) refers to the organization established under the Convention on the International Maritime Satellite Organization adopted on September 3, 1976.

Query_Text_cn: ①此类船舶按为安全目的对有关无线电的特殊要求办理，此要求载于加拿大与美利坚合众国的有关协议内。
Translation: ① Such vessels shall comply with the special requirements for radio equipment for safety purposes, as stipulated in the relevant agreements between Canada and the United States of America.

Query_Text_cn: ②因1992年日内瓦国际电信规则第1条规定，该委员会名称改为“ITU无线电通信部”(ITU-R)。
Translation: ②Pursuant to Article 1 of the 1992 International Telecommunication Regulations adopted in Geneva, the name of this committee was changed to "ITU Radiocommunication Sector" (ITU-R).

Query_Text_cn: ③因1994年12月5日～9日的第10次国际海事卫星组织（特别）会议通过对公约的修正案和操作协议的规定，该组织的名称改为“国际移动卫星组织”(Inmarsat)。
Translation: ③ Due to the amendments to the Convention and the provisions of the Operating Agreement adopted at the 10th (Extraordinary) Assembly of the International Maritime Satellite Organization (INMARSAT) from December 5 to 9, 1994, the organization's name was changed to the "International Mobile Satellite Organization" (Inmarsat).

Query_Text_cn: 7国际奈伏泰斯（NAVTEX）业务系指在518kHz上，使用窄带直接印字电报手段，用英语协调广播和自动接收海上安全信息①。
Translation: International NAVTEX service refers to the coordinated broadcast and automatic reception of maritime safety information in English on 518 kHz using narrow-band direct-printing telegraphy.

Query_Text_cn: 8定位系指发现遇险的船舶、航空器、海上设施或人员。
Translation: 8 Positioning refers to the detection of distressed vessels, aircraft, offshore installations, or individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 9海上安全信息系指向船舶播发的航行和气象警报、气象预报和与安全有关的其他紧急信息。
Translation: Maritime Safety Information (MSI) refers to navigational and meteorological warnings, weather forecasts, and other urgent safety-related messages broadcast to vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 10极轨道卫星业务系指利用极轨道卫星接收和转发来自卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRB）的遇险报警，并提供其位置的业务。
Translation: The 10-polar orbit satellite service refers to the operation of receiving and relaying distress alerts from Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) via polar-orbiting satellites, while also providing their location information.

Query_Text_cn: 11无线电规则系指随时有效的最新国际电信公约附件或被视为附件的无线电规则。
Translation: The Radio Regulations refer to the latest version of the Annex to the International Telecommunication Convention currently in force or deemed to be an annex thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 12A1海区系指至少由一个具有连续DSC报警能力的甚高频（VHF）海岸电台的无线电话所覆盖的区域，该区域可由各缔约国政府规定②。
Translation: Area 12A1 refers to a zone covered by at least one VHF coast station with continuous DSC alerting capability, as may be designated by the respective Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 13A2海区系指除A1海区以外，至少由一个具有连续DSC报警能力的中频（MF）海岸电台的无线电话所覆盖的区域，该区域可由各缔约国政府规定①。
Translation: Sea Area A2 refers to the area, other than Sea Area A1, covered by radiotelephone services of at least one medium frequency (MF) coast station with continuous DSC alerting capability, as may be designated by the respective Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 14A3海区系指除A1和A2海区以外，由具有连续报警能力的INMARSAT对地静止卫星所覆盖的区域。
Translation: Sea area A3 refers to the region covered by INMARSAT geostationary satellites with continuous alerting capability, excluding sea areas A1 and A2.

Query_Text_cn: 15A4海区系指A1、A2和A3海区以外的区域。
Translation: Sea Area A4 refers to regions beyond Sea Areas A1, A2, and A3.

Query_Text_cn: 16全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）标识系指可由船舶设备发送并用于识别船舶的海上移动业务识别码、船舶呼号、Inmarsat识别码和系列号识别码。
Translation: The GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System) identification refers to maritime mobile service identities, ship call signs, Inmarsat identification numbers, and serial number identifiers that can be transmitted by shipboard equipment for vessel identification.

Query_Text_cn: 2本章所使用的并在无线电规则和可能经修正的《1979年国际海上搜索与救助（SAR）公约》中已定义的所有其他术语和缩写语，具有与无线电规则和SAR公约所定义的相同含义。
Translation: All other terms and abbreviations used in this chapter, which are defined in the Radio Regulations and the International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR), 1979, as may be amended, shall have the same meanings as assigned to them in the Radio Regulations and the SAR Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关已考虑到这些免除对所有船舶安全业务总的有效性的影响。
Translation: The competent authority has taken into account the impact of these exemptions on the overall effectiveness of all vessel safety operations.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织认可的NAVTEX手册（出版物IMO-951E）。
Translation: ①Refer to the NAVTEX Manual (IMO Publication 951E) approved by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.801(19)决议《关于全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)无线电业务的规定》。
Translation: ② See Resolution A.801(19), "Regulations for the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) Radio Service."

Query_Text_cn: 2在例外情况下，船舶在为之配备的海区或多个海区外进行单次航行。
Translation: 2 In exceptional circumstances, a vessel may undertake a single voyage outside the sea area or areas for which it is equipped.

Query_Text_cn: 3各主管机关应在每年的1月1日后尽快向本组织提交1份上一年度内按本条1和2所有核准免除的报告，并阐明核准这些免除的理由。
Translation: Each competent authority shall submit to the Organization, as soon as possible after 1 January each year, a report of all exemptions granted under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this article during the previous calendar year, giving the reasons for granting such exemptions.

Query_Text_cn: 9发送和接收驾驶室对驾驶室的通信。
Translation: 9. Sending and receiving cab-to-cab communications.

Query_Text_cn: ①应注意到船舶执行GMDSS功能应该使用本组织A.814(19)决议通过的《避免错误的遇险报警指南》。
Translation: ① It should be noted that ships performing GMDSS functions should use the "Guidelines for Avoiding False Distress Alerts" adopted by the organization’s Resolution A.814(19).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.614(15)决议《关于在9,300～9,500MHz频带上工作的雷达配备》。
Translation: ② See Resolution A.614(15) "On the Installation of Radars Operating in the 9,300~9,500 MHz Frequency Band."

Query_Text_cn: ③应注意到船舶在港口时可能有必要接收某些海上安全信息。
Translation: ③It should be noted that ships in port may need to receive certain maritime safety information.

Query_Text_cn: 1每个缔约国政府承诺，在其认为可行和必要时，充分考虑本组织的建议案②单独或与其他缔约国政府合作，为空间和地面无线电通信业务提供适当的岸基设施。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Government undertakes, where it considers it practicable and necessary, to give due consideration to the Organization's recommendations and, either individually or in cooperation with other Contracting Governments, to provide suitable shore-based facilities for space and terrestrial radiocommunication services.

Query_Text_cn: 5在415kHz～535kHz③及1,605kHz～4,000kHz频带内的海上移动业务。
Translation: 5 Maritime mobile services within the frequency bands 415kHz to 535kHz and 1,605kHz to 4,000kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务向本组织提供关于在其沿海指定海区建立的海上移动业务、移动卫星业务和海上移动卫星业务的岸基设施的有关资料④。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Government undertakes to provide the Organization with relevant information on shore-based facilities established in designated maritime areas off its coasts for maritime mobile services, mobile satellite services, and maritime mobile satellite services.④

Query_Text_cn: 1本条适用于所有航行的所有船舶。
Translation: 1 This article applies to all vessels navigating under all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2每个缔约国政府承担义务确保做出适当安排以登记全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）识别码，并使救助协调中心全天24h能获得这些识别码。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes to ensure that appropriate arrangements are made for registering Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) identification numbers and for making these numbers available to rescue coordination centers on a 24-hour basis.

Query_Text_cn: 如适合，缔约国政府应向保存这些识别码登记的国际组织通报所授予的识别码。
Translation: Where appropriate, the government of a Contracting State shall notify the international organization maintaining the register of such identifiers of the identifiers assigned.

Query_Text_cn: ①并不要求各缔约国政府提供所有无线电通信业务。
Translation: ① It does not require the governments of the contracting states to provide all radio communication services.

Query_Text_cn: 对覆盖不同海区的岸基设施的要求应具体规定。
Translation: Requirements for shore-based facilities covering different sea areas shall be specified in detail.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.801(19)决议《关于全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)无线电业务的规定》。
Translation: ② Refer to Resolution A.801(19) on the Regulations for Radio Services in the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见A.617(15)决议《关于作为世界范围航行警告业务一部分的NAVTEX系统的实施》。
Translation: ③ See Resolution A.617(15) on the Implementation of the NAVTEX System as Part of the Worldwide Navigational Warning Service.

Query_Text_cn: ④根据缔约国政府提供的信息，GMDSS岸基设施的总布置图，将通过GMDSS通函向所有有关方面通告。
Translation: ④Based on information provided by the government of the Contracting Party, the general arrangement of GMDSS shore-based facilities will be notified to all relevant parties through GMDSS circulars.

Query_Text_cn: 1每艘船舶应设有在其整个预定航程中均能符合第4条所述之功能要求的无线电装置；除非按第3条已免除外，所有无线电装置应能符合第7条的要求以及第8、9、10或11条的要求（视预定航程所通过的海区或多个海区而定）。
Translation: 1 Every ship shall be provided with radio installations capable of complying with the functional requirements prescribed by regulation 4 throughout its intended voyage. Unless exempted under regulation 3, all radio installations shall meet the requirements of regulation 7 and those of regulations 8, 9, 10 or 11, as applicable to the sea area or sea areas through which the ship will pass during its intended voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 5清楚地标明船舶呼号，船舶电台识别码及适于无线电装置使用的其他代码。
Translation: 5 Clearly mark the ship's call sign, ship station identification number, and other codes applicable to radio equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 此要求可由手提式VHF设备来满足。
Translation: This requirement can be met by portable VHF equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4在客船上，遇险控制板应安装在指挥位置。
Translation: On passenger ships, the distress control panel shall be installed at the command position.

Query_Text_cn: 该控制板可以设有一个单独按钮，当按下这个按钮时，船上所有具有遇险报警功能的无线电通信装置发出遇险警报，或者为各个装置各设有一个按钮。
Translation: The control panel may be equipped with a single button that, when pressed, triggers distress alerts from all onboard radio communication devices with distress alerting capabilities, or it may have individual buttons for each device.

Query_Text_cn: 无论单按钮或多个按钮被按下时，控制板上均应有清晰的视觉显示。
Translation: The control panel shall provide clear visual indication whenever any single or multiple buttons are pressed.

Query_Text_cn: 应设有防止单按钮或多个按钮误操作的设施。
Translation: Facilities shall be provided to prevent accidental operation of single or multiple buttons.

Query_Text_cn: 如果卫星紧急无线电示位标用作发送遇险警报的第二种措施，且不能被遥控，则应可在驾驶室指挥位置附近安装一个附加的卫星紧急无线电示位标。
Translation: If the satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacon is used as a secondary means for distress alerting and cannot be remotely activated, an additional satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacon shall be installed near the conning position in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 5客船按下遇险控制板上的按钮时，应能连续和自动地将船舶位置资料传送至所有有关的无线电通信设备，包括原始的遇险警报。
Translation: When the button on the distress control panel of a passenger ship is pressed, it should continuously and automatically transmit the ship's position data to all relevant radio communication equipment, including the initial distress alert.

Query_Text_cn: 6对于客船，遇险报警板应安装在指挥位置。
Translation: For passenger ships, the distress alert panel shall be installed at the command position.

Query_Text_cn: 遇险报警板应能对任何遇险报警或船上收到的警告给出视觉和听觉指示，并且还应指示出通过何种无线电通信业务接收到该遇险警报。
Translation: The distress alarm panel shall be capable of providing visual and audible indications of any distress alert or warnings received on board, and shall also indicate through which radiocommunication service the distress alert was received.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1在156.525MHz（70频道）频率上的DSC。
Translation: 1.1 DSC on the frequency of 156.525 MHz (Channel 70).

Query_Text_cn: 51台接收来自Inmarsat增强群呼系统②的海上安全信息的无线电设备（如果船舶航行在Inmarsat所覆盖的，但不具有国际NAVTEX业务的任何区域内）。
Translation: Radio equipment capable of receiving maritime safety information via the Inmarsat enhanced group call system (if the ship is navigating in any area of Inmarsat coverage where international NAVTEX service is not available).

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果船舶仅航行在具有高频（HF）直接印字电报海上安全信息业务的区域，而且该船已装设了能接收这种业务的设备，则可免除本要求③。
Translation: However, if a ship navigates exclusively in areas where HF direct-printing telegraphy maritime safety information services are available and is equipped with the capability to receive such services, this requirement may be exempted.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5能人工启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: 6.5 Manual activation of distress alerts is possible.

Query_Text_cn: ①某些船舶可以免除该要求（见第9.4条）。
Translation: ①Certain vessels may be exempted from this requirement (see Article 9.4).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织A.705(17)决议通过的《关于发布海上安全信息的建议案》。
Translation: ③ Refer to the Recommendation on the Promulgation of Maritime Safety Information adopted by the Organization's Resolution A.705(17).

Query_Text_cn: ④参见关于搜救寻位能力的A.616(15)决议。
Translation: ④ Refer to Resolution A.616(15) concerning search and rescue locating capability.

Query_Text_cn: ⑤应考虑到Inmarsat卫星所覆盖的各个洋区相对应的进行接收和处理的地面设施的有效性。
Translation: ⑤ The effectiveness of the corresponding ground facilities for receiving and processing signals across the ocean regions covered by Inmarsat satellites should be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘客船都应设有从船舶通常驾驶的位置与现场用航空频率121.5MHz和123.1MHz进行以搜救为目的的双向无线电通信的设备。
Translation: Every passenger ship shall be provided with equipment for two-way on-scene radiocommunication for search and rescue purposes using the aeronautical frequencies 121.5 MHz and 123.1 MHz from the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 1在VHF频带上使用DSC工作。
Translation: 1 Working on DSC in the VHF band.

Query_Text_cn: 2通过在406MHz频率上工作的极轨道卫星业务来工作。
Translation: It operates through the polar-orbiting satellite service functioning at 406MHz.

Query_Text_cn: 5.2第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置或能从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: 5.2 The satellite EPIRB required by paragraph 7.1.6. The satellite EPIRB shall be located near the vessel's usual navigating position or be capable of remote activation from the vessel's usual navigating position.

Query_Text_cn: 2第7.1.1条所要求的VHF无线电装置还应能用无线电话发送和接收一般无线电通信。
Translation: The VHF radio installation required by paragraph 7.1.1 shall also be capable of transmitting and receiving general radiocommunications by radiotelephony.

Query_Text_cn: 3仅航行于A1海区的船舶可以装有1台EPIRB以代替第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。
Translation: Vessels navigating exclusively in Sea Area A1 may carry one EPIRB in lieu of the satellite EPIRB required under Section 7.1.6.

Query_Text_cn: 5能人工启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: 5. The distress alert can be manually activated.

Query_Text_cn: ①此要求可由能进行双向通信的Inmarsat船舶地面站来满足，如Inmarsa-A、Inmarsa-B和Fleet-77（A.808(19)决议和海安会决议MSC.130(75)）或Inmarsa-C（经修正的A.807(19)决议）。
Translation: ①This requirement may be met by an Inmarsat ship earth station capable of two-way communications, such as Inmarsat-A, Inmarsat-B and Fleet-77 (Resolutions A.808(19) and MSC.130(75)) or Inmarsat-C (Resolution A.807(19) as amended).

Query_Text_cn: 除另有说明外，本注释适用于对本章规定的Inmarsat船舶地面站的所有要求。
Translation: Unless otherwise specified, this note applies to all requirements for Inmarsat ship earth stations as stipulated in this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 21台能在2,187.5kHz频率上保持连续DSC值班的无线电装置。
Translation: 21 radio installations capable of maintaining continuous DSC watch on the frequency 2,187.5 kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.2第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置，或能从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: 3.3.2 The satellite EPIRB required by Section 7.1.6. Such satellite EPIRB shall be located near the position from which the ship is normally navigated or be capable of remote activation from that position.

Query_Text_cn: 2本条1.1和1.3所要求的无线电装置应能从船舶通常驾驶的位置启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: 2 The radio equipment required by paragraphs 1.1 and 1.3 shall be capable of initiating the transmission of distress alerts from the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 11台在1,605～4,000kHz或4,000～27,500kHz频率内工作的无线电装置。
Translation: 11 radio devices operating within the frequency range of 1,605 to 4,000 kHz or 4,000 to 27,500 kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 21台Inmarsat船舶地面站。
Translation: 21 Inmarsat ship earth stations.

Query_Text_cn: 4对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和第7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before 1 February 1997 and operating exclusively in Sea Area A2, the Administration may exempt them from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 when practicable, provided these ships maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF Channel 16 at the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 31台能在2,187.5kHz频率上保持连续DSC值班的无线电装置。
Translation: 31 radio installations capable of maintaining continuous DSC watch on the frequency 2,187.5 kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3通过Inmarsat静止卫星业务进行，增加一台船舶地面站或用第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB，该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置，或可以从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: 4.3 Via Inmarsat geostationary satellite services, by adding a ship earth station or using the satellite EPIRB required under paragraph 7.1.6. Such satellite EPIRB shall be located near the ship's normal navigating position or capable of being remotely activated from that position.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何时候，应能选择这些DSC遇险和安全频率中的任一频率。
Translation: At any time, it should be possible to select any of these DSC distress and safety frequencies.

Query_Text_cn: 4此外，船舶应能通过在1,605～4,000kHz和4,000～27,500kHz频带内的工作频率上工作的MF/HF无线电装置，使用无线电话或直接印字电报进行发送和接收一般无线电通信。
Translation: Additionally, vessels must be capable of transmitting and receiving general radio communications via MF/HF radio installations operating on working frequencies within the bands of 1,605 to 4,000 kHz and 4,000 to 27,500 kHz, using either radiotelephony or direct-printing telegraphy.

Query_Text_cn: 此要求可由上述.1所要求的设备增加该性能来满足。
Translation: This requirement can be met by adding the specified performance to the equipment as required in Section 1 above.

Query_Text_cn: 3在本条1.1、1.2、1.4、2.1和2.3中所规定的无线电装置应能从船舶通常驾驶的位置启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: The radio equipment prescribed in sections 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 2.1, and 2.3 shall be capable of initiating the transmission of distress alerts from the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 4对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2和A3海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before February 1, 1997, and operating exclusively in sea areas A2 and A3, the Administration may exempt them from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 when practicable, provided these ships maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF Channel 16 at the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 1航行于所有海区的船舶，除满足第7条的要求外，还应设有第10.2条所要求的无线电装置和设备，但是，不应接受用第10.2.3.2条所要求的设备替代第10.2.3.1条所要求的设备，因为第10.2.3.1条所要求的设备应始终是必备的。
Translation: 1. Ships operating in all sea areas shall, in addition to meeting the requirements of regulation 7, be provided with the radio installations and equipment required by regulation 10.2. However, the equipment required by regulation 10.2.3.2 shall not be accepted as a substitute for the equipment required by regulation 10.2.3.1, as the equipment specified in regulation 10.2.3.1 shall always be mandatory.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，航行于所有海区的船舶还应满足第10.3条的要求。
Translation: In addition, ships navigating in all sea areas shall also comply with the requirements of Article 10.3.

Query_Text_cn: 3根据第10.2.2条或11.1条的要求，安装有MF/HF无线电装置的船舶，在DSC遇险和安全频率2,187.5kHz和8,414.5kHz频率上以及至少在DSC遇险和安全频率4,207.5kHz、6,312kHz、12,577kHz或16,804.5kHz中的一个频率上保持连续值班，视一天中的时间和船舶所在的地理位置而定。
Translation: According to the requirements of Article 10.2.2 or 11.1, ships equipped with MF/HF radio installations shall maintain continuous watch on the DSC distress and safety frequencies 2,187.5 kHz and 8,414.5 kHz, as well as at least one of the DSC distress and safety frequencies 4,207.5 kHz, 6,312 kHz, 12,577 kHz, or 16,804.5 kHz, depending on the time of day and the geographical position of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 4根据第10.1.1条的要求，安装有Inmarsat船舶地面站的船舶，应对卫星岸对船的遇险报警保持连续值班。
Translation: In accordance with the requirements of Article 10.1.1, ships equipped with Inmarsat ship earth stations shall maintain continuous watch on satellite shore-to-ship distress alerts.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘船舶在海上时，应在向该船舶航行区域发布海上安全信息的适当频率或多个频率上，对海上安全信息的播发保持无线电值班。
Translation: Every ship at sea shall maintain a radio watch for broadcasts of maritime safety information on the appropriate frequency or frequencies on which such information is issued for the area in which the ship is navigating.

Query_Text_cn: 3至1999年2月1日或至海上安全委员会可能确定的其他日期①，每艘船舶在海上时，如实际可行，应在船舶通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班。
Translation: From 3rd to 1st February 1999 or until such other date as may be determined by the Maritime Safety Committee, every ship while at sea shall, if practicable, maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF Channel 16 from the place from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶在海上时，应始终可获得足够的电源供无线电装置工作，并对作为无线电装置的1个或多个备用电源组成部分的蓄电池进行充电。
Translation: 1 When at sea, a ship shall at all times have sufficient power available to supply the radio installations and to charge any batteries forming part of the reserve source of energy for the radio installations.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘船舶应设有1个或多个备用电源，当船舶主电源和应急电源发生故障时，向无线电装置供电，以便进行遇险和安全通信。
Translation: Every ship shall be provided with one or more reserve sources of energy to supply radio installations for the purpose of conducting distress and safety communications in the event of failure of the ship's main and emergency sources of electrical power.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于船舶配有的应急电源，如其不完全符合第II-1/42条或43条有关要求，包括向无线电装置供电，6h②。
Translation: For emergency power sources provided on ships, if they do not fully comply with the requirements of Regulation II-1/42 or 43, including power supply to radio installations, it shall be 6 hours②.

Query_Text_cn: ①海上安全委员会决定(MSC.131(75)决议)，所有GMDSS船舶在海上时，如切实可行，仍应继续在VHF的16频道上保持连续守听值班。
Translation: ① The Maritime Safety Committee has decided (Resolution MSC.131(75)) that all GMDSS ships, when at sea, shall, if practicable, continue to maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF Channel 16.

Query_Text_cn: ②作为指导，建议用以下公式来确定在遇险情况下对于每台无线电装置备用电源所能供给的电负荷：1/2发射所消耗的电流＋接收所消耗的电流＋任何附加负载消耗的电流。
Translation: ② As guidance, the following formula is recommended to determine the electrical load that can be supplied by the reserve power source for each radio installation in distress situations: 1/2 of the current consumed by transmission + the current consumed by reception + the current consumed by any additional load.

Query_Text_cn: 1个或多个备用电源不必同时向各自独立的HF和MF无线电装置供电。
Translation: One or more reserve sources of energy need not simultaneously supply the independent HF and MF radio installations.

Query_Text_cn: 31个或多个备用电源应独立于船舶推进动力及船舶电力系统。
Translation: Thirty-one or more emergency power sources shall be independent of the ship's propulsion power and electrical system.

Query_Text_cn: 2如果其他无线电装置中仅1台能同时和VHF无线电装置一起与1个或多个备用电源相连时，则应取其他无线电装置中耗电最大的1台。
Translation: 2 If only one of the other radio installations can be simultaneously connected with the VHF radio installation to one or more reserve sources of electrical energy, the other radio installation with the highest power consumption shall be selected.

Query_Text_cn: 51个或多个备用电源可以用来向第6.2.4条所要求的电气照明供电。
Translation: Fifty-one or more standby power sources may be used to supply the electrical lighting required by Section 6.2.4.

Query_Text_cn: 2应在不超过12个月的间隔期内，使用适当的方法①对不在航的船舶检查蓄电池或蓄电池组的容量。
Translation: 2 The capacity of batteries or battery banks in non-operational ships should be checked using appropriate methods① at intervals not exceeding 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 5在任何气候条件下，充足电的蓄电池应至少满足所要求的最少工作小时数。
Translation: A fully charged battery must meet the required minimum operating hours under any climatic conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 8如果需要将船舶的导航或其他设备的信息连续输入到本章要求的无线电装置（包括第18条中所述的导航接收装置）中以确保其适当的性能，应具有能确保在船舶主电源或应急电源发生故障时继续提供此类信息的措施。
Translation: 8 Where it is necessary to continuously input information from the ship's navigation or other equipment into the radio installation required by this chapter (including the navigation receiver equipment referred to in regulation 18) to ensure its proper performance, measures shall be provided to ensure the continued supply of such information in the event of failure of the ship's main or emergency power source.

Query_Text_cn: ①检查蓄电池容量的一种方法是，用正常工作电流和时间（例如10h）对蓄电池彻底地放电和充电。
Translation: One method to test battery capacity is to fully discharge and recharge it with the normal operating current over a specified time period, such as 10 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何时候都可对充电情况进行评定，但是，当船舶在海上时，不应进行大量放电。
Translation: The charging status can be assessed at any time, but significant discharging should not be performed while the vessel is at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 1本章适用的所有设备应为主管机关认可的型式。
Translation: All equipment covered in this chapter shall be of a type approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 这些设备所符合的相应性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: The corresponding performance standards that these equipment comply with shall not be inferior to the performance standards adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1A.525(13)决议《船舶航行和气象警报以及紧急信息的窄带直接印字电报设备的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 1A.525(13) "Performance Standards for Narrow-Band Direct-Printing Telegraph Equipment for the Reception of Navigational and Meteorological Warnings and Urgent Information by Ships".

Query_Text_cn: 2A.694(17)决议《作为全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)组成部分的船载无线电设备和电子导航设备的一般要求》。
Translation: Resolution 2A.694(17) "General Requirements for Shipborne Radio Equipment and Electronic Navigation Aids as Part of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS)."

Query_Text_cn: 3A.808(19)决议《经修正的能进行双向通信的船舶地面站性能标准》和A.570(14)决议《船舶地面站的型式认可》及MSC.130(75)决议《能进行双向通信的Inmarsat船舶地面站性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 3A.808(19) "Performance Standards for Ship Earth Stations Capable of Two-Way Communications, as Amended," Resolution A.570(14) "Type Approval of Ship Earth Stations," and Resolution MSC.130(75) "Performance Standards for Inmarsat Ship Earth Stations Capable of Two-Way Communications."

Query_Text_cn: 4A.803(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话和数字选择呼叫的船载VHF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件1（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 4A.803(19) "Performance Standards for Shipborne VHF Radio Installations Capable of Voice Communication and Digital Selective Calling, as amended" and Annex 1 of MSC Resolution MSC.68(68) (applicable to equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 5A.804(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话和数字选择呼叫的船载MF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件2（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 5A.804(19) "Performance Standards for Shipborne MF Radio Installations Capable of Voice Communication and Digital Selective Calling, as Amended" and Annex 2 of MSC Resolution MSC.68(68) (applicable to equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 6A.806(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话、窄带直接印字和数字选择呼叫的船载MF/HF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件3（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 6A.806(19) "Performance Standards for Shipborne MF/HF Radio Installations Capable of Voice Communication, Narrow-Band Direct-Printing and Digital Selective Calling, as amended" and Annex 3 of MSC Resolution 68(68) (effective for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 7A.810(19)决议《在406MHz频率上工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）的性能标准》和海安会决议MSC.120(74)《通过在406MHz频率上工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）性能标准（A.810(19)决议）的修正案》（还参见A.696(17)决议《在COSPAS SARSAT系统工作的卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）的型式认可》）。
Translation: Resolution A.810(19) "Performance Standards for Float-Free Satellite Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating on 406 MHz" and MSC Resolution MSC.120(74) "Adoption of Amendments to the Performance Standards for Float-Free Satellite Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating on 406 MHz (Resolution A.810(19))" (see also Resolution A.696(17) "Type Approval of Satellite Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating in the COSPAS-SARSAT System").

Query_Text_cn: 8A.802(19)决议《用于搜救作业的救生艇筏雷达应答器的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 8A.802(19) "Performance Standards for Radar Transponders for Use in Search and Rescue Operations on Lifeboats and Liferafts."

Query_Text_cn: 9A.805(19)决议《自浮式VHF应急无线电示位标的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution A.805(19) on Performance Standards for Float-Free VHF Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs).

Query_Text_cn: 10A.807(19)决议《经修正的能发射和接收直接印字通信的Inmarsat-C船舶地面站的性能标准》,海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件3（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）和A.570(14)决议《船舶地面站的型式认可》。
Translation: Resolution 10A.807(19) "Performance Standards for Inmarsat-C Ship Earth Stations Capable of Transmitting and Receiving Direct-Printing Communications, as amended," Annex 3 to MSC Resolution 68(68) (applicable to equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000), and Resolution A.570(14) "Type Approval of Ship Earth Stations."

Query_Text_cn: 11A.664(16)决议《增强的群呼设备的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 11A.664(16) "Performance Standards for Enhanced Group Call Equipment."

Query_Text_cn: 12A.812(19)决议《在1.6GHz频率上通过Inmarsat对地静止卫星系统工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution A.812(19) "Performance Standards for Float-Free Satellite Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating Through the Inmarsat Geostationary Satellite System on 1.6 GHz."

Query_Text_cn: 13A.662(16)决议《应急无线电设备的自浮释放和启动装置的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 13A.662(16) "Performance Standards for Float-Free Release and Activation Arrangements of Emergency Radio Equipment."

Query_Text_cn: 14A.699(17)决议《使用高频窄带直接印字技术进行海上安全信息播发和协调的系统性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution A.699(17) Performance Standards for Systems Using High-Frequency Narrow-Band Direct-Printing Techniques for the Dissemination and Coordination of Maritime Safety Information.

Query_Text_cn: 15MSC.148(77)决议《通过经修订的接收船舶航行和气象警告以及紧急信息的窄带直接印字电报设备（NAVTEX）的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution MSC.148(77) on the Adoption of the Revised Performance Standards for Narrow-Band Direct-Printing Telegraph Equipment for the Reception of Navigational and Meteorological Warnings and Urgent Information to Ships (NAVTEX).

Query_Text_cn: 16A.811(19)决议《在GMDSS中使用的船载无线电综合通信系统（IRCS）的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution A.811(19) "Performance Standards for Shipborne Integrated Radiocommunication Systems (IRCS) for Use in the GMDSS."

Query_Text_cn: 17MSC.80(70)决议附件1《航空双向便携式VHF无线电话设备性能标准》。
Translation: Annex 1 to Resolution MSC.80(70) "Performance Standards for Aeronautical Two-Way Portable VHF Radiotelephone Apparatus".

Query_Text_cn: 1设备的设计应使主要部件能易于更换而无需仔细地重新校准或调整。
Translation: The design of the equipment shall ensure that major components can be easily replaced without the need for meticulous recalibration or adjustment.

Query_Text_cn: 2若适合，设备的构造和安装应便于进行检查和船上维修。
Translation: 2 Where practicable, the construction and installation of equipment shall facilitate inspection and onboard maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 3考虑到本组织的建议案①，应备有足够的资料，以便对设备进行正确的操作和维修。
Translation: 3 In consideration of the recommendations of this organization①, sufficient documentation should be made available to enable the correct operation and maintenance of the equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4应备有足够的工具和备件以便能对设备进行维修。
Translation: A sufficient supply of tools and spare parts shall be available to facilitate equipment maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 5主管机关应确保本章要求的无线电设备可予维修，以保证第4条规定的功能要求的有效性，并满足对这些设备所建议的性能标准。
Translation: The competent authority shall ensure that the radio equipment required by this chapter is maintainable to guarantee the effectiveness of the functional requirements specified in Article 4 and to meet the recommended performance standards for such equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 6航行在A1和A2海区的船舶，应使用可能经主管机关认可的，诸如双套设备、岸上维修或海上电子维修能力的方法，或其组合，以确保功能要求的有效性。
Translation: Vessels navigating in Sea Areas A1 and A2 shall employ methods, such as duplicate equipment, shore-based maintenance, or at-sea electronic maintenance capability, or a combination thereof, as may be approved by the competent authority, to ensure the effectiveness of functional requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 7航行在A3和A4海区的船舶，考虑到本组织的建议案②，应使用可能经主管机关认可的至少二种组合方法，如双套设备、岸上维修或海上电子维修能力，以确保功能要求的有效性。
Translation: Vessels navigating in sea areas A3 and A4, taking into account the recommendations of this organization, shall employ at least two combined methods—such as duplicate equipment, shore-based maintenance, or at-sea electronic maintenance capability—approved by the competent authority where applicable, to ensure the effectiveness of functional requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 8虽然应采取一切合理的步骤使设备保持有效的工作状态，以确保符合第4条规定的所有功能要求，但是只要船舶能够实施所有的遇险安全功能，在第4.8条所要求的用于提供一般无线电通信的设备发生故障的情况下不应认为该船舶不适航，或作为使船舶滞留在不易提供维修设施的港口的理由。
Translation: Although all reasonable steps shall be taken to maintain the equipment in an efficient working condition to ensure compliance with all the functional requirements specified in regulation 4, the ship shall not be considered unseaworthy or as a reason for detaining the ship in a port where repair facilities are not readily available, provided that the ship is capable of performing all distress and safety functions, in the event of failure of equipment required for general radiocommunications as prescribed in regulation 4.8.

Query_Text_cn: 9卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）应在不超过12个月的间隔期内，对其操作有效性的各个方面进行测试，着重注意频率的稳定性、信号强度和编码。
Translation: 9 Satellite Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) shall be tested at intervals not exceeding 12 months for all aspects of operational effectiveness, with particular attention to frequency stability, signal strength, and coding.

Query_Text_cn: 但如认为适当和合理时，主管机关可将期限延长至17个月。
Translation: However, the competent authority may extend the period to 17 months if deemed appropriate and reasonable.

Query_Text_cn: 测试可在船上或经认可的测试站或检修站进行。
Translation: Testing may be conducted on board or at an approved testing station or repair facility.

Query_Text_cn: 1每艘船舶应配有主管机关满意的、能胜任遇险和安全无线电通信的人员。
Translation: Every ship shall carry personnel qualified for distress and safety radiocommunication to the satisfaction of the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: ③这些人员应持有无线电规则中规定的适当证书。在遇险时，应指定其中任何人员担负起无线电通信的主要责任。
Translation: ③These personnel shall hold the appropriate certificates specified in the Radio Regulations. In the event of distress, any one of them shall be designated to assume primary responsibility for radio communications.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.694(17)决议通过的《关于作为全球海上遇险和安全系统组成部分的船载无线电设备和电子导航设备一般要求的建议案》，以及A.813(19)决议中关于船舶的所有电气电子设备的电磁兼容性（EMC）的一般要求和海安会通函MSC/Circ.862《IMO对GMDSS设备性能标准有关要求的澄清》。
Translation: ① Refer to the Recommendation on General Requirements for Shipborne Radio Equipment and Electronic Navigation Aids as Part of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), adopted by IMO Resolution A.694(17), as well as the general requirements for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of all electrical and electronic equipment on ships set forth in Resolution A.813(19), and MSC/Circ.862 "Clarification of IMO Requirements for GMDSS Equipment Performance Standards."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.702(17)决议中关于A3和A4海区的全球海上遇险和安全系统的无线电维修指南。
Translation: ② Refer to the radio maintenance guidelines for the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) in sea areas A3 and A4 as outlined in Resolution A.702(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见STCW规则第IV章第B-IV/2节。
Translation: ③ Refer to STCW Code, Chapter IV, Section B-IV/2.

Query_Text_cn: 2客船上，至少应指派一名按本条1要求的有资格的人员，在遇险时只执行无线电通信责任。
Translation: On passenger ships, at least one qualified person as required by paragraph 1 of this article shall be assigned to perform radio communication duties exclusively in the event of distress.

Query_Text_cn: 应备有使主管机关满意并符合无线电规则要求的无线电记录，该记录应记载对于海上人命安全显然具有重要性的与无线电通信业务有关的所有遇险事故。
Translation: A radio log shall be maintained to the satisfaction of the Administration and in accordance with the Radio Regulations, containing a record of all distress incidents related to radio communication services that are clearly of vital importance to the safety of life at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 适用本章的船舶，其船上备有的能在遇险报警时自动报告船位的所有双向通信设备，均应自动从内部或外部导航接收装置（如设有）获得该信息。
Translation: For ships to which this chapter applies, all two-way communication equipment on board capable of automatically reporting the ship's position in the event of a distress alert shall automatically obtain such information from internal or external navigation receiving devices, if fitted.

Query_Text_cn: 如果未安装这种接收装置，则船舶在航行中的位置以及船位确定的时间应按不超过4小时的间隔期手动更新，以便随时可由该设备发送。
Translation: If such receiving equipment is not installed, the ship's position during navigation and the time of position determination shall be manually updated at intervals not exceeding 4 hours to ensure they can be transmitted by the equipment at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 2对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2、A3和A4海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before 1 February 1997 and operating exclusively in sea areas A2, A3, and A4, the Administration may exempt them from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 when practicable, provided these ships maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 at the position from which the ship is normally navigated.

Query_Text_cn: 2专门航行于北美洲五大湖以及与其连接的东至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣拉姆伯特船闸下游出口处为止的水域及支流的船舶。
Translation: 2. Vessels exclusively navigating the waters and tributaries of the Great Lakes of North America and their connecting waters, extending eastward to the downstream exit of the Saint-Lambert Lock in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，仍鼓励军舰、海军辅助船或由缔约国政府拥有或经营的仅用于政府非商业性目的的其他船舶在合理和可行的范围内，与本章保持一致。
Translation: However, warships, naval auxiliaries, or other vessels owned or operated by a State Party and used only for government non-commercial service are still encouraged to comply with this chapter to the extent reasonable and practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关可决定本章对仅在按国际法规定的基准线以内（向岸一侧）水域营运的船舶适用范围。
Translation: 2 The competent authority may determine the applicability of this chapter to ships operating solely in waters landward of the baseline as defined by international law.

Query_Text_cn: 3就本章而言，顶推船舶和被顶推船舶的刚性连接混合单元，当其设计成专用的整体拖船和驳船组合体时，应视为单一船舶。
Translation: For the purposes of this chapter, a rigidly connected composite unit of pushing vessel and pushed vessel shall be regarded as a single vessel when designed as an integrated tug and barge combination.

Query_Text_cn: 3渔船。
Translation: Three fishing vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 3该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly of the vessel has commenced with a minimum quantity of 50 tons or 1% of the estimated total weight of structural materials, whichever is less.

Query_Text_cn: 2海图或航海出版物系指专用的图或书，或支持这种图或书的经特殊编辑的数据库，由政府主管当局，经授权的水文局或其他相关的政府机构正式颁布，用于满足航海要求①。
Translation: 2 Nautical chart or nautical publication means a special-purpose map or book, or a specially compiled database supporting such map or book, officially issued by a government-authorized hydrographic office or other relevant government institution for the purpose of meeting maritime navigation requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 3所有船舶系指所有船或艇，而不论其类型和用途。
Translation: 3 All vessels refer to any ship or boat, regardless of type or purpose.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织关于沿岸国根据第9条提供海图的权利和责任的相应决议和建议。
Translation: ① Refer to the relevant resolutions and recommendations of the International Hydrographic Organization concerning the rights and responsibilities of coastal states to provide nautical charts in accordance with Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关对无机械推进装置的船舶可准予全面免除第15、17、18、19（19.2.1.7除外）、20、22、24、25、26、27和28条的要求。
Translation: 1. The competent authority may grant full exemptions from the requirements of Articles 15,17,18,19 (except 19.2.1.7),20,22,24,25,26,27 and 28 to vessels without mechanical means of propulsion.

Query_Text_cn: 2如个别船舶所从事的航行，其距岸的最大距离、航程的长短和性质、大体上无航行危险以及影响安全的其他情况使完全实施本章的规定成为不合理或不必要时，主管机关可对任何这种船舶准予部分或有条件的免除或等效，但主管机关必须事先考虑到这种免除和等效对所有其他船舶的安全可能产生的影响。
Translation: 2 Where the maximum distance from shore, the length and nature of the voyage, the absence of general navigational hazards, and other circumstances affecting safety are such as to render the full application of this chapter unreasonable or unnecessary, the Administration may grant partial or conditional exemptions or equivalents to any such ship. However, the Administration must first consider the potential impact of such exemptions or equivalents on the safety of all other ships.

Query_Text_cn: 3各主管机关应在每年的1月1日以后尽快向本组织提交一份报告，该报告应汇总上一日历年度内按本条2之规定准予的所有新的免除和等效并说明准予这种免除和等效的理由。
Translation: Each competent authority shall submit a report to the Organization as soon as possible after 1 January each year, summarizing all new exemptions and equivalences granted under paragraph 2 of this article during the previous calendar year and stating the reasons for granting such exemptions and equivalences.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织应将这些内容分发给其他缔约国政府，以供参考。
Translation: The organization shall distribute these contents to other States Parties for reference.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应采取所有必要的步骤，确保其从任何可靠的来源获悉危险的情报时，迅速通知有关各方并传送到其他相关的国家政府①。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall take all necessary steps to ensure that when it receives information of a dangerous nature from any reliable source, it shall promptly notify the parties concerned and transmit the information to other relevant national governments.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，鼓励海上船舶收集气象资料，并用最适宜于助航目的方式安排这些资料的审查、传送和交换②。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Government undertakes to encourage the collection of meteorological data by ships at sea and to arrange for their examination, dissemination, and exchange in the manner most suitable for the purpose of aiding navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应鼓励使用高度精确的气象仪器，并应于接到校核此种仪器的请求时给予便利。
Translation: The competent authority shall encourage the use of highly accurate meteorological instruments and shall facilitate requests for their calibration when received.

Query_Text_cn: 国家相应的气象服务机构可作出安排，免费向船舶提供这种校核。
Translation: The relevant national meteorological service may make arrangements to provide such verification to ships free of charge.

Query_Text_cn: 1使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发出信息，警告船舶注意强风，风暴和热带气旋。
Translation: 1. Utilize corresponding shore-based facilities of land and space radiocommunication services to issue warnings in text format and, where practicable, in graphical format to alert vessels to strong winds, storms, and tropical cyclones.

Query_Text_cn: 2每日至少2次通过相应的陆地和空间无线电通信服务③发出适用于航运的气象信息，其中包括天气、波浪和冰的数据、分析、警报和预报。
Translation: Issue meteorological information applicable to shipping at least twice daily via corresponding terrestrial and space-based radiocommunication services, including weather, wave and ice data, analyses, warnings and forecasts.

Query_Text_cn: 这些信息应以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发送，其中包括通过传真或以数字形式发送的气象分析和预测图象，供船上数据处理系统重新编制。
Translation: This information shall be transmitted in text form and, as far as practicable, in graphical format, including meteorological analysis and forecast charts sent via facsimile or in digital form for onboard data processing systems to reconstitute.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.706(17)决议通过的经修正的《IMO/IHO全球航行警报服务导则》。
Translation: ①Refer to the amended IMO/IHO Worldwide Navigational Warning Service Guidelines adopted by the Organization by resolution A.706(17).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.528(13)决议通过的《关于气象航线划定的建议案》。
Translation: ② See the Recommendation on the Delineation of Meteorological Routes adopted by the Organization in resolution A.528(13).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见第IV/7.1.4和IV/7.1.5条。
Translation: ③ See Articles IV/7.1.4 and IV/7.1.5.

Query_Text_cn: 3编制并发行供海上顺利开展气象工作所可能需要的出版物（如可行时），并安排发布及提供每日天气图供出航船舶参考。
Translation: 3. Prepare and issue publications that may be necessary for the effective conduct of meteorological work at sea (where feasible), and arrange for the dissemination and provision of daily weather charts for the reference of vessels at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 4安排选定的船舶装设经过校验的船用气象仪器（例如气压计、气压记录仪、湿度计及测量海水温度的适宜仪器），以供气象服务之用，并使其在主要标准时进行气象观测且记录和发送观测结果（如环境许可，每日至少4次），作为海面天气形势分析之用，并鼓励其他船舶用变通方式进行观测且记录和发送观测结果，特别是在航船稀少的区域。
Translation: 4. Arrange for selected ships to be equipped with calibrated marine meteorological instruments (such as barometers, barographs, hygrometers, and suitable instruments for measuring seawater temperature) for meteorological services. Ensure these ships conduct meteorological observations at major standard times, record and transmit the observations (at least four times daily when conditions permit) for surface weather analysis.
