Encourage other ships to adopt alternative methods for conducting, recording, and transmitting observations, particularly in areas with sparse shipping traffic.

Query_Text_cn: 5鼓励船公司尽可能多地将其船舶投入到气象观测和记录工作中；观测结果使用船舶陆地或空间无线电通信设备发送，以使各国气象服务机构受益。
Translation: 5. Encourage shipping companies to deploy as many vessels as possible for meteorological observation and recording; transmit the observation results using ship-to-shore or space-based radio communication equipment to benefit meteorological services worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 6这些气象观测结果免费向有关船舶发送。
Translation: These meteorological observations are disseminated free of charge to relevant vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 7当在热带气旋或疑似热带气旋附近时，应鼓励船舶尽可能增加其观测和发送观测结果的次数，但应牢记船上驾驶员在风暴情况下需先行处理的航行任务。
Translation: When in the vicinity of a tropical cyclone or suspected tropical cyclone, ships should be encouraged to increase the frequency of their observations and transmissions as much as possible, bearing in mind the navigational duties that must be prioritized by the officer on watch under storm conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 8使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备，安排接收来自船舶和向船舶发送气象信息。
Translation: 8. Utilize corresponding shore-based facilities of land and space radiocommunication services to arrange for the reception and transmission of meteorological information to and from ships.

Query_Text_cn: 9鼓励船长在遇到风速50kn或以上（蒲福风级10级）时，通知附近船舶及海岸电台。
Translation: 9. Encourage the shipmaster to notify nearby vessels and coast radio stations when encountering winds of 50 knots or above (Beaufort scale force 10).

Query_Text_cn: 10努力使上述国际气象服务获得统一程序，并尽可能地符合世界气象组织提出的技术规则和建议。
Translation: 10. Endeavor to standardize the aforementioned international meteorological services in accordance with unified procedures and align them as closely as possible with the technical regulations and recommendations set forth by the World Meteorological Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可以将执行本公约过程中可能产生的任何气象问题提交世界气象组织研究和征求意见。
Translation: The governments of the Contracting Parties may submit any meteorological issues arising from the implementation of this Convention to the World Meteorological Organization for study and consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 3应以发送格式提交本条所规定的信息，并按《无线电规则》规定的优先顺序发送，在“向所有电台”发送气象信息、预报和警报时，所有船舶电台都必须遵守《无线电规则》的规定。
Translation: The information specified in this section shall be submitted in the prescribed transmission format and dispatched in the order of priority as stipulated in the Radio Regulations. When meteorological information, forecasts, and warnings are broadcast "to all stations," all ship stations must comply with the provisions of the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 4供船舶使用的预报、警报、天气形势和其他气象资料，应按有关缔约国政府间的共同协定，特别是按世界气象组织系统为针对全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）范围内的公海编制和传播气象预报和警报所规定的要求，由具备最佳位置为不同沿海和公海区域服务的国家气象服务机构进行发布和传送。
Translation: Forecasts, warnings, weather synopses, and other meteorological data intended for ships shall be issued and disseminated by the national meteorological service best situated to serve various coastal and high seas areas, in accordance with mutual agreements among the governments of the Contracting Parties concerned, particularly as required by the World Meteorological Organization's system for the preparation and dissemination of meteorological forecasts and warnings within the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) for the high seas.

Query_Text_cn: 1冰区巡逻有助于在北大西洋内的海上人命安全、航行安全和航行效率以及海洋环境保护。
Translation: Ice patrols contribute to maritime safety of life, navigation safety and efficiency, as well as marine environmental protection in the North Atlantic.

Query_Text_cn: 在冰季期间穿越由冰区巡逻警戒的冰山区的船舶，应要求使用冰区巡逻所提供的服务。
Translation: During the ice season, vessels transiting through iceberg areas patrolled by the Ice Patrol are required to utilize the services provided by the Ice Patrol.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，继续担任北大西洋冰区巡逻和冰情的研究与观测服务。
Translation: The governments of the Contracting Parties undertake the obligation to continue providing the North Atlantic ice patrol service and conducting research and observation on ice conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 在整个冰季期间，即每年的2月15日至7月1日，在纽芬兰大浅滩附近冰山区的东南、南及西南界限应予警戒，以便将该危险区的范围通知过往船舶，研究浮冰的一般情况以及对巡逻船舶和飞机活动区内的船舶和船员提供所需的帮助。
Translation: During the entire ice season, from February 15 to July 1 each year, vigilance shall be maintained along the southeastern, southern, and southwestern boundaries of the iceberg zone near the Grand Banks of Newfoundland. This is to notify passing vessels of the hazardous area's extent, study general ice conditions, and provide necessary assistance to ships and crews within the patrol vessels' and aircraft's operational zones.

Query_Text_cn: 在一年其余时间内也应适当保持对冰情的研究与观测。
Translation: Research and observation of ice conditions should also be appropriately maintained throughout the rest of the year.

Query_Text_cn: 3用于供冰区巡逻服务及研究与观测冰情的船舶和飞机，可担任分配的其他任务，但这些其他任务不得妨碍本服务工作的原有目的或增加其费用。
Translation: 3 For ships and aircraft used in ice patrol services and for research and observation of ice conditions, they may undertake other assigned tasks, provided that such additional tasks do not hinder the original purpose of this service or increase its costs.

Query_Text_cn: 4美利坚合众国政府同意继续全面管理冰区巡逻服务及冰情的研究与观测，包括传播由此得到的信息。
Translation: 4. The Government of the United States of America agrees to continue the comprehensive management of the ice patrol service and the research and observation of ice conditions, including the dissemination of information derived therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 5在本章的附录《北大西洋冰区巡逻管理、运作和费用规则》中阐明了适用于冰区巡逻之管理、运作和费用的各项条件，该附录是本章一个组成部分。
Translation: The conditions governing the management, operation, and cost of the Ice Patrol are set forth in the appendix to this chapter, titled "Rules for the Management, Operation, and Cost of the North Atlantic Ice Patrol," which forms an integral part of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 6无论何时，美利坚合众国政府和/或加拿大政府如欲中止提供这些服务，即可以这样做，并且各缔约国政府应根据其共同利益解决继续这些服务的问题。
Translation: 6At any time, the Government of the United States of America and/or the Government of Canada may discontinue the provision of these services and the respective Contracting Government shall address the matter of continuing such services as in their mutual interest.

Query_Text_cn: 美利坚合众国和/或加拿大政府对于在中止提供这些服务之前受益于这些服务且获准悬挂缔约国国旗的船舶和在缔约国政府已延用本条要求的领土内注册的船舶，应提前18个月向所有有关缔约国政府发出中止服务的书面通知。
Translation: The Governments of the United States of America and/or Canada shall provide a written notice of termination of services to all concerned Contracting Governments at least 18 months in advance for ships entitled to fly the flag of a Contracting Government that were benefiting from these services prior to their termination, as well as for ships registered in territories where the Contracting Government has extended the application of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，确保为其负责区域内的遇险通信和相互协调并为营救其海岸附近的海上遇险者作出必要的安排。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Government undertakes to ensure that distress communications and mutual coordination are provided for within its area of responsibility and to make the necessary arrangements for the rescue of persons in distress at sea near its coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 这些安排，考虑到海上交通的密度和航行障碍物的密度，应包括视为实际可行和必要的搜救设施的建立、运转和维护，并应尽可能提供足够的寻找和营救遇险人员的设备①。
Translation: These arrangements, taking into account the density of maritime traffic and the density of navigational hazards, shall include the establishment, operation, and maintenance of such search and rescue facilities as are deemed practicable and necessary, and shall provide, as far as possible, adequate equipment for locating and rescuing persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，向本组织提供其现有搜救设施的资料以及对其中内容所作的更改方案（如有）。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes to provide the Organization with information on its existing search and rescue facilities and any changes thereto, if any.

Query_Text_cn: 3适用第I章的客船，应备有在紧急情况下与相应的搜寻和救助机构合作的计划。
Translation: Passenger ships to which chapter I applies shall have a plan for cooperation with the relevant search and rescue services in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应由船舶、第IX/1条所定义的公司以及搜救机构共同制定。
Translation: The plan shall be developed jointly by the ship, the company as defined in regulation IX/1, and search and rescue authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应包括要进行定期演习以证明该计划有效性的规定。
Translation: The plan shall include provisions for conducting regular exercises to demonstrate its effectiveness.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应根据本组织制定的指南而编制。
Translation: The plan shall be prepared in accordance with the guidelines established by the organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《1979年国际海上搜寻救助（SAR）公约》和本组织通过的下列决议：《搜救飞机的自导能力》（A.225(VII)决议）、《雷达应答器用于搜寻和救助》（A.530(13)决议）、《搜救自导能力》（A.616(15)决议）和《国际航空海上搜寻和救助手册（IAMSAR）》（A.894(21)决议）。
Translation: ① Reference is made to the International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR), 1979 and the following resolutions adopted by the Organization: Self-contained survival craft radio equipment (resolution A.225(VII)), Radar transponders for search and rescue purposes (resolution A.530(13)), Self-contained survival craft radio equipment (resolution A.616(15)) and the International Aeronautical and Maritime Search and Rescue (IAMSAR) Manual (resolution A.894(21)).

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府承担义务作好安排，使从事搜救工作的搜救设施在与遇险船舶或遇险人员通信时使用救生信号。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes to make arrangements for the use of lifesaving signals by rescue facilities engaged in search and rescue operations when communicating with ships in distress or persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，安排水文资料的收集和编制，并且出版、传播以及不断更新为安全航行所必需的所有航海资料。
Translation: 1 Each Contracting Government undertakes to arrange for the collection, compilation, and publication of hydrographic data, as well as the dissemination and continuous updating of all nautical information essential for safe navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 4提供数据管理安排以支持这些服务。
Translation: 4. Provide data management arrangements to support these services.

Query_Text_cn: 3各缔约国政府承担义务，确保尽最大可能统一海图和航海出版物，并且无论何时都要考虑到有关的国际决议和建议①。
Translation: 3 Each Contracting Government undertakes to ensure the greatest possible uniformity in charts and sailing directions and to take into account any relevant international resolutions and recommendations at all times①.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府承担义务以最大程度协调其活动，确保在全球范围内尽可能及时、可靠并明确地提供水文和航行资料。
Translation: The Contracting Governments undertake to coordinate their activities to the greatest possible extent, ensuring the timely, reliable, and unambiguous provision of hydrographic and navigational information worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶航线划定系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: 1 The ship routeing system is beneficial to the safety of life at sea, navigation safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment.

Query_Text_cn: 如采纳和实施本组织制定的指南和衡准②，建议所有船舶，某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶使用船舶航线划定系统，这也可以作为强制性要求。
Translation: The adoption and implementation of guidelines and criteria developed by this organization may recommend the use of ship routeing systems for all ships, certain types of ships, or ships carrying certain cargoes, which may also be made mandatory.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶航线划定系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The organization is the sole internationally recognized body responsible for developing international guidelines, criteria, and regulations for ship routeing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将通过船舶航线划定系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall submit proposals for the adoption of ship routeing systems to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶航线划定系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: The organization shall verify all relevant information on all adopted ship routeing systems and distribute it to the governments of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织通过的相应决议和建议。
Translation: ①Refer to the corresponding resolutions and recommendations adopted by the International Hydrographic Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: ② See the revised General Provisions on Ships' Routeing adopted by the Organization by resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶航线划定系统是各有关国家政府的责任。
Translation: It is the responsibility of the respective national governments to initiate the establishment of a ship route delineation system.

Query_Text_cn: 为使本组织通过此系统，在建立这类系统时应考虑到本组织制订的指南及衡准。
Translation: To enable the organization to adopt this system, the guidelines and criteria established by the organization should be taken into consideration when setting up such systems.

Query_Text_cn: 4船舶航线划定系统应提交本组织通过。
Translation: 4 The ship routeing system shall be submitted to the Organization for adoption.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于一国或多国政府实施的船舶航线划定系统不准备提交本组织通过或未经本组织通过，则鼓励其尽可能考虑本组织制订的指南及衡准①。
Translation: However, ship-routeing systems implemented by one or more Governments without the intention of submission to or adoption by the Organization are encouraged to take into account, as far as practicable, the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定联合提案明确说明他们对该区域船舶航线划定系统的表述和使用。
Translation: If two or more governments have a common interest in a particular area, they should formulate joint proposals on the basis of agreement among themselves, clearly stating their views on the delineation and use of the ship routeing system in that area.

Query_Text_cn: 收到此提案并开始考虑其是否通过之前，本组织应确保把该提案的详细内容分发给共同关注此地区的政府，包括在此船舶航线划定系统附近的国家。
Translation: Before considering the adoption of this proposal, the organization shall ensure that the details of the proposal are distributed to governments with shared interests in the region, including those of nations adjacent to this ship route delineation system.

Query_Text_cn: 6缔约国政府应遵守本组织通过的关于船舶航线划定系统的措施。
Translation: 6. The governments of the Contracting Parties shall comply with the measures adopted by the Organization regarding ship routeing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 他们应公布安全有效地使用船舶航线划定系统所必需的资料。
Translation: They shall publish the information necessary for the safe and effective use of ship routeing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的一国或多国政府可监督这些系统的运行。
Translation: The relevant government or governments may oversee the operation of these systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应在其权力范围内全力确保适当使用本组织通过的船舶航线划定系统。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall exert its utmost efforts, within its competence, to ensure the proper use of ship routeing systems adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 7船舶应按其船型或运载货物的要求，使用本组织通过的强制性船舶航线划定系统，并符合现行的有关规定，除非有不使用船舶航线划定系统的令人信服的理由。
Translation: Ships shall, in accordance with their type or the nature of the cargo carried, use the mandatory ship routing systems adopted by the Organization and comply with the relevant provisions in force, unless there are compelling reasons justifying non-compliance with such routing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些理由应记录于船舶日志内。
Translation: All such reasons shall be recorded in the ship's log.

Query_Text_cn: 8强制性的船舶航线划定系统应由各有关缔约国政府按照本组织制定的指南和衡准①审核。
Translation: 8 The mandatory ship routing system shall be reviewed by the respective Contracting Government concerned in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 9所有已通过的船舶航线划定系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括1982年联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All adopted ship routeing systems and actions taken to implement them shall conform to international law, including the relevant provisions of the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

Query_Text_cn: 10本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in this Article and the associated guidelines and criteria shall prejudice the rights and obligations of governments under international law or the legal regimes concerning international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶报告系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: 1. The ship reporting system is beneficial to maritime life safety, navigation safety and efficiency, and/or marine environmental protection.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶报告系统在按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准③予以通过并实施后，应按每个所通过的系统的规定适用于所有船舶或某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶。
Translation: After the ship reporting system has been adopted and implemented in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization pursuant to the requirements of this regulation, it shall apply to all ships, certain categories of ships, or ships carrying certain cargoes, as specified in each adopted system.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶报告系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The organization is the sole internationally recognized body for developing international guidelines, criteria, and regulations for ship reporting systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将采用船舶报告系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall submit proposals for the adoption of ship reporting systems to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶报告系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: The organization shall verify all information concerning all adopted ship reporting systems and distribute it to the governments of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: ① See the revised General Provisions on the Delineation of Ship Routes adopted by this Organization by resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: ②本条不涉及各国政府为搜救目的而建立且适用经修正的1979年搜救公约第5章的船舶报告系统。
Translation: ②This provision does not apply to ship reporting systems established by governments for search and rescue purposes and governed by Chapter 5 of the 1979 Search and Rescue Convention, as amended.

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: ③ Refer to the guidelines and criteria adopted by the Organization's Maritime Safety Committee through Resolution MSC.43(64) and amended by Resolution MSC.111(73).

Query_Text_cn: 并参见本组织以A.851(20)决议通过的《船舶报告系统总则和船舶报告要求，包括涉及危险品、有害物质和/或海洋污染物事故报告指南》。
Translation: And see also the General principles for ship reporting systems and ship reporting requirements, including guidelines for reporting incidents involving dangerous goods, harmful substances and/or marine pollutants, adopted by the Organization by resolution A.851(20).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶报告系统是各有关政府的责任。
Translation: It is the responsibility of the respective governments to initiate the establishment of a ship reporting system.

Query_Text_cn: 在建立此类系统时，应考虑到本组织制定的指南和衡准①中的规定。
Translation: When establishing such systems, consideration should be given to the provisions set forth in the guidelines and criteria① established by the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 4未提交本组织通过的船舶报告系统不需遵守本条要求。
Translation: Vessels that have not submitted reports as required by the organization's adopted ship reporting system are exempt from the provisions of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，鼓励实施这种系统的缔约国政府尽可能遵循本组织制定的指南和衡准①。
Translation: However, the governments of Contracting States that encourage the implementation of such systems should, to the greatest extent possible, follow the guidelines and standards① established by the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可向本组织提交这种系统由本组织认可。
Translation: The governments of the Contracting States may submit such systems to the Organization for its approval.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定一个经协调的船舶报告系统的提案。
Translation: If two or more governments have a common interest in a particular area, they should develop a proposal for a coordinated ship reporting system based on an agreement among them.

Query_Text_cn: 在着手通过船舶报告系统的提案以前，本组织应向在该系统覆盖的区域内具有共同利益的那些缔约国政府通报该提案的详细内容。
Translation: Before proceeding with the proposal for a ship reporting system, the Organization shall communicate the details of the proposal to the Governments of the Contracting Parties which have a common interest in the area covered by the system.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通过并建立了一个经协调的船舶报告系统，则该系统应具有统一的程序和操作。
Translation: If a coordinated ship reporting system is adopted and established, it shall have uniform procedures and operations.

Query_Text_cn: 6在按本条的要求通过船舶报告系统后，各有关国家政府应采取所有必要的措施公布有效使用该系统所需的任何资料。
Translation: 6 After adopting a ship reporting system in accordance with the requirements of this article, the governments of the states concerned shall take all necessary measures to publish any information required for the effective operation of such a system.

Query_Text_cn: 任何已通过的船舶报告系统应具有相互交流的能力以及在必要时为船舶提供资料的能力。
Translation: Any adopted ship reporting system shall have the capability of interaction and the ability to provide data to ships when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这种系统应按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准2进行操作。
Translation: The system shall be operated in accordance with the guidelines and criteria established by the organization in compliance with the requirements of this Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 7船长应遵守所通过的各个船舶报告系统的要求，并按其中每一系统的规定向有关当局报告所要求的所有资料。
Translation: The master shall comply with the requirements of the ship reporting systems adopted and report to the competent authority all information required in accordance with the provisions of each such system.

Query_Text_cn: 8所有已通过的船舶报告系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All adopted ship reporting systems and actions taken to implement them shall comply with international law, including the relevant provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

Query_Text_cn: 9本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不应侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in this Article and its associated guidelines and criteria shall prejudice the rights and obligations of governments under international law or the legal regimes concerning international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 10船舶按已通过的船舶报告系统的规定加入系统，应对有关船舶免收费用。
Translation: Vessels joining the system in accordance with the provisions of the approved ship reporting system shall be exempt from relevant charges.

Query_Text_cn: 11本组织应确保根据本组织制定的指南和衡准，对已通过的船舶报告系统进行审核。
Translation: 11 The Organization shall ensure that adopted ship reporting systems are reviewed in accordance with the guidelines and criteria developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶交通服务（VTS）有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或保护海洋环境、附近岸上区域、工地和海上设施免受海洋运输可能带来的不利影响。
Translation: 1. Vessel Traffic Services (VTS) contribute to maritime safety of life, navigation safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment, adjacent shore areas, work sites, and offshore facilities from potential adverse effects of maritime transport.

Query_Text_cn: 2缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为因交通量和危险程度而需要船舶交通服务的场所作出建立这种服务的安排。
Translation: 2. The Contracting Government undertakes the obligation to make arrangements for the establishment of such services in locations where it deems necessary due to traffic volume and hazard levels.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: ① Refer to the guidelines and standards adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization through resolution MSC.43(64) and amended by resolution MSC.111(73).

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府规划和实施船舶交通服务，应尽可能遵循守本组织制定的指南①。
Translation: 3. Contracting Governments, when planning and implementing vessel traffic services, shall, as far as practicable, follow the guidelines developed by the Organization①.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶交通服务的使用，仅在沿海国家领海所属的海域内才可作为强制性要求。
Translation: The use of Vessel Traffic Services (VTS) can only be mandated as a compulsory requirement within the maritime areas under the territorial seas of coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府应确保悬挂其国旗的船舶参予船舶交通服务并遵守该服务的规定。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall ensure that ships flying its flag participate in and comply with the requirements of the vessel traffic services.

Query_Text_cn: 5本条或本组织通过的指南之任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Nothing in these Guidelines or any guidelines adopted by the Organization shall prejudice the rights and obligations of governments under international law or the legal regime concerning international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为可行和必要时，根据交通量和危险程度的需要，单独或与其他缔约国政府合作提供助航设备。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Government undertakes to provide, either individually or in cooperation with other Contracting Governments, such aids to navigation as the volume of traffic justifies and the degree of risk requires, when it considers such action to be feasible and necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 2为尽最大可能达到助航设备的一致性，缔约国政府承担义务在设置这些助航设备时，注意到国际上的建议和指南②。
Translation: 2. To achieve the greatest possible degree of uniformity in aids to navigation, Contracting Governments undertake to take into account international recommendations and guidelines when establishing such aids.

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府承担义务，安排向所有有关方面提供与助航设备有关的信息。
Translation: The Contracting Governments undertake to arrange for the provision of information concerning aids to navigation to all concerned parties.

Query_Text_cn: 会对船上所设接收机的性能产生不利影响的定位系统发送的变化，应尽可能避免并仅在及时和适当地发布通告之后才可起作用。
Translation: Changes to positioning systems that may adversely affect the performance of onboard receivers should be avoided as far as possible and implemented only after timely and appropriate notification.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，各自对本国船舶保持实行或在必要时采取措施，以确保所有船舶从海上人命安全观点出发，配备足够数量和胜任的船员③。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Government undertakes to maintain, or, if necessary, adopt measures for its national ships to ensure that, from the point of view of safety of life at sea, all ships are sufficiently and efficiently manned.

Query_Text_cn: 2本公约第I章适用的每艘船舶，应备有1份由主管机关颁发的适当的最少安全配员证明或等效证明，作为符合本条1之规定所需的最少安全配员的凭证。
Translation: Every ship to which chapter I of this Convention applies shall carry an appropriate minimum safe manning document or equivalent issued by the Administration as evidence of the minimum safe manning required to comply with the provisions of paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 3在所有船舶上，为确保船员在安全事务上起到有效作用，应规定一种工作语言并将其记录在船舶航海日志上。
Translation: On all ships, a working language shall be established and recorded in the ship's logbook to ensure the crew's effective participation in safety matters.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约第IX/1条所定义的公司或船长（合适者）应确定适当的工作语言。
Translation: The company or master (as appropriate), as defined in Article IX/1 of this Convention, shall determine the appropriate working language.

Query_Text_cn: 应要求每个船员能懂得这种语言，并在合适情况下使用这种语言下达指令和指示以及应答。
Translation: Each crew member shall be required to understand the language and, where appropriate, use it for issuing and acknowledging orders and instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该工作语言不是船旗国的官方语言，则所有需张贴的图纸和图表内应有该工作语言的译文。
Translation: If the working language is not the official language of the flag state, all posted plans and charts shall include translations in the working language.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本公约第I章适用的船舶上，英语应作为驾驶台的工作语言，用以进行驾驶台对驾驶台、驾驶台对岸的安全通信以及用于引航员和驾驶台值班人员④之间在船上的通信，除非直接参与通信的人员都讲英语以外的一种共同语言。
Translation: On ships to which chapter I of this Convention applies, English shall be the working language for bridge-to-bridge, bridge-to-shore safety communications and for communication between the pilot and bridge watchkeeping personnel on board, unless those directly involved in the communication share a common language other than English.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.857(20)决议通过的《船舶交通服务指南》。
Translation: ①Refer to the Guidelines on Vessel Traffic Services adopted by this Organization by resolution A.857(20).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见IALA的相应建议和指南，以及SN/Circ.107通函《海上浮标系统》。
Translation: ② Refer to the relevant recommendations and guidelines of IALA, as well as SN/Circ.107, Circular on Maritime Buoyage Systems.

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以A.890(21)决议通过并以A.955(23)决议修正的《安全配员原则》。
Translation: ③ Refer to the Principles of Safe Manning adopted by the Organization through resolution A.890(21) and amended by resolution A.955(23).

Query_Text_cn: ④为此可使用经修正的《IMO标准海上通信用语》（A.918(22)决议）。
Translation: For this purpose, the revised IMO Standard Marine Communication Phrases (Resolution A.918(22)) may be used.

Query_Text_cn: 3使驾驶台工作人员和引航员能够方便和连续地访问重要信息。
Translation: 3. To enable bridge personnel and pilots to conveniently and continuously access critical information.

Query_Text_cn: 7通过监视和报警系统最大限度降低人为错误的风险并在发生人为错误时可探测到，以使驾驶台工作人员和引航员及时采取相应行动。
Translation: 7 Minimize the risk of human error through monitoring and alarm systems, and ensure its detection when it occurs, enabling bridge personnel and pilots to take timely corrective actions.

Query_Text_cn: 1应具有使主管机关满意的适当安排，以确保本章所要求设备的性能得到维护。
Translation: 1. Appropriate arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority shall be made to ensure that the performance of the equipment required by this chapter is maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 2除第I/7(b)(ii)、I/8和I/9条规定者外，虽应采取一切合理措施以保持本章所要求的设备处于有效工作状态，但不应把这些设备的功能失常视为船舶不适航，或作为将船舶滞留在不易提供维修设施的港口的理由，只要船长在计划和实行一个安全航程以将船舶驶往可以进行维修的港口时注意到无法工作的设备或不可得到的信息，并作了适当的安排。
Translation: 2 Except as provided in regulations I/7(b)(ii), I/8 and I/9, while all reasonable measures shall be taken to maintain the equipment required by this chapter in efficient working order, malfunction of such equipment shall not be considered as making the ship unseaworthy or as a reason for delaying the ship in a port where repair facilities are not readily available, provided that the master has taken into account the inoperative equipment or unavailable information in planning and executing a safe voyage to a port where repairs can be made and has made appropriate arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 1各国主管机关应确保安装在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶上，位于驾驶台或邻近驾驶台的所有电气和电子设备，应结合本组织制定的建议案②，进行电磁兼容性试验。
Translation: 1. The competent authorities of each country shall ensure that all electrical and electronic equipment installed on ships constructed on or after 1 July 2002, located on or near the bridge, undergoes electromagnetic compatibility testing in accordance with the recommendations developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2电气和电子设备的安装应使电磁干扰不会影响航行系统和设备的正常功能。
Translation: The installation of electrical and electronic equipment shall ensure that electromagnetic interference does not affect the normal functioning of navigation systems and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 3如果便携式电气和电子设备可能影响航行系统和设备的正常功能，则其不应在驾驶台进行操作。
Translation: 3 Portable electrical and electronic devices shall not be operated on the bridge if they may interfere with the normal functioning of navigation systems and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《驾驶台设备和布置的人机工程学衡准指南》（MSC/Circ.982号通函）和IBS性能标准（MSC.64(67)决议，附件1）及INS性能标准（MSC.86(70)决议，附件3）。
Translation: ① Refer to "Guidelines on Ergonomic Criteria for Bridge Equipment and Layout" (MSC/Circ.982) and the IBS Performance Standards (MSC.64(67), Annex 1) as well as the INS Performance Standards (MSC.86(70), Annex 3).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.813(19)决议通过的《所有船用电气和电子设备电磁兼容性的一般要求》。
Translation: ②Refer to the General Requirements for Electromagnetic Compatibility of All Electrical and Electronic Equipment on Ships adopted by this organization through Resolution A.813(19).

Query_Text_cn: 1需满足本章第19条和20条要求的系统和设备应为主管机关认可的型式。
Translation: 1. Systems and equipment required to comply with the provisions of Articles 19 and 20 of this chapter shall be of a type approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后安装，用于执行第19条和20条的功能要求的系统和设备，包括相关的后备装置（如适用），其所达到的相应性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: 2 For systems and equipment installed on or after 1 July 2002 to meet the functional requirements set out in regulations 19 and 20, including associated back-up arrangements where applicable, the associated performance standards shall be not inferior to those adopted by the Organization.1

Query_Text_cn: 《关于船舶首向发送装置（THDs）性能标准的建议案》（MSC.116(73)决议）。
Translation: "Recommendation on Performance Standards for Shipborne Transmitting Heading Devices (THDs)" (Resolution MSC.116(73)).

Query_Text_cn: 3当在2002年7月1日以前建造的船舶上替换或添加系统和设备时，这些系统和设备应在合理和可行的范围内符合本条2的要求。
Translation: When systems and equipment are replaced or added on ships constructed before 1 July 2002, such systems and equipment shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 2 to the extent reasonable and practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本组织通过相关的性能标准之前安装的系统和设备，主管机关在充分考虑了本组织通过的建议衡准后，可以对其免除完全符合这种标准的要求。
Translation: Systems and equipment installed prior to the adoption of relevant performance standards by the Organization may be exempted from full compliance with such standards at the discretion of the Administration, provided that due consideration has been given to the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于视为满足19.2.1.4条之海图配备要求的电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS），该系统所达到的相关性能标准应不低于本组织所通过且在其安装之日有效的性能标准，或者，对于在1999年1月1日以前安装的系统，应不低于本组织在1995年11月23日通过的性能标准①。
Translation: However, for an electronic chart display and information system (ECDIS) that is considered to meet the chart carriage requirements of regulation 19.2.1.4, the relevant performance standards it meets shall not be inferior to those adopted by the Organization and in force at the time of its installation, or for systems installed before 1 January 1999, not inferior to the performance standards adopted by the Organization on 23 November 1995.①

Query_Text_cn: 5主管机关应要求制造商具有一个由适任机构审核的质量控制系统，以确保持续符合型式认可条件。
Translation: The competent authority shall require manufacturers to maintain a quality control system audited by a qualified body to ensure continuous compliance with type approval conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 作为替代，主管机关可以在该产品安装上船之前使用最终产品验证程序，由适任机构验证其是否符合型式认可证书。
Translation: As an alternative, the competent authority may apply a final product verification procedure before the product is installed on board, with verification by a recognized body to confirm its compliance with the type approval certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 6在对具有本章未涉及之新特征的航行系统或设备认可之前，主管机关应确保这种特征对功能的支持与本章所要求者至少同样有效。
Translation: 6 Before approving any navigation system or equipment with novel features not covered by this chapter, the competent authority shall ensure that such features support functionality at least as effective as those required by this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果除第19条和20条要求的各项设备以外，船上还配有本组织已制定性能标准的设备，则这种设备应经过认可且所达到的性能标准应尽实际可能不低于本组织通过的性能标准。
Translation: 7 If, in addition to the equipment required by regulations 19 and 20, other equipment is carried on board for which performance standards have been developed by the Organization, such equipment shall be approved and shall meet performance standards not inferior to those adopted by the Organization to the fullest extent practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 8航行数据记录仪系统，包括所有传感器，应作年度性能试验。
Translation: The voyage data recorder system, including all sensors, shall undergo annual performance testing.

Query_Text_cn: 试验应由认可的试验或检修机构进行，以验证所记录数据的精度、持续时间和可恢复性。
Translation: The test shall be conducted by an approved testing or inspection agency to verify the accuracy, duration, and recoverability of the recorded data.

Query_Text_cn: 另外还应进行试验和检查，以确定所有防护外罩和辅助定位装置的适用性。
Translation: Additionally, tests and inspections should be conducted to verify the suitability of all protective covers and auxiliary positioning devices.

Query_Text_cn: 船上应保留1份由试验机构颁发的载明符合日期和适用性能标准的符合证书，应有一份副本保留在船上。
Translation: The ship shall retain on board one copy of the Statement of Compliance issued by the testing agency, indicating the date of compliance and the applicable performance standards, with one duplicate copy also kept on board.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶，应配备满足本条2.1至2.9规定要求的航行系统和设备。
Translation: 1.1 Ships constructed on or after 1 July 2002 shall be fitted with navigation systems and equipment that meet the requirements specified in paragraphs 2.1 to 2.9 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: ①《关于电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）性能标准的建议案》（A.817(19)决议）。
Translation: ① Recommendation on Performance Standards for Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS) (Resolution A.817(19)).

Query_Text_cn: 3不迟于本条2.4.2和2.4.3规定的日期，配备本条2.4要求的系统。
Translation: No later than the dates specified in Sections 2.4.2 and 2.4.3 of this Article, the systems required under Section 2.4 shall be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 91部电话，或其他装置，用与向应急操舵位置（如设有）传递首向信息。
Translation: 91 telephones or other devices for transmitting heading information to the emergency steering position (if provided).

Query_Text_cn: ①合适的对开纸质航海图可作为ECDIS的后备装置。
Translation: ① Appropriate paper nautical charts can serve as a backup for ECDIS.

Query_Text_cn: 可接受ECDIS的其他后备装置（见经修正的A.817(19)决议的附录6）。
Translation: Other acceptable backup arrangements for ECDIS (refer to Appendix 6 of the revised resolution A.817(19)).

Query_Text_cn: 21套白昼信号灯，或其他装置，用于在白天和夜晚通过灯光进行联络，使用电源，但非唯一依靠船上电源供电。
Translation: 21 sets of daylight signaling lights, or other devices, for communication by light both day and night, powered by electricity but not solely reliant on the ship's power supply.

Query_Text_cn: 51台经过适当校正的首向传送装置，或其他装置，用于传送首向信息以输入到本条2.3.2、2.3.3和2.4所述的设备中。
Translation: Fifty-one appropriately adjusted heading transmission devices, or other devices, for transmitting heading information to be input into the equipment described in sections 2.3.2, 2.3.3, and 2.4 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见第I/8条。
Translation: ① See Article I/8.

Query_Text_cn: ②第一次安全设备检验系指安全设备的第一次年度检验、第一次定期检验或第一次换证检验，以在2004年7月1日以后先到期者为准，此外，对于在建船舶，系指初次检验。
Translation: ②The first safety equipment survey refers to the first annual survey, the first periodical survey or the first renewal survey of the safety equipment, whichever comes due first after 1 July 2004. For ships under construction, it refers to the initial survey.

Query_Text_cn: 7AIS的操作应考虑到本组织通过的指南21。
Translation: The operation of 7AIS should take into account the guidelines adopted by the organization 21.

Query_Text_cn: 配备AIS的船舶应使AIS始终保持运行状态，但国际协定、规则或标准规定要保护航行信息的情况除外。
Translation: Ships equipped with AIS shall maintain the AIS in operation at all times, except where international agreements, rules, or standards provide for the protection of navigational information.

Query_Text_cn: 31台电罗经方位复视器，或其他装置，通过使用上述.1所述的电罗经或其他装置，在水平360o弧度范围内量取方位。
Translation: 31 gyro repeaters or other devices for taking bearings over an arc of the horizon of 360° by means of gyro or other means referred to in paragraph.1.

Query_Text_cn: 51台自动跟踪仪，或其他装置，用于自动标绘其他目标的距离和方位，以确定碰撞危险。
Translation: 51 automatic tracking devices, or other means, for automatically plotting the range and bearing of other targets to determine collision risks.

Query_Text_cn: 1本章适用于因其对船舶或船上人员的特别危害而需在本规则所适用的一切船舶上，及小于500总吨的货船上采取特别预防措施的货物的装运（散装液体、散装气体和其他章内已作出装运规定的除外）。
Translation: 1 This chapter applies to the carriage of goods that require special precautions on all ships covered by this Code and cargo ships of less than 500 gross tonnage, due to their particular hazards to the ship or persons on board (excluding bulk liquids, bulk gases, and other goods for which carriage provisions have been specified in other chapters).

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对小于500总吨的货船，如果主管机关认为因航行的遮蔽性和条件，应用本章A部分或B部分的任何具体要求是不合理或不必要的，则可采取能够确保这些船舶所需安全的其他有效措施。
Translation: However, for cargo ships of less than 500 gross tonnage, the Administration may adopt other effective measures ensuring the required safety for such ships if it considers that the application of any specific requirements in Part A or Part B of this chapter is unreasonable or unnecessary due to the sheltered nature and conditions of the voyages.

Query_Text_cn: 2作为本章A部分和B部分规定的补充，每一缔约国政府应保证提供有关货物及其堆装和系固的适当资料，特别说明安全装运此类货物所必需的预防措施。
Translation: As a supplement to the provisions of Sections A and B of this chapter, each Contracting Government shall ensure the provision of appropriate information on cargoes and their stowage and securing, with particular emphasis on the precautions necessary for the safe carriage of such cargoes.

Query_Text_cn: 1发货人应在装货前及早向船长或其代表提供关于该货物的适当资料，以便能实施为此种货物的适当堆装和安全装运可能是必需的预防措施。
Translation: 1. The shipper shall provide the master or his representative in due time prior to loading with appropriate information concerning the cargo to enable the necessary precautions to be taken for its proper stowage and safe carriage.

Query_Text_cn: 此类资料②应在货物装船前以书面形式③和适当的运输单证予以确认。
Translation: Such materials② shall be confirmed in writing③ and with appropriate transport documents prior to the loading of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于杂货和以货物单元运输的货物，应有货物的一般说明、货物或货物单元的毛重和货物的任何有关特性。
Translation: 1 For general cargo and goods transported in cargo units, a general description of the goods, the gross weight of the goods or cargo units, and any relevant characteristics shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，应提供本组织以A.714(17)决议通过并可能经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》第1.9节所要求的货物资料。
Translation: For the purpose of this article, cargo information as required by section 1.9 of the Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Stowage and Securing, adopted by the Organization by resolution A.714(17) as may be amended, shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于散装货物，应有关于货物积载因数、平舱方法、移动的可能性（包括稳定角,如适用）以及任何其他有关特性的资料。
Translation: For bulk cargoes, information shall be provided on the stowage factor, trimming method, potential for movement (including angle of repose, if applicable), and any other relevant characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: 3本组织以A.434(XI)决议通过的经修正的《固体散装货物安全操作规则(BC规则)》。
Translation: 3 The Code of Safe Practice for Solid Bulk Cargoes (BC Code), as amended, adopted by the Organization by resolution A.434(XI).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.663通函《货物资料表》。
Translation: ② Refer to MSC/Circ.663 Circular "Cargo Information Form."

Query_Text_cn: ③本条所指的单证并不排除作为书面文件的一种辅助手段而使用电子数据处理（EDP）和电子数据交换（EDI）的传输技术。
Translation: ③The documents referred to in this Article shall not preclude the use of electronic data processing (EDP) or electronic data interchange (EDI) transmission techniques as an auxiliary means to written documents.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，除上述各项要求的资料外，还应有关于其化学性质的资料。
Translation: 3 For bulk cargoes not classified according to the provisions of the IMDG Code as defined in VII/1.1 but having chemical properties that may create potential hazards, in addition to the information required above, the chemical properties of the cargo shall also be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 3在货物单元装船前，发货人应确保这类货物单元的毛重与运输单证中表明的毛重是一致的。
Translation: 3 Before loading the cargo unit, the shipper shall ensure that the gross weight of such cargo unit corresponds to the gross weight indicated in the transport document.

Query_Text_cn: 1在运输可能释放有毒或易燃气体或可能在货物处所中造成氧气耗尽的散装货物时，应备有测量空气中这类气体或氧气浓度的适当仪器，及其详细的使用说明书。
Translation: When transporting bulk cargoes that may release toxic or flammable gases or may cause oxygen depletion in cargo spaces, appropriate instruments for measuring the concentration of such gases or oxygen in the air shall be provided, along with detailed operating instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 这种仪器应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The instrument shall be to the satisfaction of the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应采取措施，确保船员在上述仪器使用方面受到培训。
Translation: The competent authority shall take measures to ensure that crew members are trained in the use of the aforementioned equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 在船上使用杀虫剂，尤其是为熏舱而使用杀虫剂时，应采取适当预防措施。
Translation: Appropriate precautions should be taken when using pesticides on board ships, particularly for fumigation purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 1在甲板上和甲板下装运的货物、货物单元②和货物运输单元③，其装载、堆装和系固应尽可能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险，以及防止货物落水灭失。
Translation: 1 Cargo, cargo units② and cargo transport units③, whether carried on or under deck, shall be loaded, stowed and secured so as to prevent as far as practicable damage or hazard to the ship and persons on board, and loss of cargo overboard during the entire voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 2货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，其在单元中的包装和系固，应能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险。
Translation: 2. Cargo, cargo units and cargo transport units, along with their packaging and securing within the unit, shall be such as to prevent damage or danger to the ship and persons on board throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 3在重型货物或异常外形尺寸货物的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，确保不发生船舶结构性损坏，并在整个航程中保持足够的稳性。
Translation: During the loading and transportation of heavy or unusually shaped cargo, appropriate preventive measures shall be taken to avoid structural damage to the vessel and maintain adequate stability throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 4在滚装船上货物单元和货物运输单元的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，特别是注意这种船上和货物单元和货物运输单元上的系固装置，以及系固点和捆索的强度。
Translation: During the loading and transportation of cargo units and cargo transport units on roll-on/roll-off ships, appropriate preventive measures shall be taken, with particular attention paid to the securing devices on such ships and cargo units/cargo transport units, as well as the strength of securing points and lashings.

Query_Text_cn: 5货运集装箱的装载应不超过经修正的《国际集装箱安全公约》（CSC）规定的安全核准牌上注明的最大总重量。
Translation: The loading of 5 freight containers shall not exceed the maximum gross weight indicated on the safety approval plate as specified in the amended International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC).

Query_Text_cn: 6在整个航程中，除散装固体和液体货物以外的所有货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，应按照主管机关认可的《货物系固手册》进行装载、堆装和系固。
Translation: 6 Throughout the voyage, all cargoes, cargo units, and cargo transport units except bulk solid and liquid cargoes shall be loaded, stowed, and secured in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 对于具有第II-2/3.41条定义的滚装处所的船舶，应在离开泊位之前按照《货物系固手册》完成所有这些货物、货物单元和货物运输单元的系固。
Translation: For ships with ro-ro spaces as defined in regulation II-2/3.41, the securing of all such cargo, cargo units and cargo transport units shall be completed in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual before leaving the berth.

Query_Text_cn: 《货物系固手册》的编制标准应至少与本组织制定的相关指南④相当。
Translation: The preparation standards for the "Cargo Securing Manual" shall be at least equivalent to the relevant guidelines developed by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见经修正的IMO《关于在船上安全使用杀虫剂的建议案》。
Translation: ① Refer to the revised IMO "Recommendations on the Safe Use of Pesticides on Ships".

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.714(17)决议通过的经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》。
Translation: ② Refer to the Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Stowage and Securing, as amended, adopted by the Organization by resolution A.714(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以MSC.122(75)决议通过的《国际海运危险货物（IMDG）规则》。
Translation: ③ Refer to the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code adopted by the Organization under resolution MSC.122(75).

Query_Text_cn: ④参见《货物系固手册编制指南》（MSC/Circ.745通函）。
Translation: ④ See the Guidelines for the Preparation of the Cargo Securing Manual (MSC/Circ.745).

Query_Text_cn: 1在散装货物装船前，船长应得到关于船舶稳性和标准装载条件下货物分布的综合资料。
Translation: 1 Before loading bulk cargo, the master shall be provided with comprehensive information on the ship's stability and the distribution of cargo under standard loading conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 提供此种资料的方法，应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The method of providing such information shall be satisfactory to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2对浓缩物或可液化的其他货物，只有当其实际含水量小于其可运含水极限时才能被接受装船。
Translation: 2 Concentrates or other cargoes which may liquefy shall only be accepted for loading when the actual moisture content is less than their transportable moisture limit.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果作出了使主管机关满意的安全布置，确保在货物移动时有足够的稳性而且船舶具有充分的结构完整性，则即使其含水量超过了上述极限，仍可接受此种浓缩物和其他货物装船。
Translation: However, if safety arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority are made to ensure sufficient stability during cargo movement and adequate structural integrity of the ship, such concentrates and other cargoes may be accepted for loading even when their moisture content exceeds the above limits.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，在装船之前应对其安全运输采取特别预防措施。
Translation: 3 For bulk cargoes that are not classified according to the provisions of the IMDG Code as defined in VII/1.1 but have chemical properties that may create potential hazards, special precautions shall be taken to ensure their safe transport before loading.

Query_Text_cn: 1就本条而言，码头代表系指船舶装卸货物的码头或其他设施使用方指定的人员，其负责这个码头或设施对该特定船舶进行作业。
Translation: 1 For the purposes of this Article, the terminal representative means a person designated by the user of the terminal or other facility where the ship is to load or unload cargo, who is responsible for the operation of that terminal or facility in respect of that particular ship.

Query_Text_cn: 2为能使船长防止船体结构中产生过大应力，应给船舶配备一本手册，并应采用为负责货物作业的高级船员所熟悉的语言编写。
Translation: To enable the master to prevent excessive stresses in the ship's structure, a manual shall be provided on board, written in a language understood by the officer responsible for cargo operations.

Query_Text_cn: 如该种语言不是英文，则船上也应配备一本用英文写成的手册。
Translation: If the language is not English, a manual written in English shall also be provided on board.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织以A.562(14)决议通过的《关于船长24m及以上客船和货船完整稳性的突风和横摇衡准(气象衡准)的建议案》。
Translation: The Recommendation on Severe Wind and Rolling Criteria (Weather Criteria) for the Intact Stability of Passenger and Cargo Ships of 24 Metres in Length and Over, adopted by this Organization through Resolution A.562(14).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: ② Refer to the Code of Safe Practice for the Safe Loading and Unloading of Bulk Carriers (BLU Code) adopted by the Organization through resolution A.862(20).

Query_Text_cn: 7如要求强度计算，在装卸货物及航行期间船体上的最大许用载荷和力矩。
Translation: 7 If strength calculations are required, the maximum allowable loads and moments on the hull during cargo handling and navigation shall be determined.

Query_Text_cn: 3固体散装货物在装货或卸货之前，船长和码头代表应商定一项计划①，该计划应确保在装卸货物期间不超过船上的许用应力和力矩，同时还应包括装卸货物的次序、数量及速率,此时应考虑到装卸货物的速度、船上添注口的数量及减压载或加压载的能力。
Translation: Prior to the loading or unloading of solid bulk cargoes, the master and the terminal representative shall agree on a plan① that ensures the permissible shipboard stresses and moments are not exceeded during the loading or unloading processes. This plan shall also include the sequence, quantity, and rate of cargo handling, taking into account the speed of loading or unloading, the number of pour points on board, and the capacity for ballasting or deballasting.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划及其后的任何修改，应提交给港口国的有关当局。
Translation: The plan and any subsequent amendments shall be submitted to the competent authority of the port State.

Query_Text_cn: 4散装货物应在整个货物处所范围内装载并按需要合理平舱，以尽量减少货物移动的危险，并确保在整个航行期间保持足够的稳性。
Translation: Bulk cargoes shall be loaded and trimmed as necessary within the entire cargo space to minimize the risk of shifting and ensure adequate stability throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 5在甲板间舱装载散装货物时，如果装载资料表明船底结构在舱口开启时的应力会达到不可接受的程度，则这些甲板间的舱口应关闭。
Translation: When loading bulk cargo in tween-deck compartments, the tween-deck hatches shall be closed if the loading data indicates that the stress on the bottom structure would reach an unacceptable level with the hatches open.

Query_Text_cn: 应将货物合理平舱，并应延伸到两舷，或用具有足够强度的附加纵向隔壁加以固定。
Translation: The cargo shall be properly trimmed and shall extend to both sides or be secured by additional longitudinal bulkheads of sufficient strength.

Query_Text_cn: 应注意甲板间舱的安全承载能力，以确保甲板结构不过载。
Translation: Attention should be paid to the safe load-bearing capacity of the tween deck to ensure the deck structure is not overloaded.

Query_Text_cn: 6船长和码头代表应确保装卸货物作业按照商定的计划进行。
Translation: The master and terminal representative shall ensure that cargo handling operations are conducted in accordance with the agreed plan.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果在装卸货物期间，本条2所述的对船舶的任一限制已经超出或者如果装卸继续进行下去可能导致超出，则船长有权中止装卸作业并有责任将此通知给批准这个计划的港口国有关当局。
Translation: 7 If any of the vessel's limitations specified in paragraph 2 of this article are exceeded during cargo handling operations, or if continued loading or unloading is likely to result in such exceedance, the master shall have the right to suspend cargo operations and is obligated to notify the relevant authorities of the port state that approved the plan accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 船长和码头代表应确保采取纠正措施。
Translation: The master and terminal representative shall ensure that corrective measures are taken.

Query_Text_cn: 当卸货时，船长和码头代表应确保卸货方法不损坏船体结构。
Translation: During unloading, the captain and port representatives shall ensure that the unloading method does not damage the ship's hull structure.

Query_Text_cn: 8船长应确保船上人员连续不断地监视货物装卸作业。
Translation: The master shall ensure that the loading and unloading operations of cargo are continuously monitored by the ship's personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 如有可能，在装卸货物期间应定期校核吃水以确认提供的吨位数。
Translation: If possible, regular draft checks should be conducted during cargo loading and unloading to verify the tonnage provided.

Query_Text_cn: 每次测得的吃水和吨位数应记入货物日志。
Translation: Each measured draft and tonnage shall be recorded in the cargo log.

Query_Text_cn: 如发现与商定的计划有显著的偏差，则应调整货物装卸或压载作业，或两者，以确保偏差被纠正。
Translation: If a significant deviation from the agreed plan is identified, cargo handling or ballasting operations, or both, shall be adjusted to ensure the deviation is corrected.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: ① Refer to the Code of Practice for the Safe Loading and Unloading of Bulk Carriers (BLU Code) adopted by the Organization through resolution A.862(20).

Query_Text_cn: 1国际谷物规则系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.23(59)决议通过并可能经本组织修正的《国际散装谷物安全装运规则》，但这类修正案应按本公约第VIII条有关除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: 1 The International Grain Code means the International Code for the Safe Carriage of Grain in Bulk adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by resolution MSC.23(59), as may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments are adopted, brought into force and take effect in accordance with the provisions of article VIII of the present Convention concerning the amendment procedures applicable to the annex other than chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 2谷物一词包括小麦、玉蜀黍（苞米）、燕麦、稞麦、大麦、大米、豆类、种子以及由其加工而成并在自然状态下具有类似特征的制品。
Translation: The term "cereals" includes wheat, corn (maize), oats, rye, barley, rice, pulses, seeds, and products processed therefrom that retain similar characteristics in their natural state.

Query_Text_cn: 1除本规则任何其他适用的要求外，装运谷物的货船还应符合《国际谷物规则》的要求，并持有1份按该规则要求的批准文件。
Translation: 1 In addition to any other applicable requirements under these regulations, ships carrying grain shall also comply with the requirements of the International Grain Code and hold a document of authorization as required by that Code.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，该规则的要求应强制性执行。
Translation: For the purposes of this Article, the requirements of this rule shall be mandatory.

Query_Text_cn: 2没有这种批准文件的船舶，在船长使主管机关或代表主管机关的装货港的缔约国政府确信该船所提出的装载情况符合《国际谷物规则》的要求之前，不应装载谷物。
Translation: 2 Ships without such approval documents shall not load grain until the master has satisfied the competent authority or the government of the contracting state at the port of loading acting on behalf of the competent authority that the proposed loading conditions of the ship comply with the requirements of the International Grain Code.

Query_Text_cn: 本章适用于所有核能船舶，但军用船舶除外。
Translation: This chapter applies to all nuclear-powered ships, with the exception of military vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的其他各章中的规则均适用于核能船舶，但经本章修订者除外。
Translation: The rules in the other chapters of this Convention shall apply to nuclear ships except as modified by this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，核能船舶均应符合本公约的任何规则，不应被免除。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall nuclear ships be exempted from any provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 核反应堆装置的设计、构造以及检查和装配的标准均应经主管机关认可和满意，并应考虑因辐射而使检验所受到的限制。
Translation: The design, construction, and standards for inspection and assembly of nuclear reactor installations shall be approved and deemed satisfactory by the competent authority, taking into account the limitations imposed by radiation on inspections.

Query_Text_cn: 设计核反应堆装置时，应考虑船舶在正常和异常两种航行情况下的特殊工作条件。
Translation: When designing nuclear reactor installations, special operating conditions for ships under both normal and abnormal navigation situations should be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应采取措施，确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: The competent authority shall take measures to ensure that crew members, passengers or the public, as well as waterways, food or water sources are not unduly exposed to radiation or other nuclear hazards at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: (a)应编写安全鉴定书，以评定核动力装置的性能和船舶的安全，从而确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: (a) A safety assessment shall be prepared to evaluate the performance of the nuclear power plant and the safety of the ship, ensuring that no undue radiation or other nuclear hazards are caused to the crew, passengers, or public, or to waterways, food, or water sources, whether at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对鉴定书满意时，应予以认可，该鉴定书应始终保持更新。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied with the appraisal report, it shall approve it, and the report shall be kept updated at all times.

Query_Text_cn: (b)应提前足够的时间将安全鉴定书送交核能船舶拟驶往的缔约国政府，以供其评定该核能船舶的安全性。
Translation: (b) The safety assessment shall be submitted to the government of the Contracting State to which the nuclear ship is intended to proceed sufficiently in advance to enable that government to evaluate the safety of the nuclear ship.

Query_Text_cn: 应制订关于核动力装置的所有操作事项且着重于安全的操作手册，作为操作人员在工作时的参考和指导。
Translation: An operational manual focusing on safety should be developed for all nuclear power plant operations, serving as a reference and guide for personnel during work.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对操作手册满意时，应予以认可。
Translation: The competent authority shall grant approval when satisfied with the operating manual.

Query_Text_cn: 应有一份操作手册保存在船上，且应始终保持更新。
Translation: An operation manual shall be kept on board and shall always be kept up to date.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《核能商船安全规则》（A.491(XII)决议），该规则补充了本章的要求。
Translation: ① Refer to the Code of Safety for Nuclear Merchant Ships (Resolution A.491(XII)), which supplements the requirements of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 对核能船舶的检验应包括第I/7条或第I/8、9和10条中的适用要求，但对于因辐射而受到限制的检验除外。
Translation: The survey of nuclear-powered ships shall include the applicable requirements of regulation I/7 or regulations I/8,9 and 10, except for surveys restricted due to radiation.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，检验还应包括安全鉴定书的任何特殊要求。
Translation: In addition, the inspection shall include any special requirements specified in the safety certification.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然有第I/8条和10条的规定，但在所有情况下，对核能船舶的检验应不少于每年1次。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles I/8 and 10, the inspection of nuclear-powered ships shall in all cases be conducted at intervals not exceeding one year.

Query_Text_cn: (a)第I/12(a)条及第I/14条的规定不适用于核能船舶。
Translation: (a) The provisions of Article I/12(a) and Article I/14 shall not apply to nuclear-powered ships.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对经检查和检验后符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求及本规则其他有关要求的核能客船，应签发核能客船安全证书。
Translation: (b) A Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate shall be issued to nuclear passenger ships that, upon inspection and survey, are found to comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV, and VIII, as well as other relevant provisions of these Rules.

Query_Text_cn: (c)对经检查和检验后满足第I/10条所规定的货船检验要求并符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求以及本规则其他有关要求的核能货船，应签发核能货船安全证书。
Translation: (c) A nuclear cargo ship that meets the survey requirements for cargo ships specified in regulation I/10 and complies with the provisions of chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV, and VIII, as well as other relevant requirements of this Code, shall be issued a Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate upon completion of surveys and inspections.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书中应阐明：“此船为核能船舶，此船符合公约第VIII章的所有要求，并与所认可的此船安全鉴定书相一致”。
Translation: (d) The Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall state: "This ship is a nuclear-powered vessel, complies with all requirements of Chapter VIII of the Convention, and conforms to the approved safety assessment report for this ship."

Query_Text_cn: (e)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书的有效期限均不应超过12个月。
Translation: (e) The validity period of both the Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: (f)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书应由主管机关或由其正式授权的个人或机构签发。
Translation: (f) The Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall be issued by the Administration or by a person or organization duly authorized by it.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，主管机关应对该证书负全部责任。
Translation: In all cases,the competent authorities shall bear full responsibility for the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 除按第I/19条所规定的控制外，核能船舶在进入各缔约国港口之前以及在港时均应受到特殊控制，其目的是为证实船上已具备有效的核能船舶安全证书，并证实在海上或港内，该船对船员、乘客或公众，或对水道或食物或水源没有不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: In addition to the controls specified in Regulation I/19, nuclear ships shall be subject to special controls prior to entry into the ports of Contracting Parties and while therein, aimed at verifying that there is on board a valid Nuclear Ship Safety Certificate and that during the voyage or in port, the ship presents no undue radiation or other nuclear hazard to the crew, passengers, or public, or to the waterways or food or water resources.

Query_Text_cn: 当核能船舶发生任何可能导致危害周围环境的事故时，该船船长应立即报告主管机关。
Translation: In the event of any accident involving a nuclear-powered vessel that may pose a hazard to the surrounding environment, the ship's captain shall immediately report to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 船长还应立即报告该船在损坏情况下可能处于的水域或驶往的水域所属国家政府的主管当局。
Translation: The master shall also promptly report to the competent authorities of the government of the country in whose waters the ship may be or to whose waters the ship may proceed in the event of damage.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见IMO/IAEA《关于核能商船使用港口的安全建议》。
Translation: ① Refer to the IMO/IAEA "Recommendations on the Safe Use of Ports by Nuclear Merchant Ships."

Query_Text_cn: 11994年高速船规则（1994HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.36(63)决议通过的《国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 1994 High-Speed Craft Code (1994 HSC Code) refers to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization through Resolution MSC.36(63). This Code may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments shall be adopted, enter into force, and be implemented in accordance with the amendment procedures applicable to the annexes to this Convention other than Chapter I, as stipulated in Article VIII.

Query_Text_cn: 22000年高速船规则（2000HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.97(73)决议通过的《2000年国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 2000 HSC Code refers to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft, 2000, adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization by resolution MSC.97(73). The Code may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments shall be adopted, brought into force and take effect in accordance with the provisions of Article VIII of the present Convention concerning the amendment procedures applicable to the annex other than chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：▽=相应于设计水线的排水量，m3。不包括在非排水状态下船体由地效应产生的气动升力完全支承在水面以上的船舶。
Translation: Chinese: ▽ = displacement corresponding to the designed waterline, in m³. Excludes vessels that are fully supported above the water surface by aerodynamic lift generated from ground effect in non-displacement conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 4建造的船系指安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船。
Translation: 4A ship is deemed to be constructed when its keel is laid or when it reaches a similar stage of construction.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的3%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly of the vessel shall have commenced with at least 50 tons or 3% of the estimated weight of all structural material, whichever is the lesser.

Query_Text_cn: 2在其营运的航线上，满载时以其营运航速航行至避难地不超过8h的500总吨及以上的货船。
Translation: For cargo ships of 500 gross tonnage and above, when fully loaded and operating at their service speed, the distance to a place of refuge shall not exceed 8 hours on their operational routes.

Query_Text_cn: 2任何船，不论其建造日期，当进行修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装时，应至少继续符合原适用于该船的要求。
Translation: 2 Any ship, regardless of its date of construction, shall, when undergoing repairs, alterations, modifications, and outfitting related thereto, continue to comply at least with the requirements originally applicable to that ship.

Query_Text_cn: 在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，一般应符合对该日期或以后建造的船的要求，且至少能达到在对其修理、改装、改建或舾装之前的同等程度。
Translation: High-speed craft constructed before 1 July 2002 shall generally comply with the requirements for craft constructed on or after that date to at least the same extent as they did before undergoing repairs, alterations, modifications or outfitting.

Query_Text_cn: 对于重大的修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装，在主管机关认为合理和可行的范围内，均应满足对2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船的要求。
Translation: For major repairs, alterations, modifications, and associated outfitting, they shall, to the extent deemed reasonable and practicable by the Administration, comply with the requirements applicable to ships constructed on or after 1 July 2002.

Query_Text_cn: 1在1996年1月1日或以后，但在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，如完全符合1994年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: 1 A high-speed craft constructed on or after 1 January 1996 but before 1 July 2002 which complies fully with the requirements of the 1994 HSC Code and has been surveyed and certified in accordance with that Code shall be deemed to have complied with the requirements of chapters I to IV and regulations V/18, 19 and 20.

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船，如完全符合2000年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: Vessels constructed on or after 1 July 2002 that meet all the requirements of the 2000 High-Speed Craft Code and have been surveyed and certified in accordance with its provisions shall be deemed to comply with the requirements of Chapters I to IV and regulations V/18, 19, and 20.

Query_Text_cn: 2按照《高速船规则》签发的证书和许可证，应与按照第I章规定签发的证书具有同样的效力和获得同样的承认。
Translation: Certificates and permits issued in accordance with the High-Speed Craft Code shall have the same validity and acceptance as those issued under the provisions of Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船系指第IX/1.6条所定义的散货船。
Translation: 1 Bulk carrier means a bulk carrier as defined in regulation IX/1.6.

Query_Text_cn: 2单舷侧结构散货船系指货舱边界为舷侧壳板的散货船。
Translation: A single-side skin bulk carrier refers to a bulk carrier where the cargo hold boundary is formed by the side shell plating.

Query_Text_cn: 3散货船的船长系指现行《国际载重线公约》所定义的长度。
Translation: The length of a bulk carrier's captain refers to the length as defined by the current International Load Line Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 4固体散货系指除液体或气体外，粉状、颗粒状或任何较大块物质构成的货物，其一般是均匀的，可直接装进装货处所而不需用任何形式的容器盛装。
Translation: Solid bulk cargo refers to any material, other than liquid or gas, consisting of a combination of particles, granules or any larger pieces of material, generally uniform in composition, which is loaded directly into the cargo spaces of a ship without any intermediate form of containment.

Query_Text_cn: 5散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准系指1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府大会于1997年11月27日通过的决议4《对最前两个货舱之间垂向槽形水密舱壁构件尺寸和最前部货舱许可装载的评估标准》，该标准可能经本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The strength standards for bulk carrier bulkheads and double bottoms refer to Resolution 4 adopted by the Conference of Contracting Governments to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1974, on 27 November 1997, titled "Standards for the Evaluation of Scantlings of Vertically Corrugated Transverse Watertight Bulkheads Between the Two Foremost Cargo Holds and for the Permissible Loading of the Foremost Cargo Hold." These standards may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments are adopted, enter into force, and become effective in accordance with the amendment procedures applicable to the annexes of this Convention other than Chapter I, as set forth in Article VIII.

Query_Text_cn: 6建造的船舶与第II-1/1.1.3.1条的含义相同。
Translation: The ship constructed has the same meaning as in regulation II-1/1.1.3.1.

Query_Text_cn: 散货船除符合其他各章的适用要求外，还应符合本章的要求。
Translation: In addition to meeting the applicable requirements of other chapters, bulk carriers shall also comply with the provisions of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 3对1999年7月1日船龄小于15年的散货船，船龄达到15年后的第一次定期检验日期,但不迟于船龄达到17年之日。
Translation: For bulk carriers built on or after July 1, 1999 with an age of less than 15 years, the date of the first periodical survey after reaching 15 years of age, but no later than the date when the vessel reaches 17 years of age.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.79(70)和MSC.89(71)决议通过的《对SOLAS公约第XII章关于散货船的附加安全措施规定的解释》。
Translation: ① Refer to the interpretation of the additional safety measures for bulk carriers in Chapter XII of the SOLAS Convention, as adopted by MSC Resolutions 79(70) and 89(71) of the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日或以后建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受任一货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
Translation: 1 Ships of 150 m in length and upwards, designed with single side-skin construction for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes of 1,000 kg/m3 and above, constructed on or after 1 July 1999, when loaded to the summer load line, shall be capable of withstanding the flooding of any one cargo hold in all loading conditions and shall remain afloat in a satisfactory condition of equilibrium as specified in paragraph 3 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 2船长150m及以上，用于载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日以前建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受最前部货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
Translation: Vessels of 150m in length and above, constructed with single-side skin structure before 1 July 1999, intended for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes having a density of 1,780kg/m3 and above, shall be capable of withstanding the flooding of the foremost cargo hold in all loading conditions when loaded to the summer load line and shall remain afloat in a satisfactory condition of equilibrium as specified in paragraph 3.

Query_Text_cn: 应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本要求。
Translation: The implementation plan stipulated in Article 3 shall comply with this requirement.

Query_Text_cn: 3按本条6的规定，进水后的平衡状态应满足经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议的附件《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》所规定的平衡状态。
Translation: The equilibrium condition after flooding shall comply with the requirements specified in the annex to Resolution A.320(IX), as amended by Resolution A.514(13), entitled "Regulations Equivalent to Regulation 27 of the International Convention on Load Lines, 1966," in accordance with paragraph 6 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 假定的进水只需考虑货舱处所进水。
Translation: The assumed flooding need only take into account the ingress of water into cargo holds.

Query_Text_cn: 除非进水货舱容积中被货物占据部分的渗透率按该特定货物予以假定，并且该货舱剩余的空余容积的渗透率假定为0.95,否则载货舱的渗透率应假定为0.9，而空货舱的渗透率应假定为0.95。
Translation: Unless the permeability of the portion of a flooded cargo compartment occupied by cargo is assumed to be that specific cargo, and the remaining empty volume of the compartment is assumed to have a permeability of 0.95, the permeability of a loaded cargo compartment shall be assumed to be 0.9, while that of an empty cargo compartment shall be assumed to be 0.95.

Query_Text_cn: 41999年7月1日以前建造并按1966年4月5日通过的《1966年国际载重线公约》第27(7)条已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条2的要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before 1 July 1999 and approved for reduced freeboard under Article 27(7) of the International Convention on Load Lines, 1966, adopted on 5 April 1966, may be deemed to comply with the requirements of paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 5按经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议通过的《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》(8)的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条1或2的相应要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers that have been approved under the provisions of the Rules Equivalent to Regulation 27 of the International Convention on Load Lines,1966,as adopted by resolution A.320(IX),as amended by resolution A.514(13),for reduced freeboard,may be considered as meeting the corresponding requirements of paragraph 1 or 2 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 6按《1966年国际载重线公约1988年议定书》附则B第27(8)条的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，进水后的平衡状态应满足该议定书的有关规定。
Translation: Bulk carriers assigned reduced freeboard in accordance with Regulation 27(8) of Annex B to the 1988 Protocol to the International Load Line Convention, 1966, shall comply with the relevant provisions of the Protocol regarding equilibrium conditions after flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船,应在所有装载压载状态下有足够强度承受任一货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响，同时考虑到本组织通过的建议案。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150 m in length and above, designed to carry solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,000 kg/m3 and above, and with single-side skin construction, shall have sufficient strength to withstand flooding of any one cargo hold in all loading and ballast conditions, taking into account the dynamic effects resulting from the presence of water inside the hold and the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议3《关于符合SOLAS公约第XII/5条的建议案》。
Translation: See Resolution 3 adopted at the 1997 SOLAS Conference, "Recommendations on Compliance with Regulation XII/5 of SOLAS Convention."

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本条要求。
Translation: 1. Single-side skin bulk carriers of 150 m in length and above carrying solid bulk cargoes having a density of 1,780 kg/m3 and above shall comply with the requirements of this regulation in accordance with the implementation schedule specified in regulation 3.

Query_Text_cn: 2最前两个货舱间的水密横舱壁及最前部货舱的双层底应符合散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准，有足够强度承受最前部货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响。
Translation: The watertight transverse bulkhead between the two foremost cargo holds and the double bottom of the foremost cargo hold shall comply with the strength standards for bulk carrier bulkheads and double bottoms. They must possess sufficient strength to withstand flooding in the foremost cargo hold, taking into account the dynamic effects caused by water ingress into the compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言,散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准应视作强制性标准。
Translation: For the purpose of this article, the strength standards for bulk carrier bulkheads and double bottoms shall be deemed mandatory.

Query_Text_cn: 2最大载重量的限制。
Translation: 2. Maximum payload capacity restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 4对为满足本条2的要求而采用以上3.1和3.2的一种或两种限制的散货船，当装载密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货时，均应符合这些限制条件。
Translation: For bulk carriers that adopt one or both limitations of 3.1 and 3.2 above to meet the requirements of paragraph 2 of this article, when carrying solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or higher, they shall comply with these limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 2所有货舱按第XI/2条要求的加强检验程序中的定期检验要求通过了同样范围的检验。
Translation: All cargo holds have passed the same scope of inspection as required by the enhanced survey program under Regulation XI/2 for periodical surveys.

Query_Text_cn: 1第VI/7.2条要求的小册子应由主管机关或其代表签署以表明其符合本章第4、5、6和7条的适用要求。
Translation: The booklet referred to in paragraph 1 of regulation VI/7.2 shall be signed by the Administration or by a person or organization duly authorized by it to indicate that it complies with the applicable requirements of regulations 4, 5, 6 and 7 of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 2按第6条的要求对载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的任何限制应在本条1所述的小册子上作出标识和记录。
Translation: 2 In accordance with the requirements of Article 6, any restrictions on the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or above shall be marked and recorded in the booklet referred to in paragraph 1 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 3适用本条2的散货船应在船中部左、右舷侧外板上勘划一个实心的永久性等边三角形标志，其边长为500mm，顶点在甲板线以下300mm处，并漆成与船体有反差的颜色。
Translation: Bulk carriers to which paragraph 2 applies shall have a solid permanent equilateral triangle mark painted on each side of the shell plating amidships. The triangle shall have each side 500 mm in length, with its apex located 300 mm below the deck line, and shall be painted in a color contrasting with the hull.

Query_Text_cn: 3提供特定货舱进水状况的详细资料。
Translation: 3. Provide detailed information on the flooding condition of specific cargo holds.

Query_Text_cn: 该资料应附有按《国际安全管理（ISM）规则》第8节规定制定的有关撤离部署的详细须知，并作为船员培训和演习的基础。
Translation: The material shall be accompanied by detailed instructions for abandonment arrangements formulated in accordance with Section 8 of the International Safety Management (ISM) Code, serving as the basis for crew training and drills.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船装货之前，发货人除按第VI/2条要求提交货物资料外，还应申报货物密度。
Translation: 1 Before loading bulk cargo, the shipper shall, in addition to providing cargo information as required by Regulation VI/2, also declare the cargo density.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于适用第6条的散货船，除非这些散货船符合本章有关装运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货的所有要求，申报的密度在1,250kg/m3至1,780kg/m3范围内的任何货物应由经授权的试验机构验证其密度。
Translation: For bulk carriers to which Regulation 6 applies, unless they meet all the requirements of this chapter for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ and above, the declared density of any cargo in the range of 1,250 kg/m³ to 1,780 kg/m³ shall be verified by an authorized testing institution.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上的散货船均应配备装载仪，该装载仪应能结合本组织所通过的建议案②，提供主船体梁的剪力和弯矩资料。
Translation: All bulk carriers with a length of 150 meters or more shall be fitted with a loading instrument capable of providing information on hull girder shear forces and bending moments, in accordance with the recommendations adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 21999年7月1日以前建造的船长150m及以上的散货船，应不迟于1999年7月1日以后的第一次中间检验或定期检验之日符合本条1的要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150 meters in length and above constructed before July 1, 1999, shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 1 no later than the date of the first intermediate or periodical survey after July 1, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: ①在验证固体散货密度时,可参见海安会MSC/Circ.908通函《测量散货密度的统一方法》。
Translation: ① When verifying the density of solid bulk cargo, reference can be made to the MSC/Circ.908 circular "Unified Method for Measuring the Density of Bulk Cargo" issued by the Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议5《关于装载仪的建议案》。
Translation: ② See Resolution 5, "Recommendation on Loading Instruments," adopted by the Conference of Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention in 1997.

Query_Text_cn: 1在每一货舱内，当水位达到高出任何货舱内底0.5m时应发出听觉和视觉报警，并在水位高度达到不小于货舱深度15%但不超过2m时也应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: In each cargo hold, an audible and visual alarm shall be activated when the water level reaches 0.5m above the inner bottom of any cargo hold. Additionally, such alarms shall also be triggered when the water level attains a height not less than 15% of the cargo hold's depth but not exceeding 2m.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第9.2条适用的散货船，只需安装后一个报警的探测器。
Translation: For bulk carriers to which regulation 9.2 applies, only the detector for the latter alarm needs to be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 水位探测器应安装在货舱的尾端。
Translation: The water level detector shall be installed at the aft end of the cargo hold.

Query_Text_cn: 对于用做水压载的货舱，可以安装一个报警越控装置。
Translation: For cargo holds used as water ballast tanks, an alarm override device may be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 2对第II-1/11条所要求的防撞舱壁前方的任一压载舱，当舱内的液面达到不超过舱容的10%时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: For any ballast tank forward of the collision bulkhead required by regulation II-1/11, an audible and visual alarm shall be given when the liquid level in the tank reaches no more than 10% of the tank's capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 3在除锚链舱以外的任何干燥处所或空舱内，延伸至首货舱前方的任何部位，在水位高出甲板0.1m时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: In any dry space or void space other than the chain locker, extending to any part forward of the foremost cargo hold, an audible and visual alarm shall be activated when the water level rises 0.1m above the deck.

Query_Text_cn: 当围蔽处所内的容量不超过船舶最大排水量的0.1%时，不必安装此类报警器。
Translation: Such alarms need not be installed when the enclosed space capacity does not exceed 0.1% of the ship's maximum displacement.

Query_Text_cn: 2在上述1中规定的听觉和视觉报警器应设于驾驶室。
Translation: The audible and visual alarms specified in paragraph 1 above shall be located in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 32004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行的年度检验、中间检验或换证检验时符合本条要求，取早者。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 2004, shall comply with the requirements of this regulation no later than the first annual survey, intermediate survey, or renewal survey conducted after July 1, 2004, whichever comes first.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船上，用于排放和泵吸位于防撞舱壁前方的压载舱的压载水，和任何部位延伸至首货舱前的干燥处所的舱底水的设备，应能从一个可进入的围蔽处所内将其运行，该围蔽处所应能从驾驶室或主机控制站进入而无需穿过露天干舷甲板或上层建筑甲板。
Translation: 1.
