On bulk carriers, the equipment for discharging and pumping ballast water from ballast tanks located forward of the collision bulkhead, as well as bilge water from any dry spaces extending forward of the foremost cargo hold, shall be operable from an accessible enclosed space. This enclosed space must be reachable from the navigating bridge or the machinery control station without traversing the exposed freeboard deck or superstructure deck.

Query_Text_cn: 如果用于这些舱或舱底水的管路穿过防撞舱壁，作为第II-1/11.4条规定的阀的控制的替代措施，只要此类阀门控制器的位置符合本条的规定，也可接受通过遥控启动阀门操作的装置。
Translation: If the piping serving such tanks or bilges passes through the collision bulkhead, it is acceptable to have remotely operated devices for activating the valve as an alternative to the valve control required by regulation II-1/11.4, provided that the location of such valve controls complies with the requirements of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 22004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行第一次中间检验或换证检验时，但无论如何不得迟于2007年7月1日符合本条要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before 1 July 2004 shall comply with the requirements of this regulation by the date of the first intermediate or renewal survey after 1 July 2004, but in no case later than 1 July 2007.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.145(77)决议通过的《散货船水位探测器性能标准》。
Translation: ①Refer to the Performance Standards for Water Level Detectors on Bulk Carriers adopted by resolution MSC.145(77) of the Organization's Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.1069《对SOLAS公约第XII/13条的解释》。
Translation: ② Refer to IMO Circular MSC/Circ.1069 "Interpretation of SOLAS Regulation XII/13."

Query_Text_cn: 1现行生效的1974年国际海上人命安全公约（1974年SOLAS公约）是由国际海事组织（IMO）于1974年11月1日召开的国际海上人命安全公约会议通过的，并于1980年5月25日生效。
Translation: The currently effective International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS 1974) was adopted at the International Conference on Safety of Life at Sea convened by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) on November 1, 1974, and entered into force on May 25, 1980.

Query_Text_cn: 2国际检验与发证协调系统会议1988年11月11日通过的议定书（1988年SOLAS议定书），于2000年2月3日生效，并在1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间替代并废除1978年SOLAS议定书。
Translation: The Protocol of 1988 Relating to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1974 (1988 SOLAS Protocol), adopted on 11 November 1988 by the Conference on the Harmonized System of Survey and Certification, entered into force on 3 February 2000. It supersedes and repeals the 1978 SOLAS Protocol among the Contracting Governments to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 27以1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府会议决议1通过的2002年12月修正案，于2004年7月1日生效。
Translation: The amendments adopted in December 2002 by Resolution 1 of the Conference of Contracting Governments to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1974, entered into force on 1 July 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 28以MSC.142(77)决议通过的2003年6月修正案。
Translation: Amendment adopted in June 2003 by resolution MSC.142(77).

Query_Text_cn: 29以MSC.151(78)决议（第II-1/3-6条）、MSC.152(78)决议（第III章和第IV章及附则的附录）和MSC.153(78)决议（第V章）通过的2004年5月修正案。
Translation: The amendments adopted in May 2004 by resolutions MSC.151(78) (regulation II-1/3-6), MSC.152(78) (chapters III and IV and appendices to the annex) and MSC.153(78) (chapter V).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过这些修正案时决定，这些修正案应分别于2005年7月1日、2006年1月1日和2006年1月1日视为已被接受，除非在这些日期以前，三分之一以上的SOLAS公约缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对这些修正案。
Translation: In adopting these amendments, the Maritime Safety Committee decided that they shall be deemed to have been accepted on 1 July 2005, 1 January 2006, and 1 January 2006 respectively, unless prior to these dates, more than one-third of the Governments of the SOLAS Contracting Parties, or Contracting Parties the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than 50% of the gross tonnage of the world's merchant shipping, have notified their objections to the amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将分别于2006年1月1日、2006年7月1日和2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: If these amendments are accepted, they will enter into force on January 1, 2006, July 1, 2006, and July 1, 2006, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 其生效条件于2003年7月1日达到，该修正案于2004年1月1日生效。
Translation: The conditions for its entry into force were met on July 1, 2003, and the amendment took effect on January 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 1988年SOLAS议定书还经MSC.154(78)决议通过的2004年5月修正案作了修正。
Translation: The 1988 SOLAS Protocol was also amended by the May 2004 amendments adopted by resolution MSC.154(78).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过该修正案时决定，该修正案将于2006年1月1日应视为已被接受，除非在此日期以前，三分之一以上的1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对该修正案。
Translation: In adopting the amendment, the Maritime Safety Committee decided that it shall be deemed to have been accepted on 1 January 2006 unless, prior to that date, more than one third of the Governments of Parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, or Governments of Parties the combined merchant fleets of which constitute not less than 50% of the gross tonnage of the world's merchant shipping, have notified their objections to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将于2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: If these amendments are accepted, they will come into effect on July 1, 2006.

Query_Text_cn: 4本出版物包括了1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及其后直到并包括2002年12月修正案的全部修正案的综合文本。
Translation: The four publications comprise the consolidated text of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and all amendments up to and including those adopted in December 2002.

Query_Text_cn: IMO秘书处编辑了合成文本，其用意是便于参照2004年7月1日起适用的SOLAS公约要求。
Translation: The IMO Secretariat has compiled a consolidated text intended to facilitate reference to the SOLAS Convention requirements applicable from 1 July 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 2第2部分，包括关于全球统一执行检验和发证协调系统（HSSC）的A.883(21)决议、船上应具备的证书和文件①清单、前述的SOLAS公约缔约国会议通过的决议清单以及SOLAS公约第II-1章第12-2条。
Translation: Part 2 includes Resolution A.883(21) on the Harmonized System of Survey and Certification (HSSC), a list of required certificates and documents carried on board, the aforementioned list of resolutions adopted by the SOLAS Conference of Contracting Governments, and SOLAS Chapter II-1 Regulation 12-2.

Query_Text_cn: 证书清单包括了规定的所有证书和文件的用途简述，以便有助于岸上工作人员、官员和船长评估证书和文件，这些对港口国控制和船舶在港内的顺利作业都是必需的。
Translation: The certificate checklist includes a brief description of the purpose of all specified certificates and documents to assist shore-based personnel, officers, and the ship's master in evaluating the certificates and documents, which are essential for port State control and the smooth operation of the ship in port.

Query_Text_cn: 6总体而言，本综合文本所包含的作业方面要求适用于所有船舶，而有关船舶构造和设备的要求只适用于各个条款所规定的日期或其后建造的船舶。
Translation: 6 In general, the operational requirements contained in this consolidated text apply to all ships, while the requirements concerning ship construction and equipment apply only to ships constructed on or after the dates specified in the respective provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 为确定适用于2001年以前建造船舶的构造和设备要求，应查阅以前的1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及本公约修正案。
Translation: To determine the construction and equipment requirements applicable to ships built before 2001, reference should be made to the earlier 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and amendments to the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，对现有客船的特殊要求未包含在1981年修正案的第II-2章中，也没有包含在本综合文本之中，而是只包含在原始的1974年SOLAS公约第II-2章的F部分之中。
Translation: For instance, the specific requirements for existing passenger ships were not incorporated in Chapter II-2 of the 1981 amendments, nor are they included in this consolidated text, but are solely contained in Part F of Chapter II-2 of the original 1974 SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 而经1978年SOLAS议定书修改的1974年SOLAS公约其他各章的有关规定无类似符号表示，因为在本公约第I章中的有关规定已被1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间所替代并废除的同时，这些规定业已被其后通过的SOLAS公约修正案所替代。
Translation: However, the relevant provisions in other chapters of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, as amended by the 1978 SOLAS Protocol, are not marked with similar symbols, because while the corresponding provisions in Chapter I of the Convention have been superseded and abrogated among the Parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, these provisions have already been replaced by subsequent amendments to the SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 8总体而言，本出版物收入了1974年SOLAS公约和1988年SOLAS议定书的文本，并包括了在其正式文本中所给出的修改和修正案内容。
Translation: Overall, this publication contains the texts of the 1974 SOLAS Convention and the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, incorporating the amendments and modifications as presented in their official texts.

Query_Text_cn: 4已按A.351(IX)决议采用国际单位制（SI）的公制值。
Translation: 4 The metric values of the International System of Units (SI) have been adopted in accordance with Resolution A.351(IX).

Query_Text_cn: 9本综合文本中的脚注（正如海上安全委员会（MSC）所说明的，其并不构成公约的一部分，之所以引入，只是为了便于参照）提出与某一特定条文有关的规则、指南和建议案供参照，并已由秘书处在出版时加以更新。
Translation: The footnotes in these nine consolidated texts (which, as explained by the Maritime Safety Committee (MSC), do not form part of the Convention and are introduced solely for ease of reference) provide references to rules, guidelines, and recommendations related to specific provisions, and have been updated by the Secretariat at the time of publication.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还根据规则、指南和建议案及其他MSC决定的有关文本，插入一些解释性脚注。
Translation: In addition,explanatory footnotes have been inserted based on rules,guidelines,recommendations,and other relevant texts decided by the MSC.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，读者都必须使用所指文本的最新版本，并记住：这些文本可能已被自经修正的本公约综合文本出版以后的更新材料所修改或废除。
Translation: In all cases, readers must use the latest version of the referenced texts and bear in mind that these texts may have been modified or repealed by subsequent updates issued after the publication of the consolidated text of this Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: 按照第七十六条的规定，应依本附件以下各条成立一个二百海里以外大陆架界限委员会。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of Article 76, a Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf beyond 200 nautical miles shall be established under the following articles of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本委员会应由二十一名委员组成，委员应是地质学、地球物理学或水文学方面的专家，由本公约缔约国从其国民中选出，选举时应妥为顾及确保公平地区代表制的必要，委员应以个人身分任职。
Translation: 1. The Commission shall consist of twenty-one members who shall be experts in geology, geophysics or hydrology, elected by the States Parties to this Convention from among their nationals, with due regard to the need to ensure equitable geographical representation. The members shall serve in their personal capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 2.初次选举应尽快举行，无论如何应在本公约生效之日后十八个月内举行。
Translation: 2. The first election shall be held as soon as possible, and in any case within eighteen months after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国秘书长应在每次选举之日前至少三个月发信给各缔约国，邀请它们在进行适当的区域协商后于三个月内提出候选人。
Translation: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall, no later than three months before the date of each election, address a letter to the States Parties inviting them to submit their nominations within three months following appropriate regional consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长应依字母次序编制所有候选人的名单，并将名单提交所有缔约国。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall prepare a list of all candidates in alphabetical order and submit it to all States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会委员的选举应由秘书长在联合国总部召开缔约国会议举行。
Translation: 3. The election of Committee members shall be conducted at a meeting of States Parties convened by the Secretary-General at United Nations Headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 在该次会议上，缔约国的三分之二应构成法定人数，获得出席并参加表决的缔约国代表三分之二多数票的候选人应当选为委员会委员。
Translation: At that meeting, two-thirds of the States Parties shall constitute a quorum, and the candidate who obtains a two-thirds majority of the votes of the representatives of States Parties present and voting shall be elected to the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 从每一地理区域应至少选出三名委员。
Translation: At least three members shall be elected from each geographical region.

Query_Text_cn: 连选可连任。
Translation: Eligible for re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 5.提出委员会委员候选人的缔约国应承担该委员在执行委员会职务期间的费用。
Translation: The nominating State Party shall bear the expenses of the Committee member during the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 有关沿海国应承担为提供本附件第三条第1款(b)项所指的咨询意见而引起的费用。
Translation: Coastal States shall bear the expenses incurred in providing the advisory opinions referred to in paragraph 1(b) of Article 3 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会秘书处应由联合国秘书长提供。
Translation: The secretariat of the Committee shall be provided by the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (b)经有关沿海国请求，在编制(a)项所述资料时，提供科学和技术咨询意见。
Translation: (b) Provide scientific and technical advice upon the request of the coastal State concerned in the preparation of the information referred to in subparagraph (a).

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会可在认为必要和有用的范围内与联合国教科文组织的政府间海洋学委员会、国际水文学组织及其他主管国际组织合作，以求交换可能有助于委员会执行职务的科学和技术情报。
Translation: 2. The Commission may cooperate, to the extent it deems necessary and useful, with the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO, the International Hydrographic Organization, and other competent international organizations for the exchange of scientific and technical information that may assist the Commission in the exercise of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 拟按照第七十六条划定其二百海里以外大陆架外部界限的沿海国，应将这种界限的详情连同支持这种界限的科学和技术资料，尽早提交委员会，而且无论如何应于本公约对该国生效后十年内提出。
Translation: A coastal State which intends to establish the outer limits of its continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles shall submit particulars of such limits to the Commission along with supporting scientific and technical data as soon as possible, but in any case within 10 years of the entry into force of this Convention for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应同时提出曾向其提供科学和技术咨询意见的委员会内任何委员的姓名。
Translation: The coastal state shall at the same time provide the names of any members of the Commission who provided it with scientific and technical advice.

Query_Text_cn: 除委员会另有决定外，委员会应由七名委员组成的小组委员会执行职务，小组委员会委员应以平衡方式予以任命，同时考虑到沿海国提出的每一划界案的具体因素。
Translation: Unless the Commission decides otherwise, it shall function by way of sub-commissions composed of seven members, appointed in a balanced manner taking into account the specific factors of each submission by the coastal State.

Query_Text_cn: 为已提出划界案的沿海国国民的委员会委员，或曾提供关于划界的科学和技术咨询意见以协助该国的委员会委员，不得成为处理该案的小组委员会委员，但应有权以委员身分参与委员会处理该案的程序。
Translation: A member of the Commission who is a national of a coastal State that has submitted a delimitation claim, or who has provided scientific or technical advice concerning the delimitation to assist that State, shall not be eligible to serve as a member of the subcommission dealing with that claim, but shall have the right to participate as a member in the Commission's proceedings concerning that claim.

Query_Text_cn: 向委员会提出划界案的沿海国可派代表参与有关的程序，但无表决权。
Translation: A coastal State that has submitted a delimitation claim to the Commission may send representatives to participate in the relevant proceedings but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 1.小组委员会应将其建议提交委员会。
Translation: 1. The subcommittee shall submit its recommendations to the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.小组委员会的建议应由委员会以出席并参加表决的委员三分之二多数核准。
Translation: 2. The recommendations of the subcommittee shall be approved by the committee with a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会的建议应以书面递交提出划界案的沿海国和联合国秘书长。
Translation: 3. The recommendations of the Commission shall be submitted in writing to the coastal State which made the submission and to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应依第七十六条第8款的规定并按照适当国家程序划定大陆架的外部界限。
Translation: Coastal States shall delineate the outer limits of the continental shelf in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 8 of Article 76 and in compliance with appropriate national procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 在沿海国不同意委员会建议的情形下，沿海国应于合理期间内向委员会提出订正的或新的划界案。
Translation: In cases where the coastal state does not agree with the recommendations of the Commission, it shall, within a reasonable period of time, submit to the Commission a revised or new submission.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的行动不应妨害海岸相向或相邻国家间划定界限的事项。
Translation: The actions of the Commission shall not prejudice matters relating to the delimitation of boundaries between States with opposite or adjacent coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 矿物按照本公约回收时，其所有权即转移。
Translation: When minerals are recovered in accordance with this Convention, their ownership shall be transferred.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)管理局应鼓励在“区域”内探矿。
Translation: 1.(a) The Authority shall encourage prospecting in the Area.

Query_Text_cn: (b)探矿只有在管理局收到一项令人满意的书面承诺以后才可进行，申请探矿者应在其中承诺遵守本公约和管理局关于在第一四三和第一四四条所指的训练方案方面进行合作以及保护海洋环境的规则、规章和程序，并接受管理局对其是否加以遵守进行查核。
Translation: (b) Prospecting shall be conducted only after the Authority has received a satisfactory written undertaking that the prospector will comply with this Convention and the rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority concerning cooperation in the training programmes referred to in articles 143 and 144 and the protection of the marine environment, and accept verification by the Authority of compliance therewith.

Query_Text_cn: 申请探矿者在提出承诺的同时，应将准备进行探矿的一个或多个区域的大约面积通知管理局。
Translation: When applying for prospecting, the prospector shall, while making the commitment, notify the Authority of the approximate size of one or more areas in which prospecting is to be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: (c)一个以上的探矿者可在同一个或几个区域内同时进行探矿。
Translation: (c) More than one prospector may conduct prospecting simultaneously within the same or multiple areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2.探矿不应使探矿者取得对资源的任何权利。
Translation: 2. Prospecting shall not confer upon the prospector any rights to the resources.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，探矿者可回收合理数量的矿物供试验之用。
Translation: However, prospectors may recover a reasonable quantity of minerals for testing purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部、缔约国和第一五三条第2款(b)项所指的其他实体，可向管理局申请核准其关于“区域”内活动的工作计划。
Translation: 1. The Enterprise, States Parties, and other entities referred to in Article 153, paragraph 2(b), may apply to the Authority for approval of plans of work for activities in the Area.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可对“区域”的任何部分提出申请，但其他方面对保留区域的申请，应受本附件第九条各项附加条件的限制。
Translation: 2. The Enterprise may submit an application with respect to any part of the Area, but applications by others with respect to reserved areas shall be subject to the additional conditions set forth in article 9 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.勘探和开发应只在第一五三条第3款所指的，并经管理局按照本公约以及管理局的有关规则、规章和程序核准的工作计划中所列明的区域内进行。
Translation: 3. Exploration and exploitation shall be carried out only in areas specified in plans of work referred to in Article 153, paragraph 3, and approved by the Authority in accordance with this Convention and the relevant rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: (c)按照管理局的规则、规章和程序，授予经营者在工作计划所包括的区域内勘探和开发指明类别的资源的专属权利。
Translation: (c) Grant the operator exclusive rights to explore for and develop specified categories of resources in the area covered by the work plan, in accordance with the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果申请者申请核准只包括勘探阶段和开发阶段的工作计划，核准的工作计划应只就该阶段给予这种专属权利。
Translation: If the applicant applies for approval of a work program that includes only the exploration phase and the development phase, the approved work program shall grant such exclusive rights solely for the respective phase.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经管理局核准后，每项工作计划，除企业部提出者外，应采取由管理局和一个或几个申请者订立合同的形式。
Translation: 5. Upon approval by the Authority, each work plan, except those submitted by the Enterprise, shall be in the form of a contract between the Authority and one or more applicants.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部以外的申请者如具备第一五三条第2款(b)项所指明的国籍或控制和担保，且如遵守管理局规则、规章和程序所载列的程序并符合其中规定的资格标准，即应取得资格。
Translation: 1. Applicants other than the Enterprise shall be qualified if they have the nationality or control and sponsorship required by article 153, paragraph 2(b), and if they comply with the procedures set forth and meet the qualification standards prescribed in the rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2.除第6款所规定者外，上述资格标准应包括申请者的财政和技术能力及其履行以前同管理局订立的任何合同的情形。
Translation: 2. Except as provided in paragraph 6, the qualification criteria referred to above shall include the financial and technical capabilities of the applicant and its performance under any previous contracts with the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一申请者应由其国籍所属的缔约国担保，除非申请者具有一个以上的国籍，例如几个国家的实体组成的合伙团体或财团，在这种情形下，所有涉及的缔约国都应担保申请；或者除非申请者是由另一个缔约国或其国民有效控制，在这种情形下，两个缔约国都应担保申请。
Translation: 3. Each applicant shall be sponsored by the State Party of which it is a national, except where the applicant has more than one nationality, as in the case of a partnership or consortium of entities from several States, in which case all the States Parties involved shall sponsor the application; or unless the applicant is effectively controlled by another State Party or its nationals, in which case both States Parties shall sponsor the application.

Query_Text_cn: 实施担保规定的标准和程序应载入管理局的规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The standards and procedures for the implementation of security regulations shall be incorporated into the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 4.担保国应按照第一三九条，负责在其法律制度范围内，确保所担保的承包者应依据合同条款及其在本公约下的义务进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: 4. The sponsoring State shall, in accordance with Article 139, be responsible for ensuring, within its legal system, that sponsored contractors carry out activities in the Area in conformity with the terms of the contract and their obligations under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但如该担保国已制定法律和规章并采取行政措施，而这些法律和规章及行政措施在其法律制度范围内可以合理地认为足以使在其管辖下的人遵守时，则该国对其所担保的承包者因不履行义务而造成的损害，应无赔偿责任。
Translation: However, if the sponsoring State has established laws and regulations and taken administrative measures which, within the framework of its legal system, can reasonably be considered sufficient to ensure compliance by persons under its jurisdiction, then the State shall not be liable for damage caused by any failure of the contractor it sponsors to meet its obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国为申请者时，审查其资格的程序，应顾及申请者是国家的特性。
Translation: 5. When the applicant is a State Party, the procedure for examining its qualifications shall take into account the specific characteristics of the applicant as a state.

Query_Text_cn: (d)遵守本附件第五条所载有关技术转让的规定。
Translation: (d) Comply with the provisions on technology transfer as set forth in Article 5 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.每一申请者在提出工作计划时，应向管理局提交关于进行“区域”内活动所使用的装备和方法的一般性说明，以及关于这种技术的特征的其他非专有的有关情报和可以从何处取得这种技术的情报。
Translation: 1. Each applicant, when submitting a work plan, shall provide the Authority with a general description of the equipment and methods to be used in carrying out activities in the Area, as well as other relevant non-proprietary information on the characteristics of such technology and where such technology is available.

Query_Text_cn: 2.经营者每当作出重大的技术改变或革新时，均应将对依据第1款提出的说明和情报所作的修改通知管理局。
Translation: 2. Whenever operators make significant technological changes or innovations, they shall notify the Authority of any modifications to the explanations and information provided pursuant to paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: (a)经管理局一旦提出要求，即以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供他根据合同进行“区域”内活动时所使用而且该承包者在法律上有权转让的技术。
Translation: (a) Upon the request of the Authority, the contractor shall make available to the Enterprise, under fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, any technology which it uses in carrying out activities in the Area under the contract and which the contractor is legally entitled to transfer.

Query_Text_cn: 这应以承包者与企业部商定并在补充合同的特别协议中订明的特许方式或其他适当安排来履行。
Translation: This shall be fulfilled through concession or other appropriate arrangements as agreed between the contractor and the Enterprise and stipulated in the special agreement of the supplementary contract.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用，但通常不能在公开市场上获得，而且为(a)项所不包括的任何技术，从技术所有人取得书面保证，经管理局一旦提出要求，技术所有人将以特许方式或其他适当安排，并以公平合理的商业条款和条件，在向承包者提供这种技术的同样程度上向企业部提供这种技术。
Translation: (b) Obtain from the owner of any technology used in carrying out activities in the Area under contract, which is not generally available on the open market and is not covered by subparagraph (a), a written assurance that the owner will, upon request by the Authority, make that technology available to the Enterprise under licence or other appropriate arrangements and on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, to the same extent as made available to the contractor.

Query_Text_cn: (c)经企业部提出要求，而承包者又不致因此承担巨大费用时，对承包者根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用而在法律上无权转让，并且通常不能在公开市场上获得的任何技术，通过一项可以执行的合同，从技术所有人取得转让给企业部的法律权利。
Translation: (c) Upon the request of the Enterprise and provided that the contractor does not thereby incur significant costs, the contractor shall secure, through an enforceable contract, the legal right to transfer to the Enterprise any technology used by the contractor in carrying out activities in the Area under the contract, which the contractor is legally not entitled to transfer and which is not generally available on the open market.

Query_Text_cn: 在承包者与技术所有人之间具有实质性公司关系的情形下，应参酌这种关系的密切程度和控制或影响的程度来判断是否已采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: In cases where there is a substantive corporate relationship between the contractor and the technology owner, the closeness of such relationship and the degree of control or influence should be taken into account in determining whether all feasible measures have been taken.

Query_Text_cn: (e)为了按照本附件第九条申请合同的发展中国家或发展中国家集团的利益，采取(a)、(b)、(c)和(d)项所规定的相同措施，但此项措施应以对承包者所提出的按照本附件第八条已予保留的一部分区域的开发为限，而且该发展中国家或发展中国家集团所申请的根据合同进行的活动须不涉及对第三国或第三国国民的技术转让。
Translation: (e) To adopt the same measures specified in (a), (b), (c), and (d) for the benefit of a developing State or group of developing States applying for a contract under Article 9 of this Annex, provided that such measures shall be limited to the development of a reserved portion of the area proposed by the contractor under Article 8 of this Annex, and the activities applied for by the developing State or group of developing States under the contract shall not involve the transfer of technology to a third State or its nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本项的义务应只在尚未经企业部要求提供技术或尚未由特定承包者向企业部转让的情形下，才对该承包者适用。
Translation: The obligations under this provision shall apply to a contractor only if the technology has not been requested by the Enterprise or transferred to the Enterprise by a specific contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 4.关于第3款所要求的承诺的争端，象合同其他规定一样，均应按照第十一部分提交强制解决程序，遇有违反这种承诺的情形，则可按照本附件第十八条命令暂停或终止合同或课以罚款。
Translation: 4. Disputes concerning the commitments required under paragraph 3 shall be subject to the compulsory dispute settlement procedures under Part XI, like any other provision of the contract. In case of a breach of such commitments, suspension or termination of the contract or the imposition of monetary penalties may be ordered in accordance with Article 18 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 关于承包者所作提议是否在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围内的争端，可由任何一方按照联合国国际贸易法委员会的仲裁规则或管理局的规则、规章和程序可能有所规定的其他仲裁规则，提交有拘束力的商业仲裁。
Translation: Disputes concerning whether a contractor's proposal falls within the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions may be submitted by either party to binding commercial arbitration in accordance with the arbitration rules of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law or such other arbitration rules as may be prescribed in the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果裁决认为承包者所作提议不在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围以内，则在管理局按照本附件第十八条采取任何行动以前，应给予承包者四十五天的时间以修改其提议，使其合乎上述范围。
Translation: If the ruling determines that the contractor's proposal does not fall within the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, the contractor shall be given 45 days to revise its proposal to bring it into compliance with such scope before the Authority takes any action under Article 18 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如果企业部未能以公平合理的商业条款和条件取得适当的技术，使其能及时开始回收和加工“区域”的矿物，理事会或大会可召集由从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、担保实体从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、以及可以取得这种技术的其他缔约国组成的一个集团。
Translation: 5. If the Enterprise is unable to obtain appropriate technology on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions to enable it to commence in a timely manner the recovery and processing of minerals from the Area, the Council or the Assembly may convene a group composed of States Parties engaged in activities in the Area, States Parties which have sponsored entities engaged in activities in the Area, and other States Parties which have access to such technology.

Query_Text_cn: 这个集团应共同协商，并应采取有效措施，以保证这种技术以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供。
Translation: The Group shall consult together and take effective measures to ensure that such technology is made available to the Enterprise on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个这种缔约国都应在其自己的法律制度范围内，为此目的采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: Each such State Party shall take all feasible measures within its own legal system to this end.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在同企业部进行联合企业的情形下，技术转让将按照联合企业协议的条款进行。
Translation: 6. In the case of joint ventures with the Enterprise, technology transfer shall be conducted in accordance with the terms of the joint venture agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 7.第3款所要求的承诺应列入进行“区域”内活动的每一个合同，至企业部开始商业生产后十年为止，在这段期间内可援引这些承诺。
Translation: 7. The commitments required under paragraph 3 shall be incorporated in each contract for activities in the Area until ten years after the commencement of commercial production by the Enterprise, during which period they may be invoked.

Query_Text_cn: 8.为本条的目的，“技术”是指专用设备和技术知识，包括为装配、维护和操作一个可行的系统所必要的手册、设计、操作指示、训练及技术咨询和支援，以及在非专属性的基础上为该目的使用以上各个项目的法律权利。
Translation: 8.For the purposes of this Article,"technology"means specialized equipment and technical know-how,including manuals,designs,operating instructions,training,and technical advice and assistance necessary for the assembly,maintenance,and operation of a viable system,as well as legal rights to use the aforementioned items for such purposes on a non-exclusive basis.

Query_Text_cn: 1.管理局应于本公约生效后六个月，以及其后每逢第四个月，对提议的工作计划进行审查。
Translation: 1. The Authority shall examine proposed plans of work six months after the entry into force of this Convention and thereafter at each fourth month.

Query_Text_cn: (a)申请者是否遵守按照本附件第四条规定的申请程序，并已向管理局提供该条所规定的任何这种承诺和保证。
Translation: (a) Whether the applicant has complied with the application procedures stipulated in Article 4 of this Annex and has provided the Authority with any such commitments and assurances as required by that Article.

Query_Text_cn: (b)申请者是否具备本附件第四条所规定的必要资格。
Translation: (b) Whether the applicant possesses the necessary qualifications stipulated in Article 4 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.所有提议的工作计划，应按其收到的顺序予以处理。
Translation: 3. All proposed work plans shall be processed in the order of their receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 提议的工作计划应符合并遵守本公约的有关条款以及管理局各项规则、规章和程序，其中包括关于作业条件、财政贡献和有关技术转让承诺的那些规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The proposed work plan shall conform to and comply with the relevant provisions of this Convention as well as the rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority, including those on operational conditions, financial contributions and undertakings with regard to the transfer of technology.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在非保留区域进行勘探和开发多金属结核的工作计划，而这些区域合并计算构成海底区域中未予保留或未依据第一六二条第2款(X)项不准开发的部分的总面积的百分之二。
Translation: (2) Work plans for exploration and exploitation of polymetallic nodules in non-reserved areas, which when combined constitute 2 percent of the total area of the seabed not reserved or not prohibited from exploitation under paragraph 2(x) of Article 162.

Query_Text_cn: 4.为了第3款(c)项所指标准的目的，一个合伙团体或财团所提议的工作计划应在按照本附件第四条第3款规定提出担保的各缔约国间按比例计算。
Translation: 4. For the purposes of the criteria in paragraph 3(c), the proposed work plan of a partnership or consortium shall be apportioned among the sponsoring States Parties in proportion to their sponsorship under paragraph 3 of Article 4 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局确定第3款(c)项所述工作计划的核准不致使一个缔约国或由其担保的实体垄断“区域”内活动的进行，或者排除其他缔约国进行“区域”内活动，管理局可核准这种计划。
Translation: If the Authority determines that the approval of the work plan referred to in paragraph 3(c) would not result in a State Party or an entity sponsored by it monopolizing activities in the Area or excluding other States Parties from activities in the Area, the Authority may approve such a plan.

Query_Text_cn: 5.虽有第3款(a)项，在第一五一条第3款所规定的过渡期间结束后，管理局可以通过规则、规章和程序制订其他符合本公约规定的程序和准则，以便在须对提议区域的申请者作出选择的情形下，决定哪些工作计划应予核准。
Translation: 5. Notwithstanding subparagraph (a) of paragraph 3, after the expiration of the transitional period specified in paragraph 3 of Article 151, the Authority may adopt rules, regulations and procedures establishing other procedures and criteria consistent with this Convention for determining which plans of work shall be approved in cases where selection among applicants for proposed areas is required.

Query_Text_cn: 这些程序和准则应确保在公平和无歧视的基础上核准工作计划。
Translation: These procedures and criteria shall ensure the approval of work plans on a fair and non-discriminatory basis.

Query_Text_cn: 如果核准所有这些申请不会超出第一五一条规定的生产限制或违背管理局按照该条参与的商品协定或安排下的义务，则管理局应发给所申请的许可。
Translation: The Authority shall issue the requested permits if approval of all such applications would not exceed the production limits set forth in Article 151 or contravene the obligations of the Authority under any commodity agreement or arrangement in which it participates pursuant to that article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果由于第一五一条第2至7款所规定的生产限制，或由于管理局按照第一五一条第1款的规定参与的商品协定或安排下的义务而必须在生产许可的申请者中作出选择时，管理局应以其规则、规章和程序中所订客观而无歧视的标准进行选择。
Translation: 2. If it becomes necessary to select among applicants for production authorizations due to the production limitations set forth in paragraphs 2 to 7 of Article 151 or the obligations of the Authority under commodity agreements or arrangements pursuant to paragraph 1 of Article 151, the Authority shall make the selection on the basis of objective and non-discriminatory standards set forth in its rules, regulations and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在探矿和勘探方面已投入最多资源和尽最大努力者。
Translation: (c) The party that has invested the most resources and made the greatest efforts in prospecting and exploration.

Query_Text_cn: 4.未在任何期间内被选定的申请者，在随后各段期间应有优先，直到其取得生产许可为止。
Translation: 4. Applicants not selected in any given period shall have priority in subsequent periods until they obtain production approval.

Query_Text_cn: 5.申请者的选择应考虑到有必要使所有缔约国，不论其社会经济制度或地理位置如何，都有更多的机会参加“区域”内活动，以避免对任何国家或制度有所歧视，并防止垄断这种活动。
Translation: The selection of applicants shall take into account the need to ensure greater opportunities for all States Parties, irrespective of their socio-economic systems or geographical locations, to participate in activities in the Area, so as to avoid discrimination against any State or system and to prevent monopolization of such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 6.当开发的保留区域少于非保留区域时，对保留区域生产许可的申请应有优先。
Translation: 6.When the developed reserved area is smaller than the non-reserved area,priority shall be given to applications for production permits in the reserved area.

Query_Text_cn: 7.本条所述的各项决定，应于每一段期间结束后尽快作出。
Translation: 7. The decisions referred to in this Article shall be made as soon as possible after the end of each period.

Query_Text_cn: 每项申请，除了企业部或任何其他实体就保留区域所提出者外，应包括一个总区域，它不一定是一个单一连续的区域，但须足够大并有足够的估计商业价值，可供从事两起采矿作业。
Translation: Each application, except those submitted by the Enterprise or any other entity concerning reserved areas, shall cover a total area that need not be a single continuous area but must be sufficiently large and of sufficient estimated commercial value to allow for two mining operations.

Query_Text_cn: 申请者应指明座标，将区域分成估计商业价值相等的两个部分，并且提交他所取得的关于这两个部分的所有资料。
Translation: The applicant shall specify coordinates that divide the area into two parts of approximately equal commercial value and submit all data obtained concerning these two parts.

Query_Text_cn: 在不妨害本附件第十七条所规定管理局的权力的情形下，提交的有关多金属结核的资料应涉及制图、试验、结核的丰度及其金属含量。
Translation: Without prejudice to the powers of the Authority under Article XVII of this Annex, the information to be submitted concerning polymetallic nodules shall relate to mapping, sampling, the abundance of nodules and their metal content.

Query_Text_cn: 在收到这些资料后的四十五天以内，管理局应指定哪一个部分专保留给管理局通过企业部或以与发展中国家协作的方式进行活动。
Translation: Within forty-five days of receiving these materials, the Authority shall designate which portions are to be reserved for activities conducted by the Authority through the Enterprise or in association with developing States.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局请一名独立专家来评断本条所要求的一切资料是否都已提交管理局，则作出这种指定的期间可以再延四十五天。
Translation: If the Authority engages an independent expert to assess whether all the information required under this article has been submitted to it, the period for making such a designation may be extended by an additional forty-five days.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦非保留区域的工作计划获得核准并经签订合同，指定的区域即应成为保留区域。
Translation: Once the work program for the non-reserved area is approved and the contract is signed, the designated area shall become a reserved area.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对每一个保留区域企业部应有机会决定是否有意在其内进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: 1. Each reserved area enterprise shall have the opportunity to determine whether it intends to conduct activities in the "Area" therein.

Query_Text_cn: 这项决定可在任何时间作出，除非管理局接到按照第4款发出的通知。在这种情形下，企业部应在合理时间内作出决定。
Translation: This decision may be made at any time unless the Authority receives a notice issued under paragraph 4. In such a case, the Enterprise shall make the decision within a reasonable time.

Query_Text_cn: 企业部可决定同有兴趣的国家或实体成立联合企业来开发这种区域。
Translation: The Enterprise may decide to enter into joint ventures with interested States or entities for the development of such areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可按照附件四第十二条订立关于执行其部分活动的合同，并可同任何按照第一五三条第2款(b)项有资格进行“区域”内活动的实体为进行这种活动成立联合企业。
Translation: 2. The Enterprise may enter into contracts for the execution of part of its activities in accordance with Annex IV, Article 12, and may form joint ventures with any entity eligible to carry out activities in the Area under Article 153, paragraph 2(b), for the purpose of such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 企业部在考虑成立这种联合企业时，应提供发展中国家缔约国及其国民有效参加的机会。
Translation: When considering the establishment of such joint ventures, the Enterprise shall provide opportunities for the effective participation of developing State Parties and their nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理局可在其规则、规章和程序内规定这种合同和联合企业的实质性和程序性要求和条件。
Translation: 3. The Authority may prescribe substantive and procedural requirements and conditions for such contracts and joint ventures within its rules, regulations and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何发展中国家缔约国，或该国所担保并受该国或受具有申请资格的另一发展中国家缔约国有效控制的任何自然人或法人，或上述各类的任何组合，可通知管理局愿意按照本附件第六条就某一保留区域提出工作计划。
Translation: 4. Any developing State Party, or any natural or juridical person sponsored by it and effectively controlled by it or by another developing State Party which is qualified to apply, or any group of the foregoing, may notify the Authority of its intention to submit a plan of work with respect to a reserved area in accordance with article 6 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果企业部按照第1款决定无意在该区域内进行活动，则应对该工作计划给予考虑。
Translation: If the Enterprise decides under paragraph 1 that it does not intend to carry out activities in the area, it shall consider the plan of work.

Query_Text_cn: 按本附件第三条第4款(c)项的规定取得核准只进行勘探的工作计划的经营者，就同一区域和资源在各申请者中应有取得开发工作计划的优惠和优先。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of paragraph 4(c) of Article III of this Annex, the operator who has obtained approval for a work plan limited to exploration shall have preference and priority among applicants for a development work plan with respect to the same area and resources.

Query_Text_cn: 但如经营者的工作成绩不令人满意时，这种优惠或优先可予撤销。
Translation: However, if the operator's performance is unsatisfactory, such preferential treatment or priority may be revoked.

Query_Text_cn: 1.合同可规定承包者同由企业部代表的管理局之间采用联合企业或分享产品的形式，或任何其他形式的联合安排，这些联合安排在修改、终止、暂停方面享有与管理局订立的合同相同的保障。
Translation: 1. The contract may stipulate joint ventures, production-sharing arrangements, or any other form of joint arrangement between the contractor and the Authority represented by the Enterprise, which shall enjoy the same safeguards regarding modification, termination, or suspension as contracts concluded with the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2.与企业部成立这种联合安排的承包者，可取得本附件第十三条中规定的财政鼓励。
Translation: 2. Contractors entering into such joint arrangements with the Enterprise may obtain the financial incentives provided for in article 13 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.同企业部组成的联合企业的合伙者，应按照其在联合企业中的份额负责缴付本附件第十三条所规定的款项，但须受该条规定的财政鼓励的限制。
Translation: 3. Partners in joint ventures with the Enterprise shall be responsible for the payment of the contributions specified in Article 13 of this Annex in proportion to their share in the joint venture, subject to the financial incentives provided for in that Article.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部依据第一五三条第2款(a)项进行的“区域”内活动，应遵守第十一部分，管理局的规则、规章和程序及其有关的决定。
Translation: Activities of the Enterprise in the Area pursuant to paragraph 2(a) of article 153 shall be governed by Part XI, the rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority and its relevant decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部提出的任何工作计划应随附证明其财政及技术能力的证据。
Translation: 2. Any work plan proposed by the Enterprise shall be accompanied by evidence demonstrating its financial and technical capabilities.

Query_Text_cn: (f)保证不致因依据第14款，按照本附件第十九条予以审查的合同条款或有关联合企业的本附件第十一条的规定向承包者提供财政鼓励，造成津贴承包者使其比陆上采矿者处于人为的竞争优势的结果。
Translation: (f) Ensure that the provision of financial incentives to contractors under paragraph 14, in accordance with the contract terms reviewed under Article 19 of this Annex or the provisions of joint ventures under Article 11 of this Annex, does not result in subsidizing contractors to grant them an artificial competitive advantage over land-based miners.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为支付处理关于核准合同形式的勘探和开发工作计划的申请的行政开支，应征收规费，并应规定每份申请的规费为五十万美元。
Translation: 2. A fee shall be levied to cover the administrative expenses incurred in processing applications for approval of the form of contracts for exploration and development work plans, with each application subject to a fee of five hundred thousand US dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 该规费应不时由理事会加以审查，以确保其足以支付处理这种申请的行政开支。
Translation: The fee shall be reviewed periodically by the Council to ensure it is sufficient to cover the administrative costs of processing such applications.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局处理申请的行政开支少于规费数额，管理局应将余额退还给申请者。
Translation: If the administrative expenses incurred by the Authority in processing an application are less than the prescribed fee, the Authority shall refund the balance to the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 3.承包者应自合同生效之日起，缴纳固定年费一百万美元。
Translation: 3. The contractor shall pay a fixed annual fee of one million US dollars from the effective date of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: 如果因为按照第一五一条发出生产许可有所稽延而推迟经核准的商业生产的开始日期，则在这段推迟期间内应免缴固定年费。
Translation: If the commencement date of approved commercial production is delayed due to delays in issuing the production license under Article 151, the fixed annual fee shall be waived during such deferred period.

Query_Text_cn: 自商业生产开始之日起，承包者应缴付第4款所指的财政贡献或固定年费，以较大的数额为准。
Translation: From the date of commencement of commercial production, the contractor shall pay the financial contribution referred to in paragraph 4 or the fixed annual fee, whichever is the greater.

Query_Text_cn: (b)同时缴付生产费和一份收益净额。
Translation: (b) Simultaneously pay the production fee and a portion of the net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: (b) The said market value shall be the product of the quantity of the processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract in the relevant accounting year and the average prices of these metals, as determined in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 7 and 8.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在(d)项所规定的商业生产第二期的任何一个会计年度内，按百分之四缴付生产费的结果会使(m)项所规定的投资利得降低到百分之十五以下，则该会计年度的生产费应为百分之二而非百分之四。
Translation: If in any fiscal year of the second phase of commercial production as specified in paragraph (d), the payment of production fees at four percent would reduce the investment return as stipulated in paragraph (m) to below fifteen percent, the production fee for that fiscal year shall be two percent instead of four percent.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: (b) The said market value shall be the product of the quantity of the processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract in the relevant accounting year and the average price of those metals, as calculated in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 7 and 8.

Query_Text_cn: (c)⑴管理局在收益净额中的份额应自承包者因开采合同包括的区域资源所得到的那一部分收益净额中拨付，这笔款额以下称为开发合同区域收益净额。
Translation: (c)(1) The share of the Authority in the net proceeds shall be paid out of that portion of the net proceeds derived by the contractor from the resources of the area covered by the contract, which portion shall hereinafter be referred to as the net proceeds from the contract area.

Query_Text_cn: 在承担发展费用的第一个会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于发展费用减去该年的现金赢余。
Translation: In the first fiscal year of bearing development costs, the unrecovered development costs shall equal the total development costs minus the cash surplus for that year.

Query_Text_cn: 在以后的每一人会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于前一会计年度未收回的发展费用加上发展费用以年利十分计算的利息，加上本会计年度所承担的发展费用，减去承包者本会计年度的现金赢余。
Translation: In each subsequent fiscal year, the unrecovered development costs shall equal the unrecovered development costs from the previous fiscal year plus interest on such costs at an annual rate of 10 percent, plus the development costs incurred during the current fiscal year, minus the cash surplus of the contractor for the current fiscal year.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵商业生产的第二期，应从商业生产的第一期终了后下一个会计年度开始，并应继续至合同结束时为止。
Translation: (2) The second phase of commercial production shall commence from the fiscal year immediately following the conclusion of the first phase of commercial production and shall continue until the termination of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (e)“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者收益净额乘以在承包者发展费用中其采矿部门发展费用所占比率的乘积数。
Translation: (e) "Net proceeds from the development of the contract area" means the product of the net proceeds of the contractor multiplied by the ratio of its mining sector development costs to the total development costs of the contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产三种加工金属，即钴、铜和镍，则开发合同区域收益净额不应少于承包者收益净额的百分之二十五。
Translation: If the contractor engages in the exploitation and transportation of polymetallic nodules and primarily produces three processed metals, namely cobalt, copper, and nickel, the net proceeds from the development of the contract area shall not be less than twenty-five percent of the contractor's net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: 在(n)项规定的限制下，在所有其他情形，包括承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产四种加工金属，即钴、铜、锰和镍的情形下，管理局可在其规则、规章和程序中规定适当的最低限额，这种限额与每一种情形的关系，应与百分之二十五的最低限额与三种金属和情形的关系相同。
Translation: Subject to the limitations provided in paragraph (n), in all other cases, including those where the contractor engages in mining, transporting polymetallic nodules and the primary production of four processed metals, namely cobalt, copper, manganese and nickel, the Authority may prescribe in its rules, regulations and procedures appropriate minimum limits, which shall bear the same relationship to each case as the 25 per cent limit does to the three metals and cases mentioned.

Query_Text_cn: (f)“承包者收益净额”是指承包者收益毛额减去其业务费用再减去按照(j)项收回的发展费用。
Translation: (f) "Net proceeds of the contractor" means the gross proceeds of the contractor minus its operating costs and minus the development costs recovered in accordance with subparagraph (j).

Query_Text_cn: (g)⑴如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、生产加工金属，则“承包者收益毛额”是指出售加工金属的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (g)(1) If the contractor engages in the exploitation, transportation of polymetallic nodules, and the production and processing of metals, the "gross proceeds of the contractor" shall mean the gross revenue from the sale of processed metals, as well as any other payments reasonably attributable to operations conducted under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵除(g)项(l)目和(n)项⑶目所列举者外，在所有其他情形下，“承包者收益毛额”是指出售自合同包括的区域回收物的金属结核生产的半加工金属所得收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (2) Except as provided in subparagraphs (g)(i) and (n)(iii), in all other cases, "gross proceeds of the contractor" means the gross revenues from the sale of semi-processed metals produced from the polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract, and any other amounts reasonably attributable to operations under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在商业生产开始后，为执行工作计划而需要承担的与以上⑴目所载相类似的开支，但可计入业务费用的开支除外。
Translation: (2) After the commencement of commercial production, expenditures similar to those specified in item (1) above that are necessary for the implementation of work plans, excluding those that may be accounted for as business expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (i)处理7资本资产所得的收益，以及合同所规定的业务不再需要而又未予出售的那些资本资产的市场价值，应从有关的会计年度的承包者发展费用中扣除。
Translation: (i) Proceeds from the disposal of capital assets, as well as the market value of those capital assets that are no longer required for the operations specified in the contract and have not been sold, shall be deducted from the contractor's development costs for the relevant accounting year.

Query_Text_cn: 这些扣除的数额超过承包者发展费用时，超过部分应计入承包者收益毛额。
Translation: When the amount of these deductions exceeds the contractor's development costs, the excess shall be included in the contractor's gross proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: (j)(h)项⑴目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始之前承担的承包者发展费用，应从商业生产开始之日起，平均分为十期收回，每年一期。
Translation: The development costs of the contractor incurred before the commencement of commercial production, as referred to in subparagraph (j)(h)(1) and subparagraph (n)(4), shall be recovered in ten equal annual installments commencing from the date of the commencement of commercial production.

Query_Text_cn: (h)项⑵目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始以后承担的承包者发展费用，应平均分为十期或不到十期收回，每年一期，以确保在合同结束前全部收回。
Translation: The development costs of the contractor referred to in subparagraph (h)(ii) and subparagraph (n)(iv), incurred after the commencement of commercial production, shall be recovered in ten equal annual installments or fewer to ensure full recovery before the expiration of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (k)“承包者业务费用”是指在商业生产开始后，为合同所规定的业务，而依照一般公认的会计原则所承担的经营合同包括的区域的生产能力及其有关活动的一切开支，其中除其他外包括：固定年费或生产费(以较大的数额为准)、工资、薪给、员工福利、材料、服务、运输、加工和销售费用、利息、公用事业费、保全海洋环境、具体与合同业务有关的间接费用和行政费用等项开支，以及其中规定的从其前或其后的年度转帐的任何业务亏损净额。
Translation: (k) "Contractor's operating costs" refers to all expenditures incurred for the operations specified in the contract after the commencement of commercial production, calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, covering the production capacity of the contract area and all related activities. These include, among others: fixed annual fees or production charges (whichever is higher), wages, salaries, employee benefits, materials, services, transportation, processing and marketing costs, interest, utility expenses, marine environmental protection, indirect costs and administrative expenses specifically related to the contract operations, as well as any net operating loss carried forward from or to subsequent years as stipulated therein.

Query_Text_cn: 业务亏损净额可以连续两年转入下一年度的帐目，但在合同的最后两年除外，这两年可转入其前两年的帐目。
Translation: Net operating losses may be carried forward into the next fiscal year's accounts for two consecutive years, except in the final two years of the contract, when they may be carried back into the accounts of the preceding two years.

Query_Text_cn: (l)如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核并生产加工金属和半加工金属，则“采矿部门发展费用”是指依照一般公认的会计原则和管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，承包者发展费用中与开采合同包括的区域的资源直接有关的部分，其中除其他外包括：申请费、固定年费以及在可适用的情形下在合同包括的区域进行探矿和勘探的费用和一部分研究与发展费用。
Translation: (l) If the contractor engages in the exploitation of polymetallic nodules, their transportation, and the production of processed and semi-processed metals, "development costs of the mining sector" shall refer to that portion of the contractor's development costs directly related to the resources in the area covered by the contract, as determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority. This includes, inter alia, application fees, fixed annual fees, and, where applicable, the costs of prospecting and exploration in the contract area, as well as a portion of research and development expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (m)任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的开发合同区域收益净额与采矿部门发展费用的比率。
Translation: (m) "Investment gains" for any fiscal year shall mean the ratio of the net proceeds from the development contract area in that year to the development costs of the mining sector.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，采矿部门发展费用应包括采矿部门购买新装备或替换装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, development expenditures in the mining sector shall include the cost of purchasing or replacing equipment in the mining sector, minus the original price of the replaced equipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⑴“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者的全部收益净额。
Translation: (1) "Net proceeds from the development of the contract area" refers to the Contractor's total net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵“承包者收益净额”的定义与(f)项相同。
Translation: (2) The definition of "net proceeds of the contractor" is the same as in paragraph (f).

Query_Text_cn: ⑶“承包者收益毛额”是指出售多金属结核的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (3) "Gross proceeds of the Contractor" means the gross proceeds from the sale of polymetallic nodules and any other amounts reasonably attributable to operations conducted under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: ⑷“承包者发展费用”是指如(h)项⑴目所述在商业生产开始前所承担的以及如(h)项⑵目所述在商业生产开始后所承担的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的一切开支。
Translation: (4) "Contractor's development costs" means all expenditures incurred prior to the commencement of commercial production as set forth in subparagraph (h)(1) and subsequent to the commencement of commercial production as set forth in subparagraph (h)(2), which are in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and directly related to the resources of the area covered by the exploitation contract.

Query_Text_cn: ⑸“承包者业务费用”是指如(k)项所述的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的承包者业务费用。
Translation: (5) "Contractor's business expenses" refers to the contractor's business expenses directly related to the resources in the area covered by the exploitation contract, as described in item (k), in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.

Query_Text_cn: ⑹任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的承包者收益净额与承包者发展费用的比率。
Translation: (6) "Return on investment" for any accounting year means the ratio of the Contractor's net proceeds to the Contractor's development costs for that year.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，承包者发展费用应包括购买新装备或替装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, the contractor's development costs shall include expenditures on the acquisition of new or replacement equipment, minus the original cost of the replaced equipment.

Query_Text_cn: (o)关于(h)、(k)(l)和(n)项所指的承包者所付的有关利息的费用，应在一切情形下，只有在管理局按照本附件第四条第1款，并顾及当时的商业惯例，认为债务资产净值比率和利率是合理的限度内，才容许列为费用。
Translation: (o) The costs in respect of interest paid by the contractor referred to in paragraphs (h), (k)(l) and (n) shall be allowed as deductible items in all cases only to the extent that, in the opinion of the Authority, in accordance with paragraph 1 of article 4 of this Annex and taking into account prevailing commercial practices, the debt-to-equity ratio and the rate of interest are reasonable.

Query_Text_cn: (p)本款所指费用不应解释为包括缴付国家对承包者业务所征收的公司所得税或类似课税的款项。
Translation: (p) The costs referred to in this paragraph shall not be construed as including payments in respect of corporate income tax or similar charges levied by the State on the operations of contractors.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)第5和第6款所指的“加工金属”是指国际中心市场上通常买卖的最基本形式的金属。
Translation: 7.(a) The term "processed metal" referred to in paragraphs 5 and 6 means metal in its most basic form as commonly traded on international central markets.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，管理局应在财务规则、规章和程序中列明有关的国际中心市场。
Translation: For this purpose,the Authority shall specify in the financial regulations,rules and procedures the relevant international central markets.

Query_Text_cn: (b)如果管理局无法以其他方式确定第5款(b)项和第6款(b)项所指自合同包括在区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属的数量，此项数量应依照管理局的规则、规章和程序并按照一般公认的会计原则，根据结核的金属含量、加工回收效率和其他有关因素予以确定。
Translation: (b) If the Authority cannot otherwise determine the quantity of processed metals produced from polymetallic nodules recovered from the Area that are referred to in paragraphs 5(b) and 6(b) of the contract, such quantity shall be determined in accordance with the rules, regulations and procedures of the Authority and generally accepted accounting principles, based on the metal content of the nodules, processing recovery efficiency and other relevant factors.

Query_Text_cn: 8.如果一个国际中心市场为加工金属、多金属结核和产自这种结核的半加工金属提供一个有代表性的定价机构，即应使用这个市场的平均价格。
Translation: 8. If an international central market serves as a representative pricing mechanism for processed metals, polymetallic nodules, and semi-processed metals derived from such nodules, the average price from this market shall be applied.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有其他情形下，管理局应在同承包者协商后，按照第9款为上述产品定出一个公平的价格。
Translation: In all other cases,the Authority shall,after consultation with the contractor,determine a fair price for such products in accordance with paragraph 9.

Query_Text_cn: 9.(a)本条所指的一切费用、开支、收益和收入，以及对价格和价值的一切决定，均应为自由市场或正当交易的结果。
Translation: 9.(a) All fees, expenses, proceeds and revenues referred to in this Article, as well as all determinations of prices and values, shall be the result of a free market or bona fide transaction.

Query_Text_cn: (b)为了保证本款的规定得到遵守和执行，管理局应遵循联合国跨国公司委员会、发展中和发达国家间税务条约专家组以及其他国际组织对于正当交易所制定的原则和所作的解释，并应在其规则、规章和程序中，具体规定划一的和国际上接受的会计规则和程序，以及为了遵照这些规则、规章和程序查核帐目的目的，由承包者选择管理局认可的领有执照的独立会计师的方法。
Translation: (b) To ensure compliance with and enforcement of the provisions of this paragraph, the Authority shall adhere to the principles and interpretations established by the United Nations Commission on Transnational Corporations, the Group of Experts on Tax Treaties between Developing and Developed Countries, and other international organizations concerning legitimate transactions. It shall also specify in its rules, regulations, and procedures uniform and internationally accepted accounting rules and procedures, as well as the method for contractors to select licensed independent accountants approved by the Authority for the purpose of auditing accounts in accordance with these rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 10.承包者应按照管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，向会计师提供为决定本条是否得到遵守所必要的财务资料。
Translation: 10. The contractor shall provide the accountant with the financial data necessary for determining compliance with this article in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 大约在十五年前，有一天我在友人古斯塔夫·哈隆教授的书房里，和他共同研读主要是道家思想的古书《管子》。这次，他建议很快翻过我们正在读的那一章的某些材料，因为其中似乎只包括一些关于动物的荒诞无稽的传说。可是我却仔细地研究了它。
Translation: About fifteen years ago, I was in the study of my friend Professor Gustav Haloun, poring over the ancient text *Guanzi*, which primarily embodies Daoist thought. On that occasion, he suggested quickly skimming certain sections of the chapter we were reading, as they seemed to contain nothing but absurd and unfounded legends about animals. However, I examined them closely.

Query_Text_cn: 结果发现，其中有一段文字谈到某些海洋动物受到月亮周期的影响，它们的大小随着月亮的盈亏而增大或缩小。
Translation: The findings revealed that a section of the text discussed how certain marine animals are influenced by the lunar cycle, with their size fluctuating in sync with the waxing and waning of the moon.

Query_Text_cn: 我大为惊奇，因为我记得亚里士多德曾说过完全相同的话。
Translation: I was greatly astonished, for I remembered that Aristotle had made exactly the same remark.

Query_Text_cn: 亚里士多德的叙述中所指的是海。我们现在已经证实了他的观察。
Translation: Aristotle's account refers to the sea. We have now confirmed his observation.

Query_Text_cn: 后一种看法的可能性是难以令人信服的。
Translation: The plausibility of the latter view is unconvincing.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一次，在我写这些段文字之前的几个星期，我参加了皇家医学会的一次会议，会上有另一位老朋友查尔斯·辛格博士谈到盖伦和古代解剖学的关系。
Translation: On another occasion, just a few weeks before I wrote these lines, I attended a meeting of the Royal Society of Medicine where another old friend, Dr. Charles Singer, spoke on Galen and the history of ancient anatomy.

Query_Text_cn: 他强调说，盖伦本人从来没有解剖过人体，他的老师们也没有解剖过，可是亚历山大时代的人确实进行过解剖，这开始于公元前3世纪上半叶的希罗菲卢斯和埃拉西斯特拉图斯。
Translation: He emphasized that Galen himself had never dissected a human body, nor had his teachers, yet dissection was indeed practiced during the Alexandrian era, beginning with Herophilus and Erasistratus in the first half of the 3rd century BC.

Query_Text_cn: 早期菡督教的神父们大都把解剖当作一件骇人听闻的事情，他们自己从来不接触解剖。我感到这个事实是很奇特的，因为在中国也可以看到古代解剖学出现过类似的兴起和衰落。中国古代解剖学起源相当早，始于扁鹊，王莽时代（公元9年）已有进行解剖的确据，并持续到稍晚的三国时期（公元240年前后）。此后，也象在欧洲一样，解剖学便绝迹了，直到中世纪晚期才再度出现。
Translation: Most early Christian priests regarded anatomy as a horrifying practice and never engaged in it themselves. I find this fact quite peculiar, because a similar rise and decline of ancient anatomy can be observed in China. The origins of Chinese anatomy date back quite early, starting with Bian Que. By the time of Wang Mang's reign (9 AD), there was definitive evidence of anatomical practices, which continued into the slightly later Three Kingdoms period (around 240 AD). After that, much like in Europe, anatomy disappeared until its revival in the late Middle Ages.

Query_Text_cn: 宋朝的解剖学者，大约比蒙迪诺·德·卢齐早一个世纪，可是没有发展下去。
Translation: Chinese anatomists during the Song Dynasty predated Mondino de Luzzi by approximately a century, yet their discipline failed to advance further.

Query_Text_cn: 我举这些事例——还可以举出其他许多同样惊人的类似事例——目的是想指出，在讨论中国思想史和各门科学史之前，有必要谈谈在不同的历史时期内东亚和西欧之间思想传播的可靠性。
Translation: I cite these examples—and many other equally astonishing parallels could be mentioned—to suggest that before discussing the history of Chinese thought and the various sciences, it is necessary to address the reliability of intellectual transmission between East Asia and Western Europe during different historical periods.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，作为必要的准备，简要地讨论一下诸如通过贸易路线和翻译人员可能产生相互影响的各种条件等整个问题，显然是适宜的。
Translation: Therefore, as a necessary preparation, it is evidently appropriate to briefly discuss the entire issue, including various conditions that may generate mutual influence through trade routes and interpreters.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管有大量的文献讨论到中国和欧洲之间的交往（下面即将简要地概述这些文献），可是我们还是没有足够的事实来作出总结，而且愈是深入追溯历史细节，情形当然便变得愈加复杂。
Translation: Although there is a substantial body of literature discussing exchanges between China and Europe (which will be briefly outlined below), we still lack sufficient facts to draw definitive conclusions. Moreover, the situation inevitably becomes more complex as we delve deeper into the historical details.

Query_Text_cn: 已经编写出来的文献中，有许多东西只不过是猜想而已。
Translation: Much of the existing literature consists merely of conjecture.

Query_Text_cn: 在关于文字那一节中，我们提到过18世纪时的“体系”，当时人们根据早先的认识，了解到中国文字是象形性质的，因而认为中国人是“古代埃及人的移民”。
Translation: In the section on writing, we mentioned the 18th-century "system" where, based on earlier knowledge, it was understood that Chinese characters were pictographic in nature, leading to the belief that the Chinese were "descendants of ancient Egyptian immigrants."

Query_Text_cn: 到19世纪，有些人在讨论中曾固执地坚持这一观点，可是现在象特里恩·德·拉库佩里或鲍尔的理论早已被驳倒了，因此主张中国文明主要是独立发展的人们，再也用不着与他们争辩了。
Translation: By the 19th century, some individuals tenaciously clung to this view in discussions, but theories like those of Terrien de Lacouperie or Bauer have long since been refuted. Consequently, those who argue that Chinese civilization developed primarily independently no longer need to engage in debate with them.

Query_Text_cn: 可是，认为在中国人的思想和实践中，有一大部分特殊的发展来源于西方，这种成见是很难消除的。
Translation: However, the deeply ingrained notion that a significant portion of China's intellectual and practical developments originated from the West is difficult to dispel.

Query_Text_cn: 让我们举几个例子。
Translation: Let us cite a few examples.

Query_Text_cn: 马伯乐起先认为，《山海经》中所叙述的中国古代地理学是受到公元前5世纪外来（印度和伊朗）潮流的刺激，并且大部分中国天文学也是由于西方的启发。
Translation: Ma Bole initially believed that the ancient Chinese geography described in the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" was stimulated by external influences (from India and Iran) in the 5th century BC, and that much of Chinese astronomy was also inspired by the West.

Query_Text_cn: 他认为二十八宿、岁星纪年、圭表和漏壶是在大流士时代传入的；而在亚历山大时代的第二次潮流中，又传入了几何学、十二循环法、星表体系等等。
Translation: He believed that the twenty-eight lunar mansions, the Jupiter cycle calendar, the gnomon, and the water clock were introduced during the era of Darius; while in the second wave of influence during Alexander's time, geometry, the duodecimal cycle method, and the star catalog system were further transmitted.

Query_Text_cn: 我们将要看到，所有这些说法都是根据不足的，并且，马伯乐在他自己后来关于中国天文学的优秀专著中，也放弃了这些观点，不再谈交流和刺激的问题了。
Translation: We shall see that all these assertions were inadequately founded, and that Maspero, in his own later and excellent monograph on Chinese astronomy, abandoned these views and ceased to speak of exchanges and stimuli.

Query_Text_cn: 中国的“宿”和印度的“纳沙特拉”（意为月站）的关系，至今还是一个难题，人们尚无法决定其孰先孰后。
Translation: The relationship between China's "Su" and India's "Nakshatra" (meaning lunar station) remains an unresolved issue, as scholars have yet to determine which system predates the other.

Query_Text_cn: 它们都可能来源于巴比伦。
Translation: They may all have originated from Babylon.

Query_Text_cn: 另有一些作者则任意地假设中国科学中的几乎每种有价值的东西都来自西方。例如，瓦卡曾不加思索地得出结论说，汉代的记里鼓车来自亚历山大里亚的赫伦（著称于公元60年）。可是在中国文献中最早提到记里鼓车，是和燕太子丹（公元前240—前226年）及韩延寿（公元前140—前70年之间）的名字连在一起的。
Translation: Other authors have arbitrarily assumed that nearly every valuable element in Chinese science was derived from the West. For instance, Vaca, without hesitation, concluded that the odometer chariot of the Han Dynasty originated from Heron of Alexandria (flourished around 60 AD). However, the earliest mention of the odometer chariot in Chinese literature is associated with the names of Crown Prince Dan of Yan (240–226 BC) and Han Yanshou (active between 140–70 BC).

Query_Text_cn: 汉代早期的这些记载并没有把记里鼓车当作很新鲜的事物；人们即使对当时所记述的记里鼓车究竟是什么车子还有点怀疑，那末，在汉代后期便有了关于记里鼓车的确切描述，这些记述出现得如此之快，以致很难认为它是从亚历山大里亚城传入的。瓦卡还认为，《周髀算经》中的几何学也来自西方，中国早期对∏值的计算也是从西方得到启发，而1300年朱世杰的二项式系数表则是从欧麦尔·海亚姆来的等等。
Translation: These early Han Dynasty records did not treat the odometer cart as a particularly novel invention. Even if there remains some doubt about the exact nature of the vehicle described at that time, definitive accounts of the odometer cart emerged so swiftly in the later Han period that it is difficult to attribute its origins to Alexandria. Vacca further argued that the geometry in the "Zhou Bi Suan Jing" was derived from the West, early Chinese calculations of the value of π were inspired by Western sources, and Zhu Shijie's binomial coefficient table from 1300 AD was borrowed from Omar Khayyam, among other claims.

Query_Text_cn: 他在论文结束时有一段确实令人惊奇的说法，他说，中国第一位重要的天文学家是唐代的僧一行，而一行晚于依巴谷及其同时代的人整整一千年，因而这些人确实领先于他。
Translation: At the conclusion of his paper, he makes a truly astonishing assertion: he states that China's first significant astronomer was the Tang Dynasty monk Yi Xing, yet Yi Xing lived a full millennium after Hipparchus and his contemporaries, who were indeed far ahead of him.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一个有趣的例子是奥地利工程师霍维茨的研究，我们将在工程学那一章中详细讨论。
Translation: Another interesting example is the research by Austrian engineer Horwitz, which we will discuss in detail in the chapter on engineering.

Query_Text_cn: 他和其他技术史家一样，认为1726年的大型类书《古今图书集成》中有些机械图显然是临摹的，而且临摹得很糟，他能认出那些图出自16世纪的欧洲书籍。
Translation: Like other historians of technology, he believed that some of the mechanical illustrations in the 1726 encyclopedia "Complete Collection of Illustrations and Writings from the Earliest to Current Times" were clearly copied—and poorly at that—from 16th-century European books, which he could identify.

Query_Text_cn: 以后，人们又通过I7世纪初期耶稣会士有关工程学的首批著作，查考出这些图流传到中国的线索。可是，这种论断有一些缺欠：（1）它假定了不相符合之处都是后来中国临摹人员造成的，（2）既然这些图样是来自欧洲的，那末，当耶稣会士把这些机器引进中国之初，中国人总不会对它们毫无新奇之感的表示。
Translation: Later, people traced the clues of these diagrams' transmission to China through the first engineering works by Jesuits in the early 17th century. However, this argument has some flaws: (1) It assumes that all discrepancies were caused by later Chinese copyists; (2) Since these designs originated from Europe, the Chinese would not have shown no sense of novelty when the Jesuits first introduced these machines to China.

Query_Text_cn: 在哲学理论和实践的领域内，有人曾挖空心思地想证明，早期的道家学说在153很大程度上受到印度《奥义书》影响，并从印度瑜珈的教理中获得苦修法，不仅如此，他们还进一步认为，中国的禅宗佛教也是从印度传入的。
Translation: In the realm of philosophical theory and practice, some have gone to great lengths to argue that early Taoist doctrines were significantly influenced by the Indian Upanishads and derived ascetic practices from the teachings of Indian yoga. Moreover, they further assert that Chinese Chan Buddhism was also introduced from India.

Query_Text_cn: 可是正如顾立雅所说这些论点从来没有真正使人信服过。
Translation: But as Herrlee Creel pointed out, these arguments have never been truly convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 《奥义书》是婆罗门经典《吠陀》的形而上学的释义，这些文献形成的时期是在公元前8世纪到前4世纪），因而它们比道家的初期理论著作略早一点。
Translation: The Upanishads are metaphysical interpretations of the Brahmanic scripture, the Vedas, with their formation period spanning from the 8th to the 4th century BCE. Thus, they predate the early theoretical works of Taoism by a slight margin.

Query_Text_cn: 它们非常显著的形而上学观念论及其对“梵”和“我”即绝对和自身一致的观点完全不是道家的特征，尽管（我们以后将看到）道家非常强调自然界的统一性以及个人与自然的合一。
Translation: Their pronounced metaphysical idealism and their conception of "Brahman" and "Atman" as the absolute and self-consistent are entirely foreign to Taoism, though (as we shall see later) Taoism strongly emphasizes the unity of nature and the harmony between the individual and nature.

Query_Text_cn: 关于瑜珈的各种修行，特别是练气法（这在印度确是很古的），对早期道教有所影响的说法，可能有些道理。
Translation: The claim that various yoga practices, particularly pranayama (which indeed has ancient roots in India), exerted some influence on early Taoism may hold some validity.

Query_Text_cn: 道教有些教派确实以专心于呼吸来进行自我催眠；可是，这种方法并不普遍，庄子就有一段文章说它不适用。
Translation: Certain Taoist sects indeed employ focused breathing techniques for self-hypnosis; however, this method is not universally practiced. Zhuangzi, for instance, explicitly critiques its applicability in one of his passages.

Query_Text_cn: 不管怎样，道家的这种类似“定”或“禅”的目的和印度人的“利雪斯”是完全不相同的。
Translation: In any case, the purpose of this Daoist practice, akin to "concentration" or "meditation," is entirely different from the Indian concept of "Lysis."

Query_Text_cn: 他们二者都想控制有机的生命并获得“超自然”的能力，可是印度人寻求的是足以使他们能够支配诸神的一种苦行感化力，而道家寻求的却是宇宙中物质的永生，因为在道家的宇宙中并没有需要他们去征服的神，修行只是道家用以达到目的的方法之一。
Translation: Both sought to control organic life and attain "supernatural" powers, yet the Indians pursued ascetic influence powerful enough to dominate their gods, while the Taoists sought physical immortality within a cosmos devoid of deities to conquer—for them, spiritual practice was but one means to this end.

Query_Text_cn: 除了在入静的自我催眠中默思宇宙外，道家对房中术也感到兴趣，他们认为应用这种方术可以长寿；而他们最大的兴趣在于炼丹，认为丹药可以使服者永生不死。
Translation: In addition to contemplating the universe through meditative self-hypnosis, Taoists also took an interest in sexual techniques, believing their practice could prolong life. Their greatest fascination, however, lay in alchemy, as they held that elixirs could grant immortality to those who consumed them.

Query_Text_cn: 大家承认，在古代印度人和波斯人的思想中都有同后面这两种因素相似的东西。
Translation: It is acknowledged that both the ancient Indians and Persians harbored concepts akin to these latter two elements in their philosophies.

Query_Text_cn: 两性关系在印度的一切神话和宗教中一直是非常重要的，特别是在“萨克蒂思”的经文中，并且正如德效骞所指出的，古代的使人狂醉的圣饮（印度的“苏摩酒”，波斯的“赫劳马”在某种意义上是被当作长生不老的灵丹妙药的。
Translation: Gender relations have always held significant importance in all Indian myths and religions, particularly in the texts of "Shaktism." As noted by Homer H. Dubs, the ancient intoxicating sacred drinks—India's "Soma" and Persia's "Haoma"—were in a sense regarded as elixirs of immortality.

Query_Text_cn: 可是总的说来，应该说所能举出的相似之处终究还是空洞的、不可靠的，而中国思想的整个气氛和知识环境都和印度的或波斯的截然不同。
Translation: Yet on the whole, it must be said that the similarities that can be cited are ultimately hollow and unreliable, for the entire intellectual atmosphere and epistemological milieu of Chinese thought are fundamentally distinct from those of India or Persia.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，禅宗佛教的入定来源于印度的吠陀哲学之说以及由菩提达摩祖师传入的典故，早经伯希和指出是后出的传说，只是为了使禅宗布道具有权威性而编造出来的。
Translation: Finally, the notion that Zen Buddhist meditation originated from Indian Vedic philosophy and was transmitted by Bodhidharma was long ago identified by Paul Pelliot as a later fabrication, concocted solely to lend authority to Zen proselytism.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一种常见的看法，认为中国思想中的阴阳二元论：是从波斯传入的。
Translation: Another common view holds that the yin-yang dualism in Chinese thought was introduced from Persia.

Query_Text_cn: 这两个字原来的含义是山坡或房屋的荫蔽面和向阳面，约在公元前4世纪它们突然成了哲学名词。阴代表黑暗、软弱、女性、夜晚、月亮等等，阳代表光明、强壮、男性、白天、太阳等等，从这些范畴中滋长出一种关于自然界的微妙理论。
Translation: Originally, these two characters meant the shaded and sunny sides of a hill or house. Around the 4th century BC, they suddenly became philosophical terms. Yin represents darkness, weakness, femininity, night, the moon, and so on, while Yang represents light, strength, masculinity, day, the sun, and the like. From these categories emerged a subtle theory about the natural world.

Query_Text_cn: 这种理论在表面上好象和袄教很相似，可是我完全同意韦利的说法，他否认后者对前者有任何直接的影响。
Translation: This theory appears superficially similar to Zoroastrianism, yet I fully concur with Waley's assertion that he denies any direct influence of the latter upon the former.

Query_Text_cn: 他说：“在袄教中，黑暗主要是邪恶，而光明的实质主要是善良。
Translation: He said,"In Zoroastrianism,darkness is primarily evil,while the essence of light is predominantly good."

Query_Text_cn: 它们是事物存在的既独立而又相辅相成的两个方面。
Translation: They are two aspects of existence that are both independent and mutually complementary.

Query_Text_cn: 哲学家们主张阴阳学说的目的不是为了光明的胜利，而是企图在人生中获得两者之间的完美的和谐。
Translation: The purpose of philosophers advocating the theory of yin and yang was not the triumph of light, but rather the pursuit of perfect harmony between the two in human life.

Query_Text_cn: 韦利从中国固有的占卜活动去找寻阴阳理论的起源，无疑是正确的。
Translation: Willy's approach to tracing the origin of the Yin-Yang theory through China's indigenous divination practices is undoubtedly accurate.

Query_Text_cn: 他也曾毫无困难地反驳了关于五行说来自希腊四元素说的观点。事实上，中国五行说的基本概念是论相生相胜的过程，而静止的四元素说却只是内在性的或衍生性的。
Translation: He also effortlessly refuted the claim that the Chinese theory of the Five Elements originated from the Greek theory of the Four Elements. In fact, the fundamental concept of the Chinese Five Elements theory revolves around the processes of mutual generation and overcoming, whereas the static Four Elements theory merely pertains to inherent or derivative properties.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，他讨论了惠悖论和埃利亚学派的惇论之间的关系，但没有得到任何肯定两者有关系的结论。事实上，两者的这种相似性又可以作为一个实例来说明，我们有时可以在旧大陆相距遥远的两地，发现一些类似现象的异乎寻常的同时性。
Translation: Finally, he discussed the relationship between Hui Shi's paradoxes and the paradoxes of the Eleatic school but reached no definitive conclusion linking the two. In fact, this similarity itself can serve as another example illustrating how we sometimes encounter remarkable synchronicities of analogous phenomena in widely separated regions of the Old World.

Query_Text_cn: 菔枪世纪中期的人，而埃利亚的芝诺的盛名期是公元前460年前后。
Translation: The man lived in the mid-fifth century BC, while Zeno of Elea's period of greatest fame was around 460 BC.

Query_Text_cn: 这里出现的同时性，至少和本章开始时所说的海生无脊椎动物的生殖与月亮的周期性有关的情形同样明显，或者象最早同时出现水磨的情形那样。关于水磨，我们将放在后面和其他机械的例子一同讨论。
Translation: The synchronicity observed here is at least as evident as the correlation between the reproductive cycles of marine invertebrates and lunar phases mentioned at the beginning of this chapter, or like the earliest simultaneous emergence of watermills. As for watermills, we will discuss them later alongside other examples of machinery.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管我们往往倾向于认为每一件事物只有一个来源，可是我们不能排除在不同地方出现完全独立而相似的思路的可能性，特别是在有关科学理论、发现和观察等方面。
Translation: Although we often tend to assume that everything has a single origin, we cannot rule out the possibility of entirely independent yet similar ideas emerging in different places, particularly concerning scientific theories, discoveries, and observations.

Query_Text_cn: 我们可以用原子论作为一个实例。
Translation: We can take atomism as an example.

Query_Text_cn: 在西方的古典文明中，原子论的历史始于公元前5世纪的留基伯和阿夫季拉的德谟克利特等人，而在公元前3世纪后期和公元前1世纪早期的伊壁鸠鲁和卢克莱修时代达到高峰。
Translation: In the classical civilizations of the West, the history of atomism began with figures such as Leucippus and Democritus of Abdera in the 5th century BCE, reaching its peak during the era of Epicurus and Lucretius in the late 3rd century BCE and early 1st century BCE.

Query_Text_cn: 这段历史我们都很熟悉。印度的原子论似乎较晚些，乌摩斯伐底的耆那体系在公元50年前后最为盛行，而迦那陀的胜论在公元2世纪下半叶才流传开来。
Translation: This history is familiar to us all. India's atomism appears to have emerged later, with the Jaina system of Umāsvāti gaining prominence around 50 AD, while the Vaiśeṣika of Kaṇāda did not spread until the latter half of the 2nd century AD.

Query_Text_cn: 可是如雷伊所认为的，有理由相信，在印度思想史中，155原子论的根源还要早得多。
Translation: Yet as Rayi suggests, there is reason to believe that the origins of atomism in Indian intellectual history date back much earlier than 155.

Query_Text_cn: 在中国物理学中，我们将看到，原子论从未出现过，可是在《墨经》的几何学中（该书可能是在公元前370年左右编集成的），似乎把点定义为将线分割到无可再分割的程度。
Translation: In Chinese physics, we shall see that atomism never appeared, yet in the geometry of the Mohist Canon (a text likely compiled around 370 BCE), a point seems to be defined as the limit of dividing a line until it can no longer be divided.

Query_Text_cn: 因此确实没有理由认为，不可分割性的概念不会在这三大文明的每一个区域内独立地产生。
Translation: Therefore, there is indeed no reason to believe that the concept of indivisibility could not have independently emerged within each of these three major civilizations.

Query_Text_cn: 在每一文明区内，人们都砍伐木材，并把木材和其他材料锯成各种长度，因此，某些好深思的人们便不难想象，如果把这些东西继续分割下去，直到剩下的东西已小到不能再分割成两半的时候，该会出现什么情形。这时，哲学的思考就会推想到，用这些小物体的排列和运动便能解释一切事物了。
Translation: Within every civilization, people cut timber and saw it, along with other materials, into various lengths. Thus, it was not difficult for some contemplative minds to imagine what would happen if these materials were continuously divided until the remaining pieces were too small to be split further. At this point, philosophical reasoning would suggest that the arrangement and motion of these tiny particles could explain all phenomena.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一种情况，我觉得与上述情况相似，那是亚里士多德的“灵魂阶梯”学说。根据这种学说，植物被认为具有生长的灵魂，动物具有生长和感觉的灵魂，而人则具有生长、感觉和理性的灵魂。
Translation: Another similar case, in my view, is Aristotle's doctrine of the "Ladder of Souls." According to this doctrine, plants are believed to possess a vegetative soul, animals a vegetative and sensitive soul, while humans possess a vegetative, sensitive, and rational soul.

Query_Text_cn: 我将在后面说明，荀子（荀卿）曾宣讲过很相似的学说。
Translation: I will later explain that Xunzi (Xun Qing) once preached a very similar doctrine.

Query_Text_cn: 亚里士多德生活在公元前384—前322年，荀卿则在公元前384—前322年。
Translation: Aristotle lived from 384 to 322 BC, while Xun Qing existed between 384 and 322 BC.

Query_Text_cn: 假若这种概念是经过传播的，那就必须传播得十分迅速。从当时的旅行条件来看，进行如此迅速的传墦是极不可能的。
Translation: If this concept was indeed disseminated, it must have spread with remarkable speed. Given the travel conditions of the time, such rapid transmission would have been highly improbable.

Query_Text_cn: 我们宁可相信这种概念是各自独立产生的，因为它终究明显地反映了自然界的阶梯性，并且或多或少直觉地认识到了有些生物比另外一些要简单得多的事实，因此，它实际上成为进化概念的先声，因为阶梯说一旦出现，进化概念很快就跟着出现了。
Translation: We prefer to believe that this concept arose independently, as it ultimately reflects the gradation in nature and, more or less intuitively, recognizes the fact that some organisms are far simpler than others. Thus, it actually heralded the concept of evolution, for once the idea of gradation emerged, the notion of evolution soon followed.

Query_Text_cn: 翟林奈曾指出，希腊的一些著作和《列子》一书之间有两处出现相似的事例，这使人们增加了对于这类相似事例的兴趣。《列子》一书的部分内容很可能早于公元前400年，可是列御寇这位哲学家是否真有其人，还很可怀疑。
